title: Leviticus 22:14
text: And if a man eats a holy thing without knowing it, then he shall put the fifth part to it, and shall give to the priest with the holy thing.

title: Leviticus 22:15
text: And they shall not profane the holy things of the sons of Israel which they offer to the LORD,

title: Leviticus 22:16
text: and so load on them the iniquity of the guilt offering in their eating of their holy things. For I [am] the LORD who sanctifies them.

title: Leviticus 22:17
text: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 22:18
text: Speak to Aaron and to his sons and to all the sons of Israel, and say to them: Any man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers in Israel, who offers his sacrifices for his vows, for all his free-will offerings, which they will offer to the LORD for a burnt offering,

title: Leviticus 22:19
text: [you shall offer] at your own will a male without blemish, of the cattle, of the sheep, or of the goats.

title: Leviticus 22:20
text: You shall not offer that which has a blemish. For it shall not be acceptable for you.

title: Leviticus 22:21
text: And when a man offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD to carry out [his] vow, or a free-will offering in cattle or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted. There shall be no blemish in them.

title: Leviticus 22:22
text: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a flow, or having scurvy, or scabbed, you shall not offer these to the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 22:23
text: As to a young bull or a sheep that is deformed or dwarfed, you may offer that [for] a free-will offering. But for a vow it shall not be accepted.

title: Leviticus 22:24
text: You shall not offer to the LORD that which is bruised or crushed, or broken or cut. You shall not make [any offering] of it in your land.

title: Leviticus 22:25
text: And you shall not offer the bread of your God out of the hand of a son of a stranger, or any of these, because their uncleanness [is] in them, and blemishes are in them. They shall not be accepted for you.

title: Leviticus 22:26
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 22:27
text: When a bull or a lamb or a goat is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam. And from the eighth day and from then on, it shall be accepted for a fire offering to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 22:28
text: But a bull or sheep, it and its young one, you shall not kill it in one day.

title: Leviticus 22:29
text: And when you will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the LORD, offer [it] at your own will.

title: Leviticus 22:30
text: On the same day it shall be eaten up. You shall leave none of it until morning. I [am] the LORD.

title: Leviticus 22:31
text: And you shall keep My commandments, and do them. I [am] the LORD.

title: Leviticus 22:32
text: And you shall not profane My holy name. But I will be holy among the sons of Israel. I [am] the LORD who is sanctifying you,

title: Leviticus 22:33
text: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. I [am] the LORD.

title: Leviticus 23:1
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 23:2
text: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, The feasts of the LORD, which you shall proclaim, holy convocations, even these are My appointed feasts.

title: Leviticus 23:3
text: Six days shall work be done, but the seventh day [is] the sabbath of rest, a holy convocation. You shall not do any work. It [is] a sabbath to the LORD in all your dwellings.

title: Leviticus 23:4
text: These [are] the appointed feasts of the LORD, holy convocations which you shall proclaim in their appointed seasons.

title: Leviticus 23:5
text: In the fourteenth [day] of the first month, between the evenings, is the LORD's Passover,

title: Leviticus 23:6
text: and on the fifteenth day of the same month [is] the Feast of Unleavened [Bread] to the LORD. You must eat unleavened [bread] seven days.

title: Leviticus 23:7
text: On the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no work of labor,

title: Leviticus 23:8
text: but you shall offer a fire offering to the LORD seven days. In the seventh day [is] a holy convocation. You shall do no work of labor.

title: Leviticus 23:9
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 23:10
text: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, When you have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap the harvest of it, then you shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest to the priest.

title: Leviticus 23:11
text: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD to be received for you. On the next day after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.

title: Leviticus 23:12
text: And you shall offer that day when you wave the sheaf, a male lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 23:13
text: And its food offering [shall be] two-tenth parts of fine flour mixed with oil, a fire offering to the LORD for a sweet savor. And the drink offering of it [shall be] of wine, the fourth [part] of a hin.

title: Leviticus 23:14
text: And you shall eat neither bread, nor parched grain, nor green ears, until the same day, until you have brought an offering to your God. [It shall be] a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

title: Leviticus 23:15
text: And you shall count to you from the next day after the sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete.

title: Leviticus 23:16
text: To the next day after the seventh sabbath you shall number fifty days. And you shall offer a new food offering to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 23:17
text: You shall bring out of your homes two wave loaves of two-tenth parts. They shall be of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, firstfruits to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 23:18
text: And you shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bull, and two rams. They shall be [for] a burnt offering to the LORD, with their food offering, and their drink offerings, a fire offering of sweet savor to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 23:19
text: Then you shall sacrifice one he-goat for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

title: Leviticus 23:20
text: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits, a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.

title: Leviticus 23:21
text: And you shall proclaim on the same day [that] it may be a holy convocation to you. You shall do no work of labor. [It shall be] a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

title: Leviticus 23:22
text: And when you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not completely reap the corner of your field. When you reap the gleaning of your harvest, you shall not gather. You shall leave them to the poor and to the stranger. I [am] the LORD your God.

title: Leviticus 23:23
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 23:24
text: Speak to the sons of Israel saying: In the seventh month, in the first [day] of the month, you shall have a sabbath, a memorial summons, a holy convocation.

title: Leviticus 23:25
text: You shall do no work of labor but you shall offer a fire offering to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 23:26
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 23:27
text: Also, on the tenth of this seventh month, this is a day of atonement. [It shall be] a holy convocation to you. And you shall afflict your souls and offer a fire offering to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 23:28
text: And you shall do no work in that same day, for it [is] a day of atonement, in order to make an atonement for you before the LORD your God.

title: Leviticus 23:29
text: For any soul who is not humbled in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.

title: Leviticus 23:30
text: And any soul who does any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.

title: Leviticus 23:31
text: You shall do no kind of work. [It shall be] a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

title: Leviticus 23:32
text: It [shall be] to you a sabbath of rest, and you shall humble your souls. In the ninth of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your sabbath.

title: Leviticus 23:33
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

title: Leviticus 23:34
text: Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month [shall be] the Feast of Tabernacles for seven days to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 23:35
text: On the first day [shall be] a holy convocation. You shall do no work of labor.

title: Leviticus 23:36
text: Seven days you shall offer a fire offering to the LORD. On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you. And you shall offer a fire offering to the LORD. It [is] a solemn assembly. And you shall do no work of labor.

title: Leviticus 23:37
text: These [are] the feasts of the LORD which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer a fire offering to the LORD, a burnt offering and a food offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, everything on its day;

title: Leviticus 23:38
text: besides the sabbath of the LORD, and besides your gifts, and besides all your vows, and besides all your free-will offerings which you give to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 23:39
text: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruit of the land, you shall keep a feast to the LORD seven days. On the first day [shall be] a sabbath, and on the eighth day shall be a sabbath.

title: Leviticus 23:40
text: And you shall take the fruit of majestic trees for yourselves on the first day, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook. And you shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.

title: Leviticus 23:41
text: And you shall keep it a feast to the LORD seven days in the year. [It shall be] a statute forever in your generations. You shall keep it in the seventh month.

title: Leviticus 23:42
text: You shall live in booths seven days. All that are born Israelites shall live in booths,

title: Leviticus 23:43
text: so that your generations may know that I made the sons of Israel live in booths when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I [am] the LORD your God.

title: Leviticus 23:44
text: And Moses declared the feasts of the LORD to the sons of Israel.

title: Leviticus 24:1
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 24:2
text: Command the sons of Israel that they bring to you pure olive oil, beaten, for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.

title: Leviticus 24:3
text: Aaron shall order it from evening until the morning before the LORD forever outside the veil of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation. [It shall be] a statute forever in your generations.

title: Leviticus 24:4
text: He shall order the lamps on the pure lampstand before the LORD forever.

title: Leviticus 24:5
text: And you shall take fine flour and bake twelve cakes of it. Two-tenth parts shall be in one cake.

title: Leviticus 24:6
text: And you shall set them in two rows, six [on] a row, on the pure table before the LORD.

title: Leviticus 24:7
text: And you shall put pure frankincense on [each] row, so that it may be on the bread for a memorial, a fire offering to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 24:8
text: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the LORD forever, from the sons of Israel by an everlasting covenant.

title: Leviticus 24:9
text: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons'. And they shall eat it in the holy place, for it [is] most holy to him of the fire offerings of the LORD, by a never-ending statute.

title: Leviticus 24:10
text: And the son of a woman of Israel, whose father [was] an Egyptian, went out among the sons of Israel. And this son of the woman of Israel and a man of Israel struggled together in the camp.

title: Leviticus 24:11
text: And the son of the woman of Israel blasphemed the name [of the LORD], and cursed. And they brought him to Moses. (And his mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.)

title: Leviticus 24:12
text: And they put him under guard, so that the mind of the LORD might be declared to them.

title: Leviticus 24:13
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

title: Leviticus 24:14
text: Bring forth the despiser outside the camp. And let all that heard lay their hands on his head. Let all the congregation stone him.

title: Leviticus 24:15
text: And you shall speak to the sons of Israel saying, Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.

title: Leviticus 24:16
text: And he that blasphemes the Name of the LORD shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall surely stone him. And the stranger as well, even as he that is born in the land; when he blasphemes the Name, he shall be put to death.

title: Leviticus 24:17
text: And he who kills any man shall surely be put to death.

title: Leviticus 24:18
text: And he who kills an animal shall make it good, animal for animal.

title: Leviticus 24:19
text: And if a man causes a blemish in his neighbor, as he has done, so shall it be done to him:

title: Leviticus 24:20
text: break for break, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. As he has caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him.

title: Leviticus 24:21
text: And he who kills an animal shall restore it. And he who kills a man shall be put to death.

title: Leviticus 24:22
text: One judgment shall be for you whether an alien or a native; for I [am] the LORD your God.

title: Leviticus 24:23
text: And Moses spoke to the sons of Israel that they should bring the despiser outside the camp, and stone him with stones. And the sons of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Leviticus 25:1
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses in Mount Sinai, saying,

title: Leviticus 25:2
text: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, When you come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 25:3
text: You shall sow your field six years, and you shall prune your vineyard six years, and gather in the fruit of it.

title: Leviticus 25:4
text: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest to the land, a sabbath for the LORD. You shall neither sow your field, nor prune your vineyard.

title: Leviticus 25:5
text: You shall not reap that which grows of its own accord of your harvest, neither gather the grapes of your undressed vine. It is a year of rest to the land.

title: Leviticus 25:6
text: And the sabbath of the land shall be food for you, for you and for your servant, and for your slave woman and for your hired servant, and for your stranger who stays with you,

title: Leviticus 25:7
text: and for your cattle, and for the beast that [is] in your land, shall all the increase of it be for food.

title: Leviticus 25:8
text: And you shall number seven sabbaths of years to you, seven times seven years. And the time of the seven sabbaths of years shall be forty-nine years to you.

title: Leviticus 25:9
text: Then you shall cause the trumpet of the jubilee to sound on the tenth of the seventh month; in the day of atonement, the trumpet sound throughout all your land.

title: Leviticus 25:10
text: And you shall make the fiftieth year holy, [one] year, and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee to you, and you shall return each man to his possession, and you shall return each man to his family.

title: Leviticus 25:11
text: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee to you. You shall not sow, neither reap that which grows of itself in it, nor gather in it of your undressed vine.

title: Leviticus 25:12
text: For it [is] the jubilee. It shall be holy to you. You shall eat the increase of it out of the field.

title: Leviticus 25:13
text: In the year of this jubilee you shall return each man to his possession.

title: Leviticus 25:14
text: And if you sell anything to your neighbor, or buy from your neighbor's hand, you shall not oppress one another.

title: Leviticus 25:15
text: According to the number of years after the jubilee you shall buy of your neighbor, according to the number of years of the fruits he shall sell to you.

title: Leviticus 25:16
text: According to the number of years you shall increase the price of it, and according to the fewness of years you shall diminish the price of it, for he is selling to you the number of crops.

title: Leviticus 25:17
text: And you shall not oppress one another. But you shall fear your God. For I [am] the LORD your God.

title: Leviticus 25:18
text: And you shall do My statutes, and keep My judgments and do them. And you shall dwell in the land in safety.

title: Leviticus 25:19
text: And the land shall yield its fruits, and you shall eat your fill and dwell in it in safety.

title: Leviticus 25:20
text: And if you shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? Behold, we shall not sow nor gather in our increase!

title: Leviticus 25:21
text: Then I will command My blessing on you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.

title: Leviticus 25:22
text: And you shall sow the eighth year, and eat of old fruit until the ninth year; until its fruits come in, you shall eat the old fruit.

title: Leviticus 25:23
text: The land shall not be sold forever; for the land [is] Mine. For you are strangers and pilgrims with Me.

title: Leviticus 25:24
text: And in all the land of your possession you shall grant a redemption for the land.

title: Leviticus 25:25
text: If your brother has become poor, and has sold his possessions, and if any of his relatives come to redeem it, then he shall redeem that which his brother sold.

title: Leviticus 25:26
text: And if the man has no redeemer, and he himself is able to redeem it, and he has enough [for] its redemption;

title: Leviticus 25:27
text: then let him count the years of the sale of it, and restore the overplus to the man to whom he sold it, so that he may return to his possession.

title: Leviticus 25:28
text: But if he is not able to restore to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that has bought it until the year of jubilee. And in the jubilee it shall go out, and he shall return to his possession.

title: Leviticus 25:29
text: And if a man sells a dwelling house [in] a walled city, then he may redeem it [within] a whole year after it is sold. He may redeem it within a full year.

title: Leviticus 25:30
text: And if it is not redeemed within the time of a full year, then the house in the walled city shall be made sure forever its buyer throughout his generations. It shall not go out in the jubilee.

title: Leviticus 25:31
text: But the houses of the villages which have no walls around them shall be counted as the field of the country. They may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubilee.

title: Leviticus 25:32
text: As to the cities of the Levites, the houses of the cities of their possession, the Levites shall have a never-ending redemption.

title: Leviticus 25:33
text: And if a man purchases [a house] from the Levites, then the house that was sold and the city of his possession shall go out in [the year of] jubilee. For the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the sons of Israel.

title: Leviticus 25:34
text: But the field of the open land of their cities may not be sold, for it [is] theirs forever.

title: Leviticus 25:35
text: And if your brother has become poor, and his hand has failed with you, then you shall help him; yes, [even if he is] a stranger or a visitor, so that he may live with you.

title: Leviticus 25:36
text: You shall take no interest from him, or increase. But you shall fear your God, so that your brother may live with you.

title: Leviticus 25:37
text: You shall not give him your silver on interest, nor lend him your food for increase.

title: Leviticus 25:38
text: I [am] the LORD your God who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan [and] to be your God.

title: Leviticus 25:39
text: And if your brother [who lives] beside you has become poor, and is sold to you, you shall not compel him to serve as a bond-servant.

title: Leviticus 25:40
text: As a hired servant, as a temporary resident, he shall be with you, and shall serve you until the year of jubilee.

title: Leviticus 25:41
text: And he shall depart from you, he and his sons with him, and shall return to his own family. And he shall return to the possession of his fathers.

title: Leviticus 25:42
text: For they [are] My servants, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold as a slave.

title: Leviticus 25:43
text: You shall not rule over him with rigor, but shall fear your God.

title: Leviticus 25:44
text: Both your male slaves, and your female slaves whom you shall have, [shall be] of the nations that are all around you. You shall buy male slaves and female slaves from them.

title: Leviticus 25:45
text: And also you may buy of the sons of the tenants who are staying with you; and from their families that [are] with you, whom they fathered in your land. And they shall be your possession.

title: Leviticus 25:46
text: And you shall take them as an inheritance [for] your sons after you, to hold [for] a possession; you may lay service on them forever. But you shall not rule over your brothers, the sons of Israel, over one another, with harshness.

title: Leviticus 25:47
text: And if an alien or a tenant lifts up a hand among you, and your brother [who dwells] beside him becomes poor and sells himself to the alien [or] tenant by you, or to the offshoot of the alien's family,

title: Leviticus 25:48
text: after he is sold he may be redeemed again. One of his brothers may redeem him;

title: Leviticus 25:49
text: either his uncle or his uncle's son may redeem him, or [any] that is near of kin to him of his family may redeem him. Or if he is able, he may redeem himself.

title: Leviticus 25:50
text: And he shall count with his buyer from the year that he was sold to him, until the year of jubilee. And the price of his sale shall be according to the number of years, according to the time of a hired servant it shall be with him.

title: Leviticus 25:51
text: If [there are] still many years, he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the silver that he was bought for, according to the years.

title: Leviticus 25:52
text: And if there remain but few years to the year of jubilee, then he shall count with him, [and] according to his years he shall give him again the price of his redemption.

title: Leviticus 25:53
text: As a yearly hired servant he shall be with him; he shall not rule with harshness in your sight.

title: Leviticus 25:54
text: And if he is not redeemed in this way, then he shall go out in the year of jubilee, he and his sons with him.

title: Leviticus 25:55
text: For to Me the sons of Israel [are] servants. They are My servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt. I [am] the LORD your God.

title: Leviticus 26:1
text: You shall make no idols to yourselves; and you shall not set up for yourselves graven images, or a memorial pillar. And you shall not set up any image of stone in your land in order to bow down to it. For I [am] the LORD your God.

title: Leviticus 26:2
text: You shall keep My sabbaths and revere My sanctuary. I [am] the LORD.

title: Leviticus 26:3
text: If you walk in My statutes and keep My commandments and do them,

title: Leviticus 26:4
text: then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

title: Leviticus 26:5
text: And your threshing shall reach to the vintage, and the vintage shall reach to the sowing time. And you shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

title: Leviticus 26:6
text: And I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down and none shall make [you] afraid. And I will cause evil beasts to cease out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

title: Leviticus 26:7
text: And you shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

title: Leviticus 26:8
text: And five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight. And your enemies shall fall by the sword in front of you.

title: Leviticus 26:9
text: For I will have respect to you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish My covenant with you.

title: Leviticus 26:10
text: And you shall eat of the old provision, and clear away the old because of the new.

title: Leviticus 26:11
text: And I will set My tabernacle among you. And My soul shall not abhor you.

title: Leviticus 26:12
text: And I will walk among you and will be your God, and you shall be My people.

title: Leviticus 26:13
text: I [am] the LORD your God, who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, from being their bondmen. And I have broken the bonds of your yoke, and made you go upright.

title: Leviticus 26:14
text: But if you will not listen to Me, and will not do all these commandments,

title: Leviticus 26:15
text: and if you shall despise My statutes, or if your soul hates My judgments, so that you will not do all My commandments, so that you break My covenant;

title: Leviticus 26:16
text: I will also do this to you: I will even appoint terror over you, consumption, and burning fever, consuming the eyes and causing sorrow of heart. And you shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.

title: Leviticus 26:17
text: And I will set My face against you, and you shall be slain before your enemies. They that hate you shall reign over you. And you shall flee when none pursues you.

title: Leviticus 26:18
text: And if you will not yet listen to Me for all this, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.

title: Leviticus 26:19
text: And I will break the pride of your power, and I will make your heaven like iron and your earth like bronze.

title: Leviticus 26:20
text: And your strength shall be spent in vain. For your land shall not yield its increase, neither shall the trees of the field yield their fruits.

title: Leviticus 26:21
text: And if you walk contrary to Me, and will not listen to Me, I will bring seven times more plagues on you according to your sins.

title: Leviticus 26:22
text: I will also send wild beasts among you, who shall bereave you. And I will destroy your cattle, and make you few. And your highways shall be deserted.

title: Leviticus 26:23
text: And if you will not be reformed by Me by these things, but will still walk contrary to Me,

title: Leviticus 26:24
text: then I will walk contrary to you and will punish you seven [times more] for your sins.

title: Leviticus 26:25
text: And I will bring a sword on you that shall execute the vengeance of the covenant. And when you are gathered inside your cities, I will send the plague among you. And you shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

title: Leviticus 26:26
text: When I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver [you] your bread again by weight. And you shall eat and not be satisfied.

title: Leviticus 26:27
text: And if you will not for all of this listen to Me, but will walk contrary to Me,

title: Leviticus 26:28
text: then I will walk contrary to you also in fury. And I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.

title: Leviticus 26:29
text: And you shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters you shall eat.

title: Leviticus 26:30
text: And I will destroy your high places and cut down your images, and throw your carcasses on the carcasses of your idols, and My soul shall despise you.

title: Leviticus 26:31
text: And I will make your cities waste and cause your sanctuaries to be deserted. And I will not smell the savor of your sweet odors.

title: Leviticus 26:32
text: And I will turn the land into wasteland. And your enemies who dwell in it shall be astonished at it.

title: Leviticus 26:33
text: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you. And your land shall be waste, and your cities waste.

title: Leviticus 26:34
text: Then shall the land enjoy its sabbaths, as long as it lies waste, and [you are] in your enemies' land; then shall the land rest and enjoy its sabbaths.

title: Leviticus 26:35
text: As long as it lies waste it shall rest, because it did not rest in your sabbaths when you lived on it.

title: Leviticus 26:36
text: And on those of you that are left I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. And the sound of a driven leaf shall chase them, and they shall flee as if fleeing from a sword. And they shall fall when none pursues.

title: Leviticus 26:37
text: And they shall fall on one another, as if it were before a sword, when none pursues. And you shall have no power to stand before your enemies.

title: Leviticus 26:38
text: And you shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.

title: Leviticus 26:39
text: And they that are left of you shall putrefy in their wilful sin in your enemies' lands. And also they shall putrefy with them in the perversities of their fathers.

title: Leviticus 26:40
text: If they shall confess their wilfulness and the wilfulness of their fathers, with their sin which they sinned against Me, and that also they have walked contrary to Me--

title: Leviticus 26:41
text: I also have walked contrary to them and have brought them into the land of their enemies. If then their uncircumcised hearts are humbled, and they then pay for their iniquity,

title: Leviticus 26:42
text: then I will remember My covenant with Jacob, and also My covenant with Isaac, and also My covenant with Abraham I will remember. And I will remember the land.

title: Leviticus 26:43
text: The land also shall be forsaken by them, and shall enjoy its sabbaths, while it lies waste without them. And they shall accept the punishment of their iniquities; because, even because they despised My judgments, and because their soul hated My statutes.

title: Leviticus 26:44
text: And yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I hate them, to destroy them utterly and to break My covenant with them. For I [am] the LORD their God.

title: Leviticus 26:45
text: But for their sakes, I will remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, so that I might be their God. I [am] the LORD.

title: Leviticus 26:46
text: These [are] the statutes and judgments and laws, which the Lord made between Him and the sons of Israel in Mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.

title: Leviticus 27:1
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 27:2
text: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, When a man shall make a special vow, the persons [shall be] for the LORD by your evaluation.

title: Leviticus 27:3
text: And your judgment shall be of the male from twenty years old even to sixty years old, even your judgment shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

title: Leviticus 27:4
text: And if it [is] a female, then your judgment shall be thirty shekels.

title: Leviticus 27:5
text: And if from five years old to twenty years old, then your judgment shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

title: Leviticus 27:6
text: And if from a month old to five years old, then your judgment shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female your judgment [shall be] three shekels of silver.

title: Leviticus 27:7
text: And if from sixty years old and above, if it is a male then your judgment shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

title: Leviticus 27:8
text: But if he is poorer than your judgment, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him. The priest shall value him according to the ability of him who vowed.

title: Leviticus 27:9
text: And if [it is] an animal of which they bring an offering to the LORD, all that one gives of such to the LORD shall be holy.

title: Leviticus 27:10
text: He shall not alter it nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good. And if he shall at all change animal for animal, then it and the exchange of it shall be holy.

title: Leviticus 27:11
text: And if [it is] any unclean animal, of which they do not offer a sacrifice to the LORD, then he shall present the animal before the priest.

title: Leviticus 27:12
text: And the priest shall value it, whether it is good or bad. As you the priest value it, so shall it be.

title: Leviticus 27:13
text: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth [part] of it to what you judged.

title: Leviticus 27:14
text: And when a man shall sanctify his house [to be] holy to the LORD, then the priest shall judge it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest shall judge it, so shall it stand.

title: Leviticus 27:15
text: And if he who sanctified it desires to redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth [part] of the silver of your judgment, and it shall be his.

title: Leviticus 27:16
text: And if a man shall sanctify to the LORD [some part] of a field that he owns, then your judgment shall be according to its seed; a homer of barley seed at fifty shekels of silver.

title: Leviticus 27:17
text: If he sanctifies his field from the year of jubilee, according to your judgment it shall stand.

title: Leviticus 27:18
text: But if he sanctifies his field after the jubilee, then the priest shall reckon to him the silver according to the years that remain, even until the year of jubilee, and it shall be taken from your estimation.

title: Leviticus 27:19
text: And if he who sanctified the field desires in any way to redeem it, then he shall add the fifth [part] of the money of your estimation to it, and it shall be made sure to him.

title: Leviticus 27:20
text: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.

title: Leviticus 27:21
text: But the field, when it goes out in the jubilee, shall be holy to the LORD, as a field devoted. The possession of it shall be the priest's.

title: Leviticus 27:22
text: And if [a man] sanctifies to the LORD a field which he has bought, which [is] not of the fields he owns,

title: Leviticus 27:23
text: then the priest shall count to him the worth of your estimation, until the year of jubilee. And he shall give your estimation in that day, a holy thing to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 27:24
text: In the year of the jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought, to him who owns [it in] the land.

title: Leviticus 27:25
text: And all your judgments shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary, twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.

title: Leviticus 27:26
text: However, the first-born of an animal, which should be the LORD's first-born, no man shall sanctify it, whether an ox, or sheep, it is the LORD's.

title: Leviticus 27:27
text: And if [it is] of an unclean animal, then he shall redeem it according to your estimation, and shall add a fifth [part] of it to it. Or if it is not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your estimation.

title: Leviticus 27:28
text: However, no devoted thing that a man shall devote to the LORD of all that he has, either of man or animal, or of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed. Every devoted thing [is] most holy to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 27:29
text: Nothing devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed, [but] shall surely be put to death.

title: Leviticus 27:30
text: And all the tithe of the land, of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, [is] the LORD's. [It is] holy to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 27:31
text: And if a man will at all redeem anything of his tithes, he shall add to it the fifth [part] of it.

title: Leviticus 27:32
text: And all the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, all that passes under the rod, a tenth shall be holy to the LORD

title: Leviticus 27:33
text: He shall not search whether it is good or bad, neither shall he change it. And if he changes it at all, then both it and the change of it shall be holy. It shall not be redeemed.

title: Leviticus 27:34
text: These [are] the commandments which the LORD commanded Moses for the sons of Israel in Mount Sinai.

title: Numbers 1:1
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first [day] of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

title: Numbers 1:2
text: Take the sum of all the congregation of the sons of Israel, according to their families, by their fathers' house, with the number of names, every male by their heads,

title: Numbers 1:3
text: from twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel. You and Aaron shall number them by their armies.

title: Numbers 1:4
text: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe, each one head of the house of his fathers.

title: Numbers 1:5
text: And these [are] the names of the men that shall stand with you: Of Reuben, Elizur, the son of Shedeur;

title: Numbers 1:6
text: Of Simeon, Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai;

title: Numbers 1:7
text: of Judah, Nahshon the son of Amminadab;

title: Numbers 1:8
text: of Issachar, Nethaneel the son of Zuar;

title: Numbers 1:9
text: of Zebulun, Eliab the son of Helon;

title: Numbers 1:10
text: of the sons of Joseph; of Ephraim, Elishama the son of Ammihud; of Manasseh, Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur;

title: Numbers 1:11
text: of Benjamin, Abidan the son of Gideoni;

title: Numbers 1:12
text: of Dan, Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai;

title: Numbers 1:13
text: of Asher, Pagiel the son of Ocran;

title: Numbers 1:14
text: of Gad, Eliasaph the son of Reuel;

title: Numbers 1:15
text: of Naphtali, Ahira the son of Enan.

title: Numbers 1:16
text: These [were] the noted ones of the congregation, rulers of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.

title: Numbers 1:17
text: And Moses and Aaron took these men who are called by name.

title: Numbers 1:18
text: And they gathered all the congregation on the first [day] of the second month. And they declared their pedigrees according to their families, by their fathers' house, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their heads.

title: Numbers 1:19
text: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.

title: Numbers 1:20
text: And the sons of Reuben, Israel's first-born son, by their generations, according to their families, by their fathers' house, according to the number of the names, by their heads, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war:

title: Numbers 1:21
text: those numbered of them, of the tribe of Reuben [were] forty-six thousand, five hundred.

title: Numbers 1:22
text: Of the sons of Simeon, by their generations, according to their families, by their fathers' house, those that were numbered of them, according to the number of the names, by their heads, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war:

title: Numbers 1:23
text: those numbered of them, of the tribe of Simeon, [were] fifty-nine thousand, three hundred.

title: Numbers 1:24
text: Of the sons of Gad, by their generations, according to their families, by their fathers' house, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war:

title: Numbers 1:25
text: those numbered of the tribe of Gad, [were] forty-five thousand, six hundred and fifty.

title: Numbers 1:26
text: Of the sons of Judah, by their generations, according to their families, by their fathers' house, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all able to go forth to war:

title: Numbers 1:27
text: those numbered of them, of the tribe of Judah, [were] seventy-four thousand, six hundred.

title: Numbers 1:28
text: Of the sons of Issachar, by their generations, according to their families, by their fathers' house, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war:

title: Numbers 1:29
text: those numbered of them, of the tribe of Issachar, [were] fifty-four thousand, four hundred.

title: Numbers 1:30
text: Of the sons of Zebulun, by their generations, according to their families, by their fathers' house, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war:

title: Numbers 1:31
text: those numbered of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, [were] fifty-seven thousand, four hundred.

title: Numbers 1:32
text: Of the sons of Joseph, of the sons of Ephraim, by their generations, according to their families, by their fathers' house, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war:

title: Numbers 1:33
text: those numbered of them, of the tribe of Ephraim, [were] forty thousand, five hundred.

title: Numbers 1:34
text: Of the sons of Manasseh, by their generations, according to their families, by their fathers' house, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war:

title: Numbers 1:35
text: those numbered of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, [were] thirty-two thousand, two hundred.

title: Numbers 1:36
text: Of the sons of Benjamin, by their generations, according to their families, by their fathers' house, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war:

title: Numbers 1:37
text: those numbered of them, of the tribe of Benjamin, [were] thirty-five thousand, four hundred.

title: Numbers 1:38
text: Of the sons of Dan, by their generations, according to their families, by their fathers' house, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war:

title: Numbers 1:39
text: those numbered of them, of the tribe of Dan, [were] sixty-two thousand, seven hundred.

title: Numbers 1:40
text: Of the sons of Asher, by their generations, according to their families, by their fathers' house, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war:

title: Numbers 1:41
text: those numbered of them, of the tribe of Asher, [were] forty-one thousand, five hundred.

title: Numbers 1:42
text: Of the sons of Naphtali, by their generations, according to their families, by their fathers' house, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war:

title: Numbers 1:43
text: those were numbered of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, [were] fifty-three thousand, four hundred.

title: Numbers 1:44
text: These are those who were numbered, whom Moses and Aaron numbered, and the rulers of Israel being twelve men. Each one was for the house of his fathers.

title: Numbers 1:45
text: And all those that were numbered of the sons of Israel, by their fathers' house, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel:

title: Numbers 1:46
text: even all those who were numbered were six hundred three thousand, five hundred and fifty.

title: Numbers 1:47
text: But the Levites, according to the tribe of their fathers, were not numbered among them.

title: Numbers 1:48
text: For the LORD had spoken to Moses saying,

title: Numbers 1:49
text: Only you shall not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the sons of Israel.

title: Numbers 1:50
text: But you shall set the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all its vessels, and over all its things. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its vessels. And they shall serve it, and shall camp around the tabernacle.

title: Numbers 1:51
text: And when the tabernacle sets forth, the Levites shall take it down. And when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up. And the stranger who comes near shall be put to death.

title: Numbers 1:52
text: And the sons of Israel shall pitch their tents, each man by his own camp, and each man by his own banner, throughout their armies.

title: Numbers 1:53
text: But the Levites shall pitch around the tabernacle of testimony, so that there may be no wrath upon the congregation of the sons of Israel. And the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.

title: Numbers 1:54
text: And the sons of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses. So they did.

title: Numbers 2:1
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

title: Numbers 2:2
text: Every man of the sons of Israel shall pitch by his own banner, with the banner of their father's house. They shall pitch far off, around the tabernacle of the congregation.

title: Numbers 2:3
text: And those who pitch on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall be those of the banner of the camp of Judah, throughout their armies. And Nahshon the son of Amminadab [shall be] captain of the sons of Judah.

title: Numbers 2:4
text: And his army, and those that were numbered of them, [were] seventy-four thousand, six hundred.

title: Numbers 2:5
text: And those that pitch next to him [shall be] the tribe of Issachar. And Nethaneel the son of Zuar shall be captain of the sons of Issachar.

title: Numbers 2:6
text: And his army, and those that were numbered of them [were] fifty-four thousand, and four hundred.

title: Numbers 2:7
text: And the tribe of Zebulun; the ruler of the sons of Zebulun [shall be] Eliab the son of Helon.

title: Numbers 2:8
text: And his army, and those numbered of them [were] fifty-seven thousand and four hundred.

title: Numbers 2:9
text: All that were numbered of the camp of Judah [were] a hundred and eighty-six thousand and four hundred, by their armies. They shall set forth first.

title: Numbers 2:10
text: On the south side [shall be] the standard of the camp of Reuben, according to their armies; the ruler of the sons of Reuben [shall be] Elizur the son of Shedeur.

title: Numbers 2:11
text: And his army, and those numbered of it, [were] forty-six thousand, five hundred.

title: Numbers 2:12
text: And those who pitch beside him [shall be] the tribe of Simeon. And the captain of the sons of Simeon [shall be] Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

title: Numbers 2:13
text: And his army, and those numbered of them, [were] fifty-nine thousand, three hundred.

title: Numbers 2:14
text: Then the tribe of Gad. And the ruler of the sons of Gad [shall be] Eliasaph the son of Reuel.

title: Numbers 2:15
text: And his army, and those numbered of them, [were] forty-five thousand, six hundred and fifty.

title: Numbers 2:16
text: All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben [were] a hundred fifty-one thousand, four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies. And they shall go forward in the second rank.

title: Numbers 2:17
text: And the tabernacle of the congregation shall go forward with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp. As they camp, so they shall go forward, each man in his place, by their banners.

title: Numbers 2:18
text: On the west side [shall be] the banner of the camp of Ephraim, according to their armies. And the ruler of the sons of Ephraim [shall be] Elishama the son of Ammihud.

title: Numbers 2:19
text: And his army, and those numbered with them, [were] forty thousand, five hundred.

title: Numbers 2:20
text: And beside him [shall be] the tribe of Manasseh. And the ruler of the sons of Manasseh [shall be] Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

title: Numbers 2:21
text: And his army, and those numbered of them, [were] thirty-two thousand, two hundred.

title: Numbers 2:22
text: And the tribe of Benjamin; the ruler of the sons of Benjamin [shall be] Abidan the son of Gideoni.

title: Numbers 2:23
text: And his army, and those numbered of them [were] thirty-five thousand, four hundred.

title: Numbers 2:24
text: All that [were] numbered of the camp of Ephraim were a hundred eight thousand, one hundred, by their armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.

title: Numbers 2:25
text: The banner of the camp of Dan [shall be] on the north side of their armies. And the ruler of the sons of Dan [shall be] Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

title: Numbers 2:26
text: And his army, and those numbered of them, [were] sixty-two thousand, seven hundred.

title: Numbers 2:27
text: And those that camp beside him [shall be] the tribe of Asher. And the ruler of the sons of Asher [shall be] Pagiel the son of Ocran.

title: Numbers 2:28
text: And his army, and those numbered of them, [were] forty-one thousand, five hundred.

title: Numbers 2:29
text: Then the tribe of Naphtali. And the ruler of the sons of Naphtali [shall be] Ahira the son of Enan.

title: Numbers 2:30
text: And his army, and those numbered of them, [were] fifty-three thousand, four hundred.

title: Numbers 2:31
text: All those who [were] numbered in the camp of Dan were a hundred fifty-seven thousand, six hundred. They shall go last with their banners.

title: Numbers 2:32
text: These [are] those numbered of the sons of Israel, by their fathers' house. All those numbered of the camps throughout their armies were six hundred three thousand, five hundred and fifty.

title: Numbers 2:33
text: But the Levites were not numbered among the sons of Israel, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Numbers 2:34
text: And the sons of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses. So they pitched by their banners, and so they went forward, everyone according to their families, according to the house of their fathers.

title: Numbers 3:1
text: These also [are] the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day the LORD spoke with Moses in Mount Sinai.

title: Numbers 3:2
text: And these [are] the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the first-born, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

title: Numbers 3:3
text: These [are] the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests who were anointed, whom he set apart to minister as priests.

title: Numbers 3:4
text: And Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD when they offered strange fire before the LORD in the wilderness of Sinai. And they had no sons. And Eleazar and Ithamar ministered as priest in the presence of Aaron their father.

title: Numbers 3:5
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

title: Numbers 3:6
text: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, so that they may minister to him.

title: Numbers 3:7
text: And they shall keep his charge and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.

title: Numbers 3:8
text: And they shall keep all the vessels of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the sons of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.

title: Numbers 3:9
text: And you shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his son. They [are] wholly given to him out of the sons of Israel.

title: Numbers 3:10
text: And you shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest's office. And the stranger who comes near shall be put to death.

title: Numbers 3:11
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

title: Numbers 3:12
text: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the sons of Israel instead of all the first-born that open the womb among the sons of Israel. Therefore the Levites shall be Mine.

title: Numbers 3:13
text: Because all the first-born [are] Mine. On the day that I struck all the first-born in the land of Egypt I set apart to Myself all the first-born in Israel, both man and animal. They shall be Mine. I [am] the LORD.

title: Numbers 3:14
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai saying,

title: Numbers 3:15
text: Number the sons of Levi according to their fathers' house, by their families. You shall number them, every male from a month old and upward.

title: Numbers 3:16
text: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD, as he was commanded.

title: Numbers 3:17
text: And these were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.

title: Numbers 3:18
text: And these were the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.

title: Numbers 3:19
text: And the sons of Kohath by their families: Amram and Izehar, Hebron and Uzziel.

title: Numbers 3:20
text: And the sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These [were] the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.

title: Numbers 3:21
text: Of Gershon [was] the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites. These [are] the families of the Gershonites.

title: Numbers 3:22
text: Those who were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward; those numbered of them [were] seven thousand, five hundred.

title: Numbers 3:23
text: The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.

title: Numbers 3:24
text: And the ruler of the house of the father of the Gershonites [shall be] Eliasaph the son of Lael.

title: Numbers 3:25
text: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation [shall be] the tabernacle, and the tent, and its covering, and the veil for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,

title: Numbers 3:26
text: and the hangings of the court, and the veil for the door of the court which [is] by the tabernacle and by the altar all around, and the cords of it, for all the service of it.

title: Numbers 3:27
text: And of Kohath [was] the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites. These were the families of the Kohathites.

title: Numbers 3:28
text: In number, all the males, from a month old and upward, [were] eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.

title: Numbers 3:29
text: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.

title: Numbers 3:30
text: And the ruler of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites [shall be] Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

title: Numbers 3:31
text: And their charge [shall be] the ark, and the table, and the lampstand, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary with which they minister, and the veil, and all the service of it.

title: Numbers 3:32
text: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest [shall be] chief over the leaders of the Levites, having the oversight of the ones who keep the charge of the sanctuary.

title: Numbers 3:33
text: Of Merari [was] the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites. These [are] the families of Merari.

title: Numbers 3:34
text: And those numbered of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, [were] six thousand and two hundred.

title: Numbers 3:35
text: And the ruler of the house of the father of the families of Merari [was] Zuriel the son of Abihail. They pitched on the side of the tabernacle northward.

title: Numbers 3:36
text: And the office and charge of the sons of Merari [were] the boards of the tabernacle, and its bars, and its pillars, and its sockets, and its vessels, and all its service,

title: Numbers 3:37
text: and the pillars of the court all around, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.

title: Numbers 3:38
text: And those who camp before the tabernacle toward the east, before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, [shall be] Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the sons of Israel. And the stranger that comes near shall be put to death.

title: Numbers 3:39
text: All who were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron numbered at the command of the LORD, throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, [were] twenty-two thousand.

title: Numbers 3:40
text: And the LORD said to Moses, Number all the first-born of the males of the sons of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.

title: Numbers 3:41
text: You shall take the Levites for Me, I [am] the LORD, in the place of all the first-born among the sons of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the sons of Israel.

title: Numbers 3:42
text: And as the LORD commanded him, Moses numbered all the first-born among the sons of Israel.

title: Numbers 3:43
text: And all the first-born males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those numbered of them, [were] twenty-two thousand two hundred and seventy-three.

title: Numbers 3:44
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

title: Numbers 3:45
text: Take the Levites instead of all the first-born among the sons of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle. And the Levites shall be Mine. I [am] the LORD.

title: Numbers 3:46
text: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and seventy-three of the first-born of the sons of Israel, who are more than the Levites,

title: Numbers 3:47
text: you shall even take five shekels each by the head, according to the shekel of the sanctuary you shall take. (The shekel [is] twenty gerahs.)

title: Numbers 3:48
text: And you shall give to Aaron, and to his sons, the silver of the redeemed left over among them.

title: Numbers 3:49
text: And Moses took the redemption silver from those who were over and above the ones who were redeemed by the Levites.

title: Numbers 3:50
text: He took the silver from the first-born of the sons of Israel: one thousand three hundred and sixty-five [shekels], according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

title: Numbers 3:51
text: And Moses gave the silver from those who were redeemed to Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Numbers 4:1
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

title: Numbers 4:2
text: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, according to their families, by their fathers' house,

title: Numbers 4:3
text: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years, all that enter into the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.

title: Numbers 4:4
text: This [shall be] the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, the most holy [place].

title: Numbers 4:5
text: And when the camp sets forth, Aaron and his sons shall come, and they shall take down the covering veil and cover the ark of testimony with it.

title: Numbers 4:6
text: And they shall put on it the covering of dugong skins, and shall spread over [it] a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in its staves.

title: Numbers 4:7
text: And they shall spread a cloth of blue upon the table of showbread, and put the dishes on it, and the spoons, and the bowls, and the cups of the drink offering, and covers to cover it with. And the continual bread shall be on it.

title: Numbers 4:8
text: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet and cover it with a covering of dugong skins, and they shall put in its staves.

title: Numbers 4:9
text: And they shall take a cloth of blue and cover the lampstand of the light, and its lamps, and its tongs, and its fire-pans, and all the oil vessels of it, with which they serve it.

title: Numbers 4:10
text: And they shall put it and all the vessels of it inside a covering of dugong skins, and shall put [it] upon a bar.

title: Numbers 4:11
text: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers' skins, and they shall put the staves into it.

title: Numbers 4:12
text: And they shall take all the vessels of ministry with which they serve in the sanctuary, and put [them] in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of dugong skins, and shall put them on a bar.

title: Numbers 4:13
text: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth on it.

title: Numbers 4:14
text: And they shall put on it all its vessels, with which they minister about it: the fire-pans, the flesh-hooks, and the shovels, and the basins, all the vessels of the altar. And they shall spread upon it a covering of dugong skins, and put the staves into it.

title: Numbers 4:15
text: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, when the camp is to set forward, then after that the sons of Kohath shall come to carry [it]. But they shall not touch any holy thing lest they die. These [are] the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.

title: Numbers 4:16
text: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest [belongs] the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily food offering, and the anointing oil, the oversight of all the tabernacle and of all that is in it, in the sanctuary and in its vessels.

title: Numbers 4:17
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

title: Numbers 4:18
text: Do not cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites.

title: Numbers 4:19
text: But do this to them, and they shall live and not die when they approach the Holy of Holies. Aaron and his sons shall go in and appoint each one of them to his service and to his burden.

title: Numbers 4:20
text: But they shall not go in to watch when the holy things are covered, lest they die.

title: Numbers 4:21
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 4:22
text: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon throughout the houses of their fathers by their families.

title: Numbers 4:23
text: From thirty years old and upward to fifty years old you shall number them, all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.

title: Numbers 4:24
text: This [is] the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve and to carry burdens.

title: Numbers 4:25
text: And they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, its covering, and the covering of the dugong skins that [is] above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,

title: Numbers 4:26
text: and the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which [is] by the tabernacle and by the altar all around, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them. So they shall serve.

title: Numbers 4:27
text: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens and in all their service. And you shall appoint all their burdens to the ones in charge.

title: Numbers 4:28
text: This [is] the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation. And their charge [shall be] under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

title: Numbers 4:29
text: You shall number the sons of Merari according to their families, by the house of their fathers.

title: Numbers 4:30
text: You shall number them from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who enters into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.

title: Numbers 4:31
text: And this [is] the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation: the boards of the tabernacle, and its bars, and its pillars, and its sockets,

title: Numbers 4:32
text: and the pillars of the court all around, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their vessels, and with all their service. And you shall count the vessels of the charge of their burden by name.

title: Numbers 4:33
text: This [is] the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

title: Numbers 4:34
text: And Moses and Aaron and the leaders of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites according to their families, and according to the house of their fathers.

title: Numbers 4:35
text: They numbered them from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone that entered into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.

title: Numbers 4:36
text: And those numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.

title: Numbers 4:37
text: These [were] the ones that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

title: Numbers 4:38
text: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon throughout their families, and by their fathers' house,

title: Numbers 4:39
text: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone that enters into the service for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,

title: Numbers 4:40
text: even those that were numbered of them by their families, by their fathers' house, were two thousand six hundred and thirty.

title: Numbers 4:41
text: These [are] the ones numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the command of the LORD.

title: Numbers 4:42
text: And those numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, throughout their families, by their fathers' house,

title: Numbers 4:43
text: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone that enters into the service for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,

title: Numbers 4:44
text: even those numbered of them according to their families, were three thousand, two hundred.

title: Numbers 4:45
text: These [are] those numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

title: Numbers 4:46
text: All those numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the rulers of Israel numbered, according to their families and according to their fathers' house,

title: Numbers 4:47
text: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone that came to do the service of the ministry and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation,

title: Numbers 4:48
text: even those numbered of them were eight thousand, five hundred and eighty.

title: Numbers 4:49
text: According to the command of the LORD they were numbered by the hand of Moses, everyone according to his service and according to his burden. So they were numbered by him as the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Numbers 5:1
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 5:2
text: Command the sons of Israel that they put out of the camp every leper and everyone that has an issue, and whoever is defiled by a dead body.

title: Numbers 5:3
text: You shall put out both male and female. You shall put them outside the camp so that they do not defile their camps in the midst of which I dwell.

title: Numbers 5:4
text: And the sons of Israel did so, and put them out outside the camp. Even as the LORD spoke to Moses, so the sons of Israel did.

title: Numbers 5:5
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 5:6
text: Speak to the sons of Israel: When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to commit a trespass against the LORD, and that person is guilty,

title: Numbers 5:7
text: then they shall confess their sin which they have done. And he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, and add to it one fifth of it, and give [it] to him against whom he has sinned.

title: Numbers 5:8
text: But if the man has no kinsman to whom he may make restitution for the guilt, the guilt which is restored [shall be] given to the LORD, to the priest, besides the ram of the atonement by which an atonement shall be made for him.

title: Numbers 5:9
text: And every offering of all the holy things of the sons of Israel which they shall bring to the priest, shall be his.

title: Numbers 5:10
text: And every man's devoted things shall be his. Whatever any man gives the priest, it shall be his.

title: Numbers 5:11
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 5:12
text: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, If any man's wife goes astray, and has committed a trespass against him,

title: Numbers 5:13
text: and a man lie with her carnally, and if it is hidden from the eyes of her husband and is kept hidden, and she is defiled, and [there is] no witness against her, neither is she taken in the act;

title: Numbers 5:14
text: and if the spirit of jealousy comes upon him and he is jealous of his wife, and she is defiled-- or if the spirit of jealousy comes upon him and he is jealous of his wife, and she is not defiled--

title: Numbers 5:15
text: then the man shall bring his wife to the priest. And he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth of an ephah of barley meal. He shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense on it, for it [is] an offering of jealousy, a reminding offering, bringing iniquity to mind.

title: Numbers 5:16
text: And the priest shall bring her near and set her before the LORD.

title: Numbers 5:17
text: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel. And the priest shall take of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle and put [it] into the water.

title: Numbers 5:18
text: And the priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and uncover the woman's head, and put the reminding offering in her hands, which [is] the jealousy offering. And the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causes the curse.

title: Numbers 5:19
text: And the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say to the woman, If no man has lain with you, and if you have not gone aside to uncleanness, being under your husband, you are free from this bitter water that causes the curse.

title: Numbers 5:20
text: But if you have gone aside, being under your husband, and if you are defiled and some man besides your husband has given his semen to you,

title: Numbers 5:21
text: then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing. And the priest shall say to the woman, The LORD make you a curse and an oath among your people, when the LORD makes your thigh to fall away and your belly to swell.

title: Numbers 5:22
text: And this water that causes the curse shall go into your bowels to make [your] belly swell and your thigh fall away. And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.

title: Numbers 5:23
text: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot [them] out with the bitter water.

title: Numbers 5:24
text: And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causes the curse. And the water that causes the curse shall enter into her [and become] bitter.

title: Numbers 5:25
text: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman's hand and shall wave the offering before the LORD, and offer it upon the altar.

title: Numbers 5:26
text: And the priest shall take a handful of the offering, as a memorial of it, and burn [it] upon the altar, and afterward [he] shall cause the woman to drink the water.

title: Numbers 5:27
text: And when he has made her drink the water, then it shall be, if she is defiled and has committed a trespass against to her husband, the water that causes the curse shall enter into her and [become bitter]. And her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall fall away. And the woman shall be a curse among her people.

title: Numbers 5:28
text: And if the woman is not defiled, but is clean, then she shall be clean, and shall conceive seed.

title: Numbers 5:29
text: This [is] the law of jealousies when a woman goes aside, being under her husband, and is defiled.

title: Numbers 5:30
text: Or when the spirit of jealousy comes on a man, and he is jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.

title: Numbers 5:31
text: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and the woman shall bear her iniquity.

title: Numbers 6:1
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 6:2
text: Speak to the sons of Israel, and say to them, When a man or woman shall separate in order to vow a vow of a Nazarite, in order to separate to the LORD,

title: Numbers 6:3
text: he shall separate from wine and strong drink and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink; neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes or dried.

title: Numbers 6:4
text: All the days of his Nazariteship he shall eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.

title: Numbers 6:5
text: All the days of his vow to separate, no razor shall come upon his head. Until all the days are fulfilled in which he separates to the LORD, he shall be holy. He shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.

title: Numbers 6:6
text: All the days that he separates to the LORD, he shall not come near any dead body.

title: Numbers 6:7
text: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, or for his brother, or for his sister, when they die, because his separation to his God [is] upon his head.

title: Numbers 6:8
text: All the days of his separation he [is] holy to the LORD.

title: Numbers 6:9
text: And if any man dies very suddenly beside him, and he has defiled the head of his consecration, then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day he shall shave it.

title: Numbers 6:10
text: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtle-doves or two young pigeons to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

title: Numbers 6:11
text: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, because he sinned by the dead, and shall make his head holy that same day.

title: Numbers 6:12
text: And he shall set apart to the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a guilt offering. But the former days shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.

title: Numbers 6:13
text: And this [is] the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled. He shall be brought to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

title: Numbers 6:14
text: And he shall offer his offering to the LORD: one male lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for peace offerings,

title: Numbers 6:15
text: and a basket of unleavened cakes of fine flour, cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and their food offerings and their drink offerings.

title: Numbers 6:16
text: And the priest shall bring [them] before the LORD and shall offer his sin offering and his burnt offering.

title: Numbers 6:17
text: And he shall offer the ram [for] a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, with the basket of unleavened bread. The priest shall offer also his food offering and his drink offering.

title: Numbers 6:18
text: And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation and put [it] in the fire under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.

title: Numbers 6:19
text: And the priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put [them] on the hands of the Nazarite, after his separation has been shaved.

title: Numbers 6:20
text: And the priest shall wave them [for] a wave offering before the LORD. This [is] holy for the priest, with the wave breast and heave shoulder. And afterward the Nazarite may drink wine.

title: Numbers 6:21
text: This [is] the law of the Nazarite who has vowed his offering to the LORD for his separation, besides that which he is able to get. According to the vow which he vowed, so he must do according to the law of his separation.

title: Numbers 6:22
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 6:23
text: Speak to Aaron and to his sons saying, In this way you shall bless the sons of Israel, saying to them,

title: Numbers 6:24
text: The LORD bless you and keep you.

title: Numbers 6:25
text: The LORD make His face shine upon you and be gracious to you.

title: Numbers 6:26
text: The LORD lift up His face to you and give you peace.

title: Numbers 6:27
text: And they shall put My name upon the sons of Israel. And I, I will bless them.

title: Numbers 7:1
text: And it happened on the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it and sanctified it, and all the vessels of it, both the altar and all its vessels, and had anointed them and sanctified them,

title: Numbers 7:2
text: and the rulers of Israel offered, the head men of their fathers' house, the rulers of the tribes; these [were] they who stood over the numbered ones.

title: Numbers 7:3
text: And they brought their offerings before the LORD: six covered wagons and twelve oxen, a wagon for two of the rulers, an ox for each one. And they brought them before the tabernacle.

title: Numbers 7:4
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

title: Numbers 7:5
text: Take [it] from them so that they may be used in doing the service of the tabernacle of the congregation. And you shall give them to the Levites, to every man according to his service.

title: Numbers 7:6
text: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen and gave them to the Levites.

title: Numbers 7:7
text: He gave two wagons and four oxen to the sons of Gershon, according to their service.

title: Numbers 7:8
text: And he gave four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the hand of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

title: Numbers 7:9
text: But to the sons of Kohath he did not give any, because the service of the sanctuary belonging to them [was that] which they should carry upon their shoulders.

title: Numbers 7:10
text: And the rulers offered for the dedication of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the rulers offered their offering before the altar.

title: Numbers 7:11
text: And the LORD said to Moses, They shall offer their offering, each ruler on his day, for the dedication of the altar.

title: Numbers 7:12
text: And he that offered his offering the first day [was] Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah.

title: Numbers 7:13
text: And his offering [was] one silver dish, and its weight hundred and thirty [shekels]; one silver basin of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a food offering;

title: Numbers 7:14
text: one golden pan [of] ten [shekels] full of incense;

title: Numbers 7:15
text: one young bull, one ram, one lamb of the first year for a burnt offering;

title: Numbers 7:16
text: one male of the goats for a sin offering;

title: Numbers 7:17
text: and for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five lambs of the first year. This [was] the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

title: Numbers 7:18
text: On the second day Nethaneel the son of Zuar, ruler of Issachar, offered.

title: Numbers 7:19
