text: And I spoke to you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you by myself.

title: Deuteronomy 1:10
text: Jehovah your God has multiplied you, and, behold, today you [are] as the stars of heaven for multitude.

title: Deuteronomy 1:11
text: May the LORD, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times more than you [are], and bless you as He has said to you!

title: Deuteronomy 1:12
text: How can I by myself bear your pressure and your burden and your strife?

title: Deuteronomy 1:13
text: Give wise and understanding men, and [those] known to your tribes, and I will appoint them rulers over you.

title: Deuteronomy 1:14
text: And you answered me and said, The thing which you have spoken [is] good to do.

title: Deuteronomy 1:15
text: And I took the chiefs of your tribes, wise and noted men, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.

title: Deuteronomy 1:16
text: And I commanded your judges at that time saying, Hear [the causes] between your brothers, and judge righteously between a man and his brother, and the stranger with him.

title: Deuteronomy 1:17
text: You shall not respect persons in judgment. You shall hear the small as well as the great. You shall not be afraid of the face of man, for the judgment [is] God's. And the cause that is too hard for you, bring to me, and I will hear it.

title: Deuteronomy 1:18
text: And I commanded you at that time all the things which you should do.

title: Deuteronomy 1:19
text: And when we pulled up from Horeb, we went [through] all that great and terrible wilderness which you saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us. And we came to Kadesh-barnea.

title: Deuteronomy 1:20
text: And I said to you, You have come to the mountain of the Amorites, which the LORD our God has given unto us.

title: Deuteronomy 1:21
text: Behold, the LORD your God has set the land before you. Go up. Possess [it], even as the LORD God of your fathers has said to you. Do not fear, neither be troubled.

title: Deuteronomy 1:22
text: And you came near to me, every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search out the land and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.

title: Deuteronomy 1:23
text: And the saying pleased me very much. And I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe.

title: Deuteronomy 1:24
text: And they turned and went up into the mountain and came to the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.

title: Deuteronomy 1:25
text: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought [it] down to us, and brought us word again and said, It is a good land which the LORD our God gives us.

title: Deuteronomy 1:26
text: But you would not go up, but rebelled against the command of the LORD your God.

title: Deuteronomy 1:27
text: And you murmured in your tents and said, Because the LORD hates us, He has brought us forth out of the land of Egypt to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.

title: Deuteronomy 1:28
text: Where [shall] we go up? Our brothers have broken our heart, saying, We have seen there a people greater and taller than we [are]. The cities are great and walled up to the heavens, also the sons of the giants.

title: Deuteronomy 1:29
text: Then I said to you, Do not dread them nor be afraid of them.

title: Deuteronomy 1:30
text: The LORD your God who goes before you shall fight for you, according to all that He did for you in Egypt before your eyes,

title: Deuteronomy 1:31
text: and in the wilderness where you have seen how the LORD your God carried you, as a man carries his son, in all the way that you went until you came into this place.

title: Deuteronomy 1:32
text: Yet in this thing you did not believe the LORD your God,

title: Deuteronomy 1:33
text: who went in the way before you to search you out a place to pitch your tents, in fire by night, to show you by what way you should go, and in a cloud by day.

title: Deuteronomy 1:34
text: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, and was angry and swore, saying,

title: Deuteronomy 1:35
text: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I swore to give to your fathers,

title: Deuteronomy 1:36
text: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him I will give the land that he has trodden upon, and to his sons, because he has fully followed the LORD.

title: Deuteronomy 1:37
text: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, You also shall not go in there.

title: Deuteronomy 1:38
text: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, he shall go in there. Make him strong, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

title: Deuteronomy 1:39
text: And your little ones, who you said would be a prey, and your sons who in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in there. And I will give it to them, and they shall possess it.

title: Deuteronomy 1:40
text: But you turn and pull up into the wilderness by the way of the Red Sea.

title: Deuteronomy 1:41
text: And you answered and said to me, We have sinned against the LORD; we will go up and fight according to all that the LORD our God commanded us. And when each one of you had buckled on his weapons of war, you were ready to go up into the hill.

title: Deuteronomy 1:42
text: But the LORD said to me, Say to them, Do not go up, nor fight, for I [am] not among you, you will be beaten by your enemies.

title: Deuteronomy 1:43
text: So I spoke to you. And you would not hear, but rebelled against the command of the LORD, and went presumptuously into the hill.

title: Deuteronomy 1:44
text: And the Amorites who lived in that mountain came out against you and chased you, even as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, to Hormah.

title: Deuteronomy 1:45
text: And you returned and wept before the LORD. But the LORD would not listen to your voice, nor give ear to you.

title: Deuteronomy 1:46
text: So you stayed in Kadesh many days, according to the days that you remained.

title: Deuteronomy 2:1
text: Then we turned and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red Sea, as the LORD spoke to me. And we went around Mount Seir many days.

title: Deuteronomy 2:2
text: And the LORD spoke to me, saying,

title: Deuteronomy 2:3
text: You have gone around this mountain long enough. Turn northward.

title: Deuteronomy 2:4
text: And command the people saying, You [are] to pass through the border of your brothers, the sons of Esau, who dwell in Seir. And they shall be afraid of you. Therefore be careful.

title: Deuteronomy 2:5
text: Do not meddle with them, for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a foot breadth, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau [for] a possession.

title: Deuteronomy 2:6
text: You shall buy food from them for silver, so that you may eat. And you shall also buy water from them for silver, so that you may drink.

title: Deuteronomy 2:7
text: For the LORD your God has blessed you in all the works of your hand. He knows your walking [through] this great wilderness. The LORD your God [has been] with you these forty years. You have lacked nothing.

title: Deuteronomy 2:8
text: And when we left our brothers the sons of Esau who lived in Seir, through the way of the Arabah from Elath, and from Ezion-geber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.

title: Deuteronomy 2:9
text: And the LORD said to me, Do not besiege Moab, nor fight with them in battle. For I will not give you any of their land [for] a possession. Because I have given Ar to the sons of Lot [for] a possession.

title: Deuteronomy 2:10
text: The Emim lived there in times past, a great people, who were many and tall like the Anakim.

title: Deuteronomy 2:11
text: And they were known as giants, like the sons of Anak, but the Moabites called them Emim.

title: Deuteronomy 2:12
text: The Horim also lived in Seir in times past. But the sons of Esau took their place when they had destroyed them from before them, and lived in their place; as Israel did to the land of his possession, which the LORD gave to them.

title: Deuteronomy 2:13
text: Now rise up and cross over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.

title: Deuteronomy 2:14
text: And the days in which we came from Kadesh-barnea, until we had come over the brook Zered [were] thirty-eight years; until the end of all the generation. The men of war [were] destroyed from the midst of the camp, as the LORD swore to them.

title: Deuteronomy 2:15
text: And the hand of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from among the camp, until they were consumed.

title: Deuteronomy 2:16
text: And it happened, when all the men of war had finished dying from among the people,

title: Deuteronomy 2:17
text: the LORD spoke to me, saying,

title: Deuteronomy 2:18
text: today you are to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab.

title: Deuteronomy 2:19
text: And when you come near, across from the sons of Ammon, do not trouble them nor be stirred up against them. For I will not give you [any] possessions from the land of the sons of Ammon, because I have given it to the sons of Lot [for]  a possession.

title: Deuteronomy 2:20
text: It also was known to be a land of giants. Giants lived there in past times. And the Ammonites call them Zamzumim,

title: Deuteronomy 2:21
text: a great and plentiful people, and tall, like the sons of Anak, but the LORD destroyed them before them. And they expelled them and lived in their place,

title: Deuteronomy 2:22
text: as He did to the sons of Esau who lived in Seir, when he destroyed the Horim from before them. And they expelled them and lived in their place even to this day.

title: Deuteronomy 2:23
text: And the Avvim who lived in villages as far as Azzah, the Caphtorites, who came forth out of Caphtor destroyed them, and lived in their place.

title: Deuteronomy 2:24
text: Rise up, set out and cross over the river Arnon. Behold! I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite king of Heshbon, and his land. Begin to possess, and fight with him in battle.

title: Deuteronomy 2:25
text: Today, I will begin to put your dread and your fear upon the nations under the whole heavens; who shall hear report of you, and shall tremble and be in anguish because of you.

title: Deuteronomy 2:26
text: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon [with] words of peace, saying,

title: Deuteronomy 2:27
text: Let me pass through your land. I will go along by the highway. I will neither turn [to] the right hand nor to the left.

title: Deuteronomy 2:28
text: You shall sell me food for silver, so that I may eat, and give me water for silver so that I may drink. Only I will pass through on my feet,

title: Deuteronomy 2:29
text: as the sons of Esau who live in Seir, and the Moabites who live in Ar, did to me, until I shall cross over Jordan into the land which the LORD our God gives us.

title: Deuteronomy 2:30
text: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him. For the LORD your God hardened his spirit and made his heart stubborn so that He might deliver him into your hand, as [it is] this day.

title: Deuteronomy 2:31
text: And the LORD said to me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before you. Begin to possess it so that you may inherit his land.

title: Deuteronomy 2:32
text: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.

title: Deuteronomy 2:33
text: And the LORD our God delivered him before us. And we struck him and his sons and all his people.

title: Deuteronomy 2:34
text: And we took all his cities at that time and completely destroyed the men and the women and the little ones of every city. We left none to remain.

title: Deuteronomy 2:35
text: Only we plundered the cattle for ourselves, and we took the spoil of the cities.

title: Deuteronomy 2:36
text: From Aroer, by the brink of the river of Arnon, and the city by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us. The LORD our God delivered all to us.

title: Deuteronomy 2:37
text: Only to the land of the sons of Ammon you did not come, to any place of the river Jabbok, nor to the cities in the mountains, nor to whatever the LORD our God denied us.

title: Deuteronomy 3:1
text: And we turned and went up the way to Bashan. And Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle [at] Edrei.

title: Deuteronomy 3:2
text: And the LORD said to me, Do not fear him, for I will deliver him and all his people, and his land, into your hand. And you shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.

title: Deuteronomy 3:3
text: So the LORD our God delivered Og into our hands also, the king of Bashan, and all his people. And we struck him until none [was] left remaining to him.

title: Deuteronomy 3:4
text: And we took all his cities at that time. There was not a city which we did not take from them, sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

title: Deuteronomy 3:5
text: All these cities [were] fortified with high walls, gates, and bars; besides a good many unwalled towns.

title: Deuteronomy 3:6
text: And we completely destroyed them, as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, completely destroying the men, women, and children of every city.

title: Deuteronomy 3:7
text: But we took the cattle and the spoil of the cities as a prize for ourselves.

title: Deuteronomy 3:8
text: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon to Mount Hermon,

title: Deuteronomy 3:9
text: (the Hermon [which] the Sidonians call Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir).

title: Deuteronomy 3:10
text: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, and Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan [were taken].

title: Deuteronomy 3:11
text: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the rest of the giants. Behold! His bedstead [was] a bedstead of iron. Is it not in Rabbath of the sons of Ammon? Nine cubits [was] its length, and four cubits its width, according to the cubit of a man.

title: Deuteronomy 3:12
text: And this is the land [which] we possessed at that time, from Aroer by the river Arnon, and half of Mount Gilead, and its cities, I gave to the men of Reuben and of Gad.

title: Deuteronomy 3:13
text: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half tribe of Manasseh, all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.

title: Deuteronomy 3:14
text: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob to the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi. And he called them after his own name, Bashan (Towns of Jair) to this day.

title: Deuteronomy 3:15
text: And I gave Gilead to Machir.

title: Deuteronomy 3:16
text: And to the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead even to the river Arnon, half the valley, and the border even to the river Jabbok, the border of the sons of Ammon,

title: Deuteronomy 3:17
text: the plain also, and Jordan, and its border, from Chinnereth even to the sea of the plain, the Salt Sea, under The Slopes of Pisgah eastward.

title: Deuteronomy 3:18
text: And I commanded you at that time saying, The LORD your God has given you this land to possess it. You shall pass over armed before your brothers the sons of Israel, all the sons of might.

title: Deuteronomy 3:19
text: But your wives and your little ones, and your cattle, (I know that you have much cattle), shall stay in your cities which I have given you

title: Deuteronomy 3:20
text: until the LORD has given rest to your brothers, as well as to you, and they also possess the land which the LORD your God [has] given them beyond Jordan. And then you shall each one return to his possessions which I have given you.

title: Deuteronomy 3:21
text: And I commanded Joshua at that time saying, Your eyes have seen all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings. So the LORD shall do to all the kingdoms where you pass.

title: Deuteronomy 3:22
text: You shall not fear them. For the LORD your God shall fight for you.

title: Deuteronomy 3:23
text: And I begged the LORD at that time saying,

title: Deuteronomy 3:24
text: O, LORD God, You have begun to show Your servant Your greatness, and Your mighty hand. For what God [is there] in heaven or in earth who can do according to Your works, and according to Your might?

title: Deuteronomy 3:25
text: I pray you, let me go over and see the good land beyond Jordan, this good hill-country and Lebanon.

title: Deuteronomy 3:26
text: But the LORD was angry with me because of you and would not hear me. And the LORD said to me, [Let it be] enough for you. Speak no more to Me of this matter.

title: Deuteronomy 3:27
text: Go up into the top of Pisgah and lift up your eyes westward and northward and southward and eastward, and behold [it] with your eyes. For you shall not go over this Jordan.

title: Deuteronomy 3:28
text: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him. For he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see.

title: Deuteronomy 3:29
text: So we stayed in the valley over against Beth-peor.

title: Deuteronomy 4:1
text: And now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the judgments which I teach you, in order to do them, so that you may live and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers gives you.

title: Deuteronomy 4:2
text: You shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall you take away from it, so that you may keep the commands of the LORD your God which I command you.

title: Deuteronomy 4:3
text: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baal-peor. For the LORD your God has destroyed from among you all the men that followed Baal-peor.

title: Deuteronomy 4:4
text: And you who held fast to the LORD your God [are] alive, every one of you, this day.

title: Deuteronomy 4:5
text: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the LORD my God commanded me, so that you should do so in the land where you go to possess it.

title: Deuteronomy 4:6
text: And you shall keep and do [them], for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes and say, Surely this great nation [is] a wise and understanding people.

title: Deuteronomy 4:7
text: For who is a great nation whose God [is] coming near to them, as Jehovah our God [is], in all our calling on him?

title: Deuteronomy 4:8
text: And who is a great nation whose statutes and judgments [are so] righteous as all this law which I set before you today?

title: Deuteronomy 4:9
text: Only take heed to yourself and keep your soul carefully, lest you forget the things which your eyes have seen, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life. But teach them to your sons, and your sons' sons.

title: Deuteronomy 4:10
text: Remember the day that you stood before the LORD your God in Horeb, when the LORD said to me, Gather the people to Me, and I will make them hear My words so that they may learn to fear Me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and they may teach their sons.

title: Deuteronomy 4:11
text: And you came near and stood under the mountain. And the mountain burned with fire to the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.

title: Deuteronomy 4:12
text: And the LORD spoke to you out of the midst of the fire. You heard the voice of the words, but saw no likeness, only a voice.

title: Deuteronomy 4:13
text: And He declared to you His covenant which He commanded you to perform, ten commandments. And He wrote them on two tablets of stone.

title: Deuteronomy 4:14
text: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments so that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it.

title: Deuteronomy 4:15
text: Therefore take good heed to yourselves, for you saw no kind of likeness on the day the LORD spoke to you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire,

title: Deuteronomy 4:16
text: lest you act corruptly and make yourselves a graven image, the likeness of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

title: Deuteronomy 4:17
text: the likeness of any beast on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flies in the air,

title: Deuteronomy 4:18
text: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish in the waters beneath the earth;

title: Deuteronomy 4:19
text: and lest you lift up your eyes to the heavens, and when you see the sun, and the moon, and the stars, all the host of heaven, lest you should be driven to worship them and serve them, which the LORD your God has allotted to all nations under all the heavens.

title: Deuteronomy 4:20
text: But the LORD has taken you and brought you out from the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to Him a people of inheritance, as [you are] today.

title: Deuteronomy 4:21
text: And the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in to that good land which the LORD your God gives you [for] an inheritance.

title: Deuteronomy 4:22
text: But I must die in this land; I must not go over Jordan. But you [shall] go over and possess that good land.

title: Deuteronomy 4:23
text: Take heed to yourselves, lest you forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which He made with you, and make you a graven image, a likeness of anything which the LORD your God has forbidden you.

title: Deuteronomy 4:24
text: For the LORD your God [is] a consuming fire, a jealous God.

title: Deuteronomy 4:25
text: When you father sons and sons of sons, and when you shall have remained long in the land and have dealt corruptly by making a graven image, the likeness of any, and shall do evil in the sight of the LORD your God, to provoke Him to anger,

title: Deuteronomy 4:26
text: I call Heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that you shall soon utterly perish from off the land which you are crossing over Jordan to possess. You shall not prolong [your] days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.

title: Deuteronomy 4:27
text: And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and you shall be left few in number among the nations where the LORD shall drive you.

title: Deuteronomy 4:28
text: And there you shall serve gods, the work of men's hands, wood and stone, which neither see nor hear nor eat nor smell.

title: Deuteronomy 4:29
text: But if you shall seek the LORD your God from there, you shall find [Him], if you seek Him with all your heart and with all your soul.

title: Deuteronomy 4:30
text: When you are in trouble and when all these things have found you in the latter days, then you shall return to the LORD your God and shall be obedient to His voice.

title: Deuteronomy 4:31
text: For the LORD your God [is] a merciful God; He will not forsake you, nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which He swore to them.

title: Deuteronomy 4:32
text: For ask now of the days past which were before you, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and from the one end of the heavens to the other end of the heavens, where there has been a thing as great as this, or has been heard any like it.

title: Deuteronomy 4:33
text: Did people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire as you have heard and live?

title: Deuteronomy 4:34
text: Or has God gone forth to take a nation for himself from the midst of a nation, by trials, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

title: Deuteronomy 4:35
text: It was shown to you so that you might know that Jehovah [is] God, [and] no one else beside Him.

title: Deuteronomy 4:36
text: He made you hear His voice out of Heaven so that He might teach you. And He showed you His great fire upon earth. And you heard His words out of the midst of the fire.

title: Deuteronomy 4:37
text: And because He loved your fathers, therefore He chose their seed after them, and brought you out in His sight with His mighty power out of Egypt,

title: Deuteronomy 4:38
text: in order to drive out from before you nations greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as [it is] this day.

title: Deuteronomy 4:39
text: Therefore, know this day and consider within your heart, that the LORD [is] God in Heaven above and on the earth beneath. There is no other.

title: Deuteronomy 4:40
text: Therefore, you shall keep His statutes and His commandments which I command you this day, so that it may go well with you and with your sons after you, and so that you may make your days longer upon the earth which the LORD your God gives you forever.

title: Deuteronomy 4:41
text: Then Moses separated three cities on this side Jordan towards the sunrise,

title: Deuteronomy 4:42
text: so that the slayer might flee there, he who should kill his neighbor through error and who did not hate him [in] times past, and he fleeing to one of these cities might live.

title: Deuteronomy 4:43
text: They were Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, for the Manassites.

title: Deuteronomy 4:44
text: And this [is] the law which Moses set before the sons of Israel.

title: Deuteronomy 4:45
text: These [are] the testimonies and the statutes and the judgments which Moses spoke to the sons of Israel after they came forth out of Egypt,

title: Deuteronomy 4:46
text: beyond Jordan, in the valley over against Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon, whom Moses and the sons of Israel killed, after they had come forth out of Egypt.

title: Deuteronomy 4:47
text: And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, who [were] on this side Jordan toward the sunrise,

title: Deuteronomy 4:48
text: from Aroer, on the edge of the river Arnon, even to Mount Zion, which [is] Hermon,

title: Deuteronomy 4:49
text: and all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even to the sea of the plain, under the Slopes of Pisgah.

title: Deuteronomy 5:1
text: And Moses called all Israel and said to them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, so that you may learn them and keep and do them.

title: Deuteronomy 5:2
text: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

title: Deuteronomy 5:3
text: The LORD did not make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, all of us here, alive today.

title: Deuteronomy 5:4
text: The LORD talked with you face to face in the mountain out of the midst of the fire;

title: Deuteronomy 5:5
text: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to show you the word of the LORD, for you were afraid because of the fire, and did not go up into the mountain,) saying,

title: Deuteronomy 5:6
text: I [am] the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

title: Deuteronomy 5:7
text: You shall have no other gods besides Me.

title: Deuteronomy 5:8
text: You shall not make a graven image for you, any likeness [of anything] that is in the heavens above, or in the earth beneath, or in the waters beneath the earth.

title: Deuteronomy 5:9
text: You shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them. For I the LORD your God [am] a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the sons to the third and fourth [generation] of those who hate Me,

title: Deuteronomy 5:10
text: and doing mercy to thousands of those who love Me and keep My commandments.

title: Deuteronomy 5:11
text: You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain, for the LORD will not acquit [the one] who takes His name in vain.

title: Deuteronomy 5:12
text: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the LORD your God has commanded you.

title: Deuteronomy 5:13
text: Six days you shall labor and do all your work.

title: Deuteronomy 5:14
text: But the seventh day [shall be] the sabbath of the LORD your God. [In it] you shall not do any work, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your manservant, nor your maidservant, nor your ox, nor your ass, nor any of your cattle, nor your stranger inside your gates, so that your manservant and your maidservant may rest like yourself.

title: Deuteronomy 5:15
text: And remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God brought you out from there with a mighty hand and with a stretched-out arm. Therefore the LORD your God commanded you to keep the sabbath day.

title: Deuteronomy 5:16
text: Honor your father and your mother, as the LORD your God has commanded you, so that your days may be made longer, and that it may go well with you in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

title: Deuteronomy 5:17
text: You shall not kill.

title: Deuteronomy 5:18
text: And you shall not commit adultery.

title: Deuteronomy 5:19
text: And you shall not steal.

title: Deuteronomy 5:20
text: And you shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.

title: Deuteronomy 5:21
text: And you shall not lust after your neighbor's wife, nor shall you covet your neighbor's house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any [thing] that is your neighbor's.

title: Deuteronomy 5:22
text: The LORD spoke these words to all your assembly in the mountain out of the midst of the fire of the cloud and of the thick darkness with a great voice. And He added no more. And He wrote them in two tablets of stone and delivered them to me.

title: Deuteronomy 5:23
text: And it happened when you heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, for the mountain burned with fire, you came near me, all the heads of your tribes and your elders,

title: Deuteronomy 5:24
text: and you said, Behold! The LORD our God has revealed His glory and His greatness, and we have heard His voice out of the midst of the fire. We have seen today that God talks with man yet he [still] lives.

title: Deuteronomy 5:25
text: Now therefore why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we hear the voice of the LORD our God any more, then we shall die.

title: Deuteronomy 5:26
text: For who of all flesh has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we [have], and lived?

title: Deuteronomy 5:27
text: You go near and hear all that the LORD our God shall say. And you speak to us all that the LORD our God shall speak to you, and we will hear and act.

title: Deuteronomy 5:28
text: And the LORD heard the voice of your words when you spoke to me. And the LORD said to me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken to you. They have well [said] all that they have spoken.

title: Deuteronomy 5:29
text: Oh that there were such a heart in them that they would fear Me and keep all My commandments always, so that it might be well with them and with their sons forever!

title: Deuteronomy 5:30
text: Go say to them, Go into your tents again.

title: Deuteronomy 5:31
text: But as for you, you stand here by Me, and I will speak to you all the commandments and the statutes and the judgments which you shall teach them, that they may do [them] in the land which I am giving them, to possess it.

title: Deuteronomy 5:32
text: And you shall be careful to do as the LORD your God has commanded you. You shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.

title: Deuteronomy 5:33
text: You shall walk in all the ways which the LORD your God has commanded you so that you may live and that good [may be] to you, and you may make [your] days longer in the land which you shall possess.

title: Deuteronomy 6:1
text: And these [are] the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD our God commanded to teach you so that you might do [them] in the land where you go, to possess it,

title: Deuteronomy 6:2
text: that you might fear the LORD your God, to keep all His statutes and His commandments which I command you, you, and your son, and your son's son, all the days of your life, and so that your days may be prolonged.

title: Deuteronomy 6:3
text: Then hear, O, Israel, and be careful to [do] it, so that it may be well with you, and that you may greatly multiply, as the LORD God of our fathers has promised you, in the land that flows with milk and honey.

title: Deuteronomy 6:4
text: Hear, O, Israel. The LORD our God [is] one LORD.

title: Deuteronomy 6:5
text: And you shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your might.

title: Deuteronomy 6:6
text: And these words which I command you this day shall be in your heart.

title: Deuteronomy 6:7
text: And you shall carefully teach them to your sons, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.

title: Deuteronomy 6:8
text: And you shall bind them for a sign upon your hand, and they shall be as frontlets between your eyes.

title: Deuteronomy 6:9
text: And you shall write them upon the posts of your house, and on your gates.

title: Deuteronomy 6:10
text: And it shall be when the LORD your God has brought you into the land which He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you great and good cities which you did not build,

title: Deuteronomy 6:11
text: and houses full of every good [thing] which you did not fill, and wells which are dug, but which you did not dig, vineyards and olive trees which you did not plant, and you shall eat and be full,

title: Deuteronomy 6:12
text: you shall be on guard lest you forget the LORD who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of slaves.

title: Deuteronomy 6:13
text: You shall fear the LORD your God and serve Him, and shall swear by His name.

title: Deuteronomy 6:14
text: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people all around you,

title: Deuteronomy 6:15
text: for the LORD your God [is] a jealous God among you, lest the anger of the LORD your God be kindled against you and destroy you from off the face of the earth.

title: Deuteronomy 6:16
text: You shall not tempt the LORD your God as you tempted in Massah.

title: Deuteronomy 6:17
text: You shall carefully keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and His testimonies, and His statutes which He has commanded you.

title: Deuteronomy 6:18
text: And you shall do the right and good in the sight of the LORD, so that it may be well with you, and so that you may go in and possess the good land which the LORD swore to your fathers,

title: Deuteronomy 6:19
text: to cast out all your enemies from before you, as the LORD has spoken.

title: Deuteronomy 6:20
text: When your son asks you in time to come, saying, What are the testimonies, and the statutes and the judgments which the LORD our God has commanded you?

title: Deuteronomy 6:21
text: Then you shall say to your son, We were Pharaoh's slaves in Egypt, and the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

title: Deuteronomy 6:22
text: And the LORD gave signs and wonders, great and evil signs, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh and upon all his household, before our eyes.

title: Deuteronomy 6:23
text: And He brought us out from there so that He might bring us in to give us the land which He swore to our fathers.

title: Deuteronomy 6:24
text: And the LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, so that He might preserve us alive, as [it is] today.

title: Deuteronomy 6:25
text: And if we are careful to do all this commandment before the LORD our God, as He has commanded us, it shall be our righteousness.

title: Deuteronomy 7:1
text: When the LORD your God shall bring you into the land where you go to possess it, and has cast out many nations before you, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than you,

title: Deuteronomy 7:2
text: and the LORD your God shall deliver them before you, you shall crush them, completely destroy them. You shall make no covenant with them nor show mercy to them.

title: Deuteronomy 7:3
text: Nor shall you make marriages with them. You shall not give your daughter to his son, nor shall you take his daughter to your son.

title: Deuteronomy 7:4
text: For they will turn away your son from following Me, so that they may serve other gods. So the anger of the LORD will be kindled against you and will destroy you suddenly.

title: Deuteronomy 7:5
text: But you shall deal with them in this way: you shall destroy their altars and break down their images, and cut down their groves and burn their graven images with fire.

title: Deuteronomy 7:6
text: For you [are] a holy people to the LORD your God. The LORD your God has chosen you to be a special people to Himself above all people that are upon the face of the earth.

title: Deuteronomy 7:7
text: The LORD did not set His love upon you, nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people, for you [were] the fewest of all people.

title: Deuteronomy 7:8
text: But because the LORD loved you, and because He would keep the oath which He had sworn to your fathers, the LORD has brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you out of the house of slaves, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

title: Deuteronomy 7:9
text: Therefore, know that the LORD your God, He [is] God, the faithful God who keeps covenant and mercy with them that love Him and keep His commandments, to a thousand generations.

title: Deuteronomy 7:10
text: And he repays those who hate Him to their face, to destroy them. He will not be slow to repay him who hates Him. He will repay him to his face.

title: Deuteronomy 7:11
text: And you shall keep the commandments and the statutes and the judgments which I command you today, to do them.

title: Deuteronomy 7:12
text: And it shall be, because you listen to these judgments and keep and do them, the LORD your God shall keep to you the covenant and the mercy which He swore to your fathers.

title: Deuteronomy 7:13
text: And He will love you and bless you and multiply you. He will also bless the fruit of your womb, and the fruit of your land, your grain, and your wine, and your oil, the increase of your cattle, and the flocks of your sheep, in the land which He swore to your fathers to give you.

title: Deuteronomy 7:14
text: You shall be blessed above all people. There shall not be male or female barren among you or among your cattle.

title: Deuteronomy 7:15
text: And the LORD will take away from you all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt which you know upon you. But He will lay them upon all who hate you.

title: Deuteronomy 7:16
text: And you shall destroy all the people which the LORD your God shall deliver you. Your eye shall have no pity upon them, neither shall you serve their gods, for [they will be] a snare to you.

title: Deuteronomy 7:17
text: If you shall say in your heart, These nations [are] more than I; how can I throw them out?

title: Deuteronomy 7:18
text: You shall not be afraid of them, [but] shall well remember what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt.

title: Deuteronomy 7:19
text: [Remember] the great temptations which your eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched-out arm by which the Lord your God brought you out. So shall the LORD your God do to all the people of whom you are afraid.

title: Deuteronomy 7:20
text: And the LORD your God will send the hornet among them, until the ones who are left, and who hide themselves from you, are destroyed.

title: Deuteronomy 7:21
text: You shall not be afraid of them, for the LORD your God [is] among you, a mighty and terrible God.

title: Deuteronomy 7:22
text: And the LORD your God will put out those nations before you by little and little. You may not destroy them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon you.

title: Deuteronomy 7:23
text: And the LORD your God shall deliver them to you, and shall destroy them with a mighty ruin until they are destroyed.

title: Deuteronomy 7:24
text: And He shall deliver their kings into your hand, and you shall destroy their name from under the heavens. No man shall be able to stand before you until you have destroyed them.

title: Deuteronomy 7:25
text: You shall burn the graven images of their gods with fire. You shall not desire the silver or gold on them, nor take [it] for yourself, so that you may not be snared in it. For it is an abomination to the LORD your God.

title: Deuteronomy 7:26
text: And you shall not bring an abomination into your house, lest you be a cursed thing like it. You shall utterly hate it, and you shall utterly despise it. For it [is] a cursed thing.

title: Deuteronomy 8:1
text: All the commandments which I command you this day shall you be careful to do, that you may live and multiply and go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers.

title: Deuteronomy 8:2
text: And you shall remember all the way which the LORD your God led you these forty years in the wilderness in order to humble you, to prove you, to know what is in your heart, whether you would keep His commandments or not.

title: Deuteronomy 8:3
text: And He humbled you and allowed you to hunger, and then He fed you with manna, which you did not know, neither did your fathers know [it], so that He might make you know that man shall not live by bread alone. But every [word] that comes out of the mouth of the LORD man shall live.

title: Deuteronomy 8:4
text: Your clothing did not wear out on you, nor did your foot swell, these forty years.

title: Deuteronomy 8:5
text: And you have known with your heart that as a man chastens his son, [so] the LORD your God chastens you.

title: Deuteronomy 8:6
text: And you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, to walk in His ways and to fear him.

title: Deuteronomy 8:7
text: For the LORD your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills,

title: Deuteronomy 8:8
text: a land of wheat and barley and vines and fig trees and pomegranates, a land of olive oil and honey,

title: Deuteronomy 8:9
text: a land in which you shall eat bread without want. You shall not lack any [thing] in it. [It is] a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper.

title: Deuteronomy 8:10
text: And you shall eat and be satisfied, then you shall bless the LORD your God for the good land which He has given you.

title: Deuteronomy 8:11
text: Beware that you do not forget the LORD your God, in not keeping His commandments, and His judgments, and His statutes, which I command you today,

title: Deuteronomy 8:12
text: lest [when] you have eaten and are full and have built good houses and lived in [them,]

title: Deuteronomy 8:13
text: and [when] your herds and your flocks multiply, and your silver and your gold is multiplied, and all that you have is multiplied,

title: Deuteronomy 8:14
text: then your heart might be lifted up, and you might forget the LORD your God who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of slaves.

title: Deuteronomy 8:15
text: He led you through the great and terrible wilderness, [with] fiery serpents and scorpions and thirsty ground, where [there was] no water, who brought you forth water out of the rock of flint,

title: Deuteronomy 8:16
text: who fed you in the wilderness with manna which your fathers did not know, so that He might humble you and so that He might prove you, to do you good in your latter end,

title: Deuteronomy 8:17
text: and so that you might not say in your heart, My power and the might of [my] hand has gotten me this wealth.

title: Deuteronomy 8:18
text: But you shall remember the LORD your God, for [it is] He who gives you power to get wealth, so that He may confirm His covenant which He has sworn to your fathers, as it is today.

title: Deuteronomy 8:19
text: And it shall be if you do at all forget the LORD your God and walk after other gods and serve them and worship them, I testify against you today that you shall surely perish.

title: Deuteronomy 8:20
text: As the nations whom the LORD destroys before your face, so you shall perish because you would not listen to the voice of the LORD your God.

title: Deuteronomy 9:1
text: Hear, O, Israel! You [are] to pass over Jordan today, to go in to expel nations greater and mightier than you, cities great and fenced up to heaven,

title: Deuteronomy 9:2
text: a people great and tall, the sons of the giants, whom you know and have heard it said, Who can stand before the sons of Anak!

title: Deuteronomy 9:3
text: Therefore, understand today that the LORD your God [is] He who goes over before you. [Like] a consuming fire, He shall destroy them, and He shall bring them down before your face. So you shall drive them out and destroy them quickly, as the LORD has said to you.

title: Deuteronomy 9:4
text: Do not speak in your heart, after the LORD your God has cast them out from before you, saying: For my righteousness, the LORD has brought me in to possess this land. But for the wickedness of these nations, the LORD your God drives them out from before you.

title: Deuteronomy 9:5
text: Not for your righteousness, or for the uprightness of your heart, do you go to possess their land. But for the wickedness of these nations the LORD your God drives them out from before you, so that He may perform the word which the LORD swore to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

title: Deuteronomy 9:6
text: Therefore, understand that the LORD your God does not give you this good land, to possess it, for your righteousness. For you [are] a stiff-necked people.

title: Deuteronomy 9:7
text: Remember, [and] do not forget, how you provoked the LORD your God to wrath in the wilderness. From the day you departed out of the land of Egypt, until you came to this place, you have been rebellious against the LORD.

title: Deuteronomy 9:8
text: Also in Horeb you provoked the LORD to wrath, so that the LORD was angry with you to have destroyed you.

title: Deuteronomy 9:9
text: When I had gone up into the mountain to receive the tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I stayed in the mountain forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water.

title: Deuteronomy 9:10
text: And the LORD delivered to me two tablets of stone written with the finger of God, and on them according to all the words which the LORD spoke with you in the mountain out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.

title: Deuteronomy 9:11
text: And it happened, at the end of forty days and forty nights the LORD gave me the two tables of stone, the tablets of the covenant.

title: Deuteronomy 9:12
text: And the LORD said to me, Arise! Get down quickly from here, for your people whom you have brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted. They have quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them. They have made them a molten image.

title: Deuteronomy 9:13
text: And the LORD spoke to me saying: I have seen this people, and, behold, it [is] a stiff-necked people.

title: Deuteronomy 9:14
text: Let Me alone, so that I may destroy them and blot out their name from under the heavens. And I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they.

title: Deuteronomy 9:15
text: So I turned and came down from the mountain, and the mountain burned with fire. And the two tables of the covenant [were] in my two hands.

title: Deuteronomy 9:16
text: And I looked, and behold! You had sinned against the LORD your God, and had made you a molten calf. You had turned aside quickly out of the way which the LORD had commanded you.

title: Deuteronomy 9:17
text: And I took the two tablets and threw them out of my hands and broke them before your eyes.

title: Deuteronomy 9:18
text: And I fell down before the LORD, as at the first, forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water, because of all your sins which you sinned in doing wickedly in the sight of the LORD to provoke Him to anger.

title: Deuteronomy 9:19
text: For I was afraid of the anger and fury with which the LORD was angry against you to destroy you. But the LORD listened to me at that time also.

title: Deuteronomy 9:20
text: And the LORD was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him. And I prayed for Aaron also at the same time.

title: Deuteronomy 9:21
text: And I took your sin, the calf which you had made, and burned it with fire, and stamped it, grinding [it] very small, until it was as small as dust. And I threw the dust of it into the torrent that descended out of the mountain.

title: Deuteronomy 9:22
text: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at the Graves of Lust, you provoked the LORD to anger.

title: Deuteronomy 9:23
text: And when the LORD sent you from Kadesh-barnea, saying: Go up and possess the land which I have given you, then you rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God, and you did not believe Him, nor listened to His voice.

title: Deuteronomy 9:24
text: You have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.

title: Deuteronomy 9:25
text: And I fell down before the LORD forty days and forty nights, as I fell down [before], because the LORD had said He would destroy you.

title: Deuteronomy 9:26
text: I prayed therefore to the LORD and said, O, Lord God, do not destroy Your people and Your inheritance which You have redeemed through Your greatness, which You have brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

title: Deuteronomy 9:27
text: Remember Your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Do not look to the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin,

title: Deuteronomy 9:28
text: lest the land from where You bring us out say, Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which He promised them, and because He hated them, He has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness.

title: Deuteronomy 9:29
text: Yet they [are] Your people and Your inheritance which You brought out by Your mighty power and by Your stretched-out arm.

title: Deuteronomy 10:1
text: At that time the LORD said to me: Cut out two tablets of stone like the first, and come up to Me into the mountain, and make an ark of wood.

title: Deuteronomy 10:2
text: And I will write on the tablets the words that were in the first tablets which you broke, and you shall put them in the ark.

title: Deuteronomy 10:3
text: And I made an ark [of] acacia-wood, and cut out two tablets of stone like the first, and went up into the mountain, having the two tablets in my hand.

title: Deuteronomy 10:4
text: And He wrote on the tablets, according to the first writing, the Ten Commandments which the LORD spoke to you in the mountain out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly. And the LORD gave them to me.

title: Deuteronomy 10:5
text: And I turned myself and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark which I had made. And there they are, as the LORD commanded me.

title: Deuteronomy 10:6
text: And the sons of Israel pulled up [stakes] from Beeroth of the sons of Jaakan to Mosera. There Aaron died, and there he was buried. And Eleazar his son served in the priest's office in his place.

title: Deuteronomy 10:7
text: From there they pulled up to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah to Jotbath, a land of rivers of water brooks.

title: Deuteronomy 10:8
text: At that time the LORD separated the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to minister to Him, and to bless in His name, until today.

title: Deuteronomy 10:9
text: Therefore Levi has no part nor inheritance with his brothers. The LORD [is] his inheritance, according as the LORD your God promised him.

title: Deuteronomy 10:10
text: And I stayed in the mountain, according to the first time, forty days and forty nights. And the LORD listened to me at that time also. The LORD would not destroy you.

title: Deuteronomy 10:11
text: And the LORD said to me, Arise, Go before the people, causing them to go in and possess the land which I swore to their fathers to give to them.

title: Deuteronomy 10:12
text: And now, Israel, what does the LORD your God ask of you, but to fear the LORD your God, to walk in all His ways, and to love Him, and to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

title: Deuteronomy 10:13
text: to keep the commandments of the LORD, and His statutes, which I command you today for your good?

title: Deuteronomy 10:14
text: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens [belong] to the LORD your God, the earth also, with all in it.

title: Deuteronomy 10:15
text: Only the LORD had a delight in your fathers to love them, and He chose their seed after them, you above all people, as [it is] today.

title: Deuteronomy 10:16
text: Therefore, circumcise the foreskin of your heart, and be no longer stiff-necked.

title: Deuteronomy 10:17
text: For the LORD your God [is] God of gods, and Lord of lords, a great God, the mighty, and a terrible God, who does not respect persons nor take a bribe.

title: Deuteronomy 10:18
text: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow, and loves the stranger in giving him food and clothing.

title: Deuteronomy 10:19
text: Therefore love the stranger, for you were strangers in the land of Egypt.

title: Deuteronomy 10:20
text: You shall fear the LORD your God. You shall serve Him, and you shall hold fast to Him, and swear by His name.

title: Deuteronomy 10:21
text: He [is] your praise, and He [is] your God, who has done for you these great and terrible things which your eyes have seen.

title: Deuteronomy 10:22
text: Your fathers went down into Egypt with seventy persons. And now the LORD your God has made you as the stars of the heavens for multitude.

title: Deuteronomy 11:1
text: Therefore you shall love the LORD your God, and keep His charge and His statutes and His judgments and His commandments always.

title: Deuteronomy 11:2
text: And you know today, for [I do] not [speak] with your sons who have not known and who have not seen the chastisement of the LORD your God, His greatness, His mighty hand, and His stretched-out arm,

title: Deuteronomy 11:3
text: and His miracles, and His acts which He did in the midst of Egypt, to Pharaoh the king of Egypt and to all his land.

title: Deuteronomy 11:4
text: And [you know] what He did to the army of Egypt, to their horses and to their chariots, how He made the water of the Red Sea to overflow them as they pursued after you, and the LORD has destroyed them to today.

title: Deuteronomy 11:5
text: And you [know what] He did to you in the wilderness until you came into this place,

title: Deuteronomy 11:6
text: and what He did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab the son of Reuben, how the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, and their households, and their tents, and all the substance in their possession, in the midst of all Israel.

title: Deuteronomy 11:7
text: But your eyes have seen all the great acts of the LORD which He did.

title: Deuteronomy 11:8
text: Therefore you shall keep all the commandments which I command you today, so that you may be strong and go in and possess the land where you go to possess it,

title: Deuteronomy 11:9
text: and so that you may make [your] days longer in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give to them and to their seed, a land that flows with milk and honey.

title: Deuteronomy 11:10
text: For the land into which you go to possess it, [is] not as the land of Egypt from which you came out, where you sowed your seed and watered [it] with your foot, like a garden of herbs.

title: Deuteronomy 11:11
text: But the land which you are entering to possess it [is] a land of hills and valleys, drinking water from the rain of heavens.

title: Deuteronomy 11:12
text: It is a land which the LORD your God cares for. The eyes of the LORD your God [are] always upon it, from the beginning of the year even to the end of the year.

title: Deuteronomy 11:13
text: And it will be, if you will listen carefully to My commandments which I command you today, to love the LORD your God and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul,

title: Deuteronomy 11:14
text: I will give the rain of your land in its due season, the first rain and the latter rain, that you may gather in your grain and your wine and your oil.

title: Deuteronomy 11:15
text: And I will send grass in your fields for your cattle so that you may eat and be full.

title: Deuteronomy 11:16
text: Take heed to yourselves that your heart may not be deceived, and you turn aside and serve other gods, and worship them,

title: Deuteronomy 11:17
text: and the LORD's wrath be kindled against you, and He shut up the heavens so that there will be no rain, and so that the land will not yield her fruit, and you perish quickly from off the good land which the LORD gives you.

title: Deuteronomy 11:18
text: Therefore you shall lay up these my words in your hearts and in your souls, and bind them for a sign upon your hand, so that they may be as frontlets between your eyes.

title: Deuteronomy 11:19
text: And you shall teach them to your sons, speaking of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, when you lie down, and when you rise up.

title: Deuteronomy 11:20
text: And [you] shall write them upon the door posts of your house, and upon your gates,

title: Deuteronomy 11:21
text: so that your days and the days of your sons may be multiplied in the land which the LORD swore to give to your fathers, like the days of the heavens upon the earth.

title: Deuteronomy 11:22
text: For if you will carefully keep all these commandments which I command you, to do them, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all His ways, and to hold fast to Him,

title: Deuteronomy 11:23
text: then the LORD will drive out all these nations from before you, and you shall possess greater and mightier nations than you.

title: Deuteronomy 11:24
text: Every place on which the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours, from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even to the furthest sea shall your border be.

title: Deuteronomy 11:25
text: There shall no man stand before you, [for] the LORD your God shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon the face of all the land that you shall tread upon, as He has said to you.

title: Deuteronomy 11:26
text: Behold, I set before you today a blessing and a curse:

title: Deuteronomy 11:27
text: A blessing if you obey the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you today,

title: Deuteronomy 11:28
text: and a curse if you will not obey the commandments of the LORD your God, but will turn aside out of the way which I command you today, to go after other gods which you have not known.

title: Deuteronomy 11:29
text: And it will be, when the LORD your God has brought you into the land where you go to possess it, you shall set the blessing upon Mount Gerizim, and the curse upon Mount Ebal.

title: Deuteronomy 11:30
text: [Are] they not on the other side Jordan, by the way of the sunset, in the land of the Canaanites, who dwell in the plain across from Gilgal beside the plains of Moreh?

title: Deuteronomy 11:31
text: For you shall pass over Jordan to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God gives you, and you shall possess it and dwell in it.

title: Deuteronomy 11:32
text: And you shall be careful to do all the statutes and judgments which I set before you today.

title: Deuteronomy 12:1
text: These [are] the statutes and judgments which you shall be careful to do in the land which the LORD God of your fathers gives you to possess it, all the days that you live upon the earth.

title: Deuteronomy 12:2
text: You shall completely destroy all the places in which the nations which you shall possess served their gods, on the high mountains and on the hills and under every green tree.

title: Deuteronomy 12:3
text: And you shall overthrow their altars and break their pillars, and burn their pillars with fire. And you shall cut down the carved images of their gods, and destroy their names out of that place.

title: Deuteronomy 12:4
text: You shall not do so to the LORD your God.

title: Deuteronomy 12:5
text: But you shall seek to the place which the LORD your God shall choose out of all your tribes to put His name there, even to His dwelling place you shall seek, and there you shall come.

title: Deuteronomy 12:6
text: And there you shall bring your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and heave offering of your hand, and your vows, and your free-will offerings, and the first-born of your herds and of your flocks.

title: Deuteronomy 12:7
text: And there you shall eat before the LORD your God, and you shall rejoice in all that you put your hand to, you and your households in which the LORD your God has blessed you.

title: Deuteronomy 12:8
text: You shall not do according to all that we do here today, each doing whatever [is] right in his own eyes.

title: Deuteronomy 12:9
text: For you have not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance which the LORD your God gives you.

title: Deuteronomy 12:10
text: But [when] you go over Jordan and live in the land which the LORD your God gives you to inherit, and He gives you rest from all your enemies all around, so that you live in safety,

title: Deuteronomy 12:11
text: then there shall be a place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause His name to dwell there. There you shall bring all that I command you, your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the heave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which you vow to the LORD.

title: Deuteronomy 12:12
text: And you shall rejoice before the LORD your God, you, your sons, your daughters, your men-servants, your female-servants, and the Levite that [is] within your gates (because he has no part nor inheritance with you).

title: Deuteronomy 12:13
text: Take heed to yourself that you do not offer your burnt offerings in every place that you see.

title: Deuteronomy 12:14
text: But in the place which the LORD shall choose in one of your tribes, there you shall offer your burnt offerings, and there you shall do all that I command you.

title: Deuteronomy 12:15
text: However, with all your soul's desire you shall sacrifice and eat flesh in all your gates, according to the blessing of the LORD your God which He has given you, the unclean and the clean may eat of it, as of the gazelle, and as of the hart.

title: Deuteronomy 12:16
text: Only you shall not eat the blood. You shall pour it on the earth like water.

title: Deuteronomy 12:17
text: You may not eat inside your gates the tithe of your grain or of your wine or of your oil, or the first-born of your herds or of your flock, or any of your vows which you vow, or your free-will offerings or the heave offering of your hand.

title: Deuteronomy 12:18
text: But you must eat them before the LORD your God in the place which the LORD your God shall choose, you, and your son, and your daughter, and your manservant, and your maidservant, and the Levite within your gates. And you shall rejoice before the LORD your God in all that you put your hand [to].

title: Deuteronomy 12:19
text: Take heed to yourself that you do not forsake the Levite as long as you live on the earth.

title: Deuteronomy 12:20
text: When the LORD your God shall make your border larger, as He has promised you, and you shall say, I will eat flesh, because your soul longs to eat flesh; you may eat flesh, whatever your soul desires.

title: Deuteronomy 12:21
text: If the place which the LORD your God has chosen to put his name there is too far from you, then you shall kill of your herd and of your flock which the LORD has given you, as I have commanded you, and you shall eat in your gates whatever your soul desires.

title: Deuteronomy 12:22
text: Even as the gazelle and the hart is eaten, so you shall eat them. The unclean and the clean shall eat [of] them alike.

title: Deuteronomy 12:23
text: Only be sure that you do not eat the blood. For the blood [is] the life. And you may not eat the life with the flesh.

title: Deuteronomy 12:24
text: You shall not eat it. You shall pour it on the earth like water.

title: Deuteronomy 12:25
text: You shall not eat it, so that it may go well with you and with your sons after you, when you shall do what [is] right in the sight of the LORD.

title: Deuteronomy 12:26
text: Only your holy things which you have, and your vows, you shall take and go to the place which the LORD shall choose.

title: Deuteronomy 12:27
text: And you shall offer your burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, on the altar of the LORD your God. And the blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out on the altar of the LORD your God, and you shall eat the flesh.

title: Deuteronomy 12:28
text: Be careful to hear all these words which I command you, so that it may go well with you and with your sons after you forever, when you do the good and right in the sight of the LORD your God.

title: Deuteronomy 12:29
text: When the LORD your God shall cut off the nations before you, where you go to possess them, and you take their place and dwell in their land,

title: Deuteronomy 12:30
text: take heed to yourself that you do not become snared by following them, after they are destroyed from before you, and that you do not ask about their gods, saying, How did these nations serve their gods that I too may do likewise?

title: Deuteronomy 12:31
text: You shall not do so to the LORD your God. For every abomination to the LORD, which He hates, they have done to their gods; even their sons and their daughters they have burned in the fire to their gods.

title: Deuteronomy 12:32
text: All the things I command you, be careful to do it. You shall not add to it, nor take away from it.

title: Deuteronomy 13:1
text: If a prophet rises among you, or a dreamer of dreams, and gives you a sign or a wonder,

title: Deuteronomy 13:2
text: and the sign or the wonder which he foretold to you occurs, saying, Let us go after other gods which you have not known, and let us serve them,

title: Deuteronomy 13:3
text: you shall not listen to the words of that prophet or that dreamer of dreams. For the LORD your God [is] testing you to know whether you love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

title: Deuteronomy 13:4
text: You shall walk after the LORD your God and fear Him, and keep His commandments, and obey His voice, and you shall serve Him and hold fast to Him.

title: Deuteronomy 13:5
text: And that prophet or that dreamer of dreams shall be put to death, because he has spoken to turn [you] away from the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you out of the house of slaves, to thrust you out of the way in which the LORD your God commanded you to walk. So you shall put the evil away from the midst of you.

title: Deuteronomy 13:6
text: If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son, or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who [is] like your own soul, lures you secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods which you have not known, you nor your fathers,

title: Deuteronomy 13:7
text: that is, of the gods of the people who [are] around you, near you or far off from you, from the one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth,

title: Deuteronomy 13:8
text: you shall not consent to him nor listen to him. Nor shall your eye pity him, nor shall you spare, nor shall you hide him.

title: Deuteronomy 13:9
text: But you shall surely kill him. Your hand shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterwards the hand of all the people.

title: Deuteronomy 13:10
text: And you shall stone him with stones so that he dies, because he has sought to drive you away from the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, from the house of slaves.

title: Deuteronomy 13:11
text: And all Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall do no more any such wickedness as this among you.

title: Deuteronomy 13:12
text: If, in one of your cities which the LORD your God has given you to dwell in, you shall hear [one] saying,

title: Deuteronomy 13:13
text: Men, the sons of Belial, have gone out from among you and have drawn away those who live in their city, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which you have not known,

title: Deuteronomy 13:14
text: then you shall inquire and make search, and ask carefully. And behold, [if it is true], and the thing is certain, [that] such an abomination is done among you,

title: Deuteronomy 13:15
text: you shall surely strike those who live in that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it completely, and all that [is] in it, and all the cattle of it, with the edge of the sword.

title: Deuteronomy 13:16
text: And you shall gather all its spoil into the middle of its street, and shall burn the city with fire, and all its spoil, every bit of it, for the LORD your God. And it shall be a heap forever. It shall not be built again.

title: Deuteronomy 13:17
text: And let nothing of the cursed thing cling to your hand, so that the LORD may turn from the heat of his anger and show you mercy, and give mercies to you, and multiply you as He has sworn to your fathers,

title: Deuteronomy 13:18
text: when you listen to the voice of the LORD your God, to keep all His commandments which I command you today, to do the right in the eyes of the LORD your God.

title: Deuteronomy 14:1
text: You [are] the sons of the LORD your God. You shall not cut yourselves nor make [any] baldness between your eyes for the dead.

title: Deuteronomy 14:2
text: For you [are] a holy people to the LORD your God, and the LORD has chosen you to be a peculiar people to Himself, above all the nations that are on the earth.

title: Deuteronomy 14:3
text: You shall not eat any hateful thing.

title: Deuteronomy 14:4
text: These [are] the animals which you shall eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat,

title: Deuteronomy 14:5
text: the hart, and the gazelle, and the roe deer, and the wild goat, and the mountain goat, and the wild ox, and the mountain-sheep.

title: Deuteronomy 14:6
text: And every animal that divides the hoof, and divides it into two hooves, [and] chews the cud among the animals, that you shall eat.

title: Deuteronomy 14:7
text: But these you shall not eat, of those which chew the cud, or of those that divide the cloven hoof: the camel, and the hare, and the rock badger, for they chew the cud, but do not divide the hoof. They [are] unclean to you.

title: Deuteronomy 14:8
text: And the swine, because it divides the hoof but does not chew the cud; it [is] unclean to you. You shall not eat of their flesh nor touch their dead body.

title: Deuteronomy 14:9
text: These you shall eat of all that [are] in the waters: all that have fins and scales you shall eat.

title: Deuteronomy 14:10
text: And whatever does not have fins and scales you shall not eat. It [is] unclean to you.

title: Deuteronomy 14:11
text: You shall eat all clean birds.

title: Deuteronomy 14:12
text: But you shall not eat of these: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the osprey,

title: Deuteronomy 14:13
text: and the hawk, and the falcon, and the vulture after its kind,

title: Deuteronomy 14:14
text: and every raven after its kind,

title: Deuteronomy 14:15
text: and the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckoo, and the hawk after its kind,

title: Deuteronomy 14:16
text: the little owl, and the great owl, and the swan,

title: Deuteronomy 14:17
text: and the pelican, and the owl, and the cormorant,

title: Deuteronomy 14:18
text: and the stork, and the heron after its kind, and the hoopoe, and the bat.

title: Deuteronomy 14:19
text: And every creeping thing that flies [is] unclean to you. They shall not be eaten.

title: Deuteronomy 14:20
text: You may eat all clean fowls.

title: Deuteronomy 14:21
text: You shall not eat anything that dies of itself. You shall give it to the stranger that [is] in your gates, so that he may eat it. Or you may sell [it] to a stranger. For you [are] a holy people to the LORD your God. You shall not boil a kid in its mother's milk.

title: Deuteronomy 14:22
text: You shall truly tithe all the increase of your seed that the field brings forth year by year.

title: Deuteronomy 14:23
text: And you shall eat before the LORD your God in the place which He shall choose to place His name there, the tithe of your grain, of your wine, and of your oil, and the first-born of your herds and of your flocks, so that you may learn to fear the LORD your God always.

title: Deuteronomy 14:24
text: And if the way is too long for you, so that you are not able to carry it, [or] if the place is too far from you, which the LORD your God shall choose to set His name there, when the LORD your God has blessed you,

title: Deuteronomy 14:25
text: then you shall turn [it] into silver and bind up the silver in your hand, and shall go to the place which the LORD your God shall choose.

title: Deuteronomy 14:26
text: And you shall pay that silver for whatever your soul desires, for oxen, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatever your soul desires. And you shall eat there before the LORD your God, and you shall rejoice, you and your household

title: Deuteronomy 14:27
text: and the Levite within your gates, you shall not forsake him, for he has no part nor inheritance with you.

title: Deuteronomy 14:28
text: At the end of three years you shall bring forth all the tithe of your increase the same year, and shall lay [it] up inside your gates.

title: Deuteronomy 14:29
text: And the Levite, because he has no part nor inheritance with you, and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, who [are] inside your gates, shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied, so that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hand which you do.

title: Deuteronomy 15:1
text: At the end of [every] seven years you shall make a release.

title: Deuteronomy 15:2
text: And this [is] the manner of the release. Every man who has a loan to his neighbor shall release it. He shall not exact [it] from his neighbor, or from his brother, because it is called the LORD's release.

title: Deuteronomy 15:3
text: You may exact [it] from a foreigner, but your hand shall release that which is yours with your brother,

title: Deuteronomy 15:4
text: except when there shall be no poor among you. For the LORD shall greatly bless you in the land which the LORD your God gives you [for] an inheritance to possess it,

title: Deuteronomy 15:5
text: only if you carefully listen to the voice of the LORD your God to be careful to do all these commandments which I command you today.

title: Deuteronomy 15:6
text: For the LORD your God blesses you as He promised you. And you shall lend to many nations, but you shall not borrow. And you shall reign over many nations, but they shall not reign over you.

title: Deuteronomy 15:7
text: If there is among you a poor man of one of your brothers inside any of your gates in your land which the LORD your God gives you, you shall not harden your heart nor shut your hand from your poor brother.

title: Deuteronomy 15:8
text: But you shall open your hand wide to him, and shall surely lend him enough for his need, that which he lacks.

title: Deuteronomy 15:9
text: Beware that there is not a thought in your wicked heart, saying, The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand, and your eye may be evil against your poor brother, and you give him nothing. And he may cry to the LORD against you, and it is sin to you.

title: Deuteronomy 15:10
text: You shall surely give to him, and your heart shall not be grieved when you give to him, because for this thing the LORD your God shall bless you in all your works, and in all that you put your hand to.

title: Deuteronomy 15:11
text: For the poor shall never cease out of the land. Therefore, I command you saying, You shall open your hand wide to your brother, to your poor, and to your needy, in your land.

title: Deuteronomy 15:12
text: If your brother, a Hebrew man or a Hebrew woman, is sold to you and serves you six years, then in the seventh year you shall let him go free from you.

title: Deuteronomy 15:13
text: And when you send him out free from you, you shall not let him go away empty.

title: Deuteronomy 15:14
text: You shall richly bestow on him from your flock, and from your grain floor, and from your winepress; with what the LORD your God has blessed you, you shall give to him.

title: Deuteronomy 15:15
text: And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you. Therefore I command you this thing today.

title: Deuteronomy 15:16
text: And if he says to you, I will not go away from you, because he loves you and your house, because it [has been] good for him with you;

title: Deuteronomy 15:17
text: then you shall take an awl and put [it] through his ear to the door, and he shall be your servant forever. And also to your slave-girl you shall do so.

title: Deuteronomy 15:18
text: It shall not seem hard to you when you send him away from you free, for he has been worth a double hired servant in serving you six years. And the LORD your God shall bless you in all that you do.

title: Deuteronomy 15:19
text: All the first-born males that come from your herd and from your flock, you shall set apart to the LORD your God. You shall do no work with the first-born of your bull, nor shear the first-born of your sheep.

title: Deuteronomy 15:20
text: You shall eat before the LORD your God year by year in the place which the LORD shall choose, you and your household.

title: Deuteronomy 15:21
text: And if there is a blemish in it, lame, or blindness, or any ill blemish, you shall not sacrifice it to the LORD your God.

title: Deuteronomy 15:22
text: You shall eat it inside your gates. The unclean and the clean shall [eat it] alike, as the gazelle, and as the hart.

title: Deuteronomy 15:23
text: Only you shall not eat the blood of it. You shall pour it on the ground like water.

title: Deuteronomy 16:1
text: Observe the month Abib, and keep the Passover to the LORD your God. For in the month of Abib, the LORD your God brought you forth out of Egypt by night.

title: Deuteronomy 16:2
text: And you shall therefore sacrifice the Passover to the LORD your God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which the LORD shall choose to place His name there.

title: Deuteronomy 16:3
text: You shall eat no leavened [bread] with it. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread with it, the bread of affliction, for you came forth out of the land of Egypt in haste, so that you may remember the day that you came forth out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.

title: Deuteronomy 16:4
text: And there shall be no leavened [bread] seen with you in all your borders for seven days. Nor shall [any] of the flesh which you sacrificed in the first day at evening remain all night until the morning.

title: Deuteronomy 16:5
text: You may not sacrifice the Passover within any of your gates, which the LORD your God gives you,

title: Deuteronomy 16:6
