text: but at the place which the LORD your God shall choose to place His name in, there you shall sacrifice the Passover at evening, at the going of the sun, at the time that you came out of Egypt.

title: Deuteronomy 16:7
text: And you shall roast and eat in the place which the LORD your God shall choose. And in the morning you shall turn and go to your tents.

title: Deuteronomy 16:8
text: Six days you shall eat unleavened [bread]. And on the seventh day [shall be] a solemn assembly to the LORD your God. You shall do no work.

title: Deuteronomy 16:9
text: You shall count seven weeks to yourselves. Begin to count the seven weeks from the time you began [to put] the sickle to the grain.

title: Deuteronomy 16:10
text: And you shall keep the Feast of Weeks to the LORD your God with a measure of a free-will offering of your hand, which you shall give according as the LORD your God has blessed you.

title: Deuteronomy 16:11
text: And you shall rejoice before the LORD your God, you, and your son, and your daughter, and your male servant, and your slave-girl, and the Levite inside your gates, and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, those among you, in the place which the LORD your God has chosen to place His name there.

title: Deuteronomy 16:12
text: And you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt. And you shall be careful to do these statutes.

title: Deuteronomy 16:13
text: You shall keep the Feast of Tabernacles seven days after you have gathered in your grain flour and your wine press.

title: Deuteronomy 16:14
text: And you shall rejoice in your feast, you, and your son, and your daughter, and your male slave, and your slave-girl, and the Levite, the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow inside your gates.

title: Deuteronomy 16:15
text: Seven days you shall keep a solemn feast to the LORD your God in the place which the LORD shall choose. Because the LORD your God shall bless you in all your increase, and in all the works of your hands, therefore you shall surely rejoice.

title: Deuteronomy 16:16
text: Three times in a year shall all your males appear before the LORD your God in the place which He shall choose: in the Feast of Unleavened [Bread], and in the Feast of Weeks, and in the Feast of Tabernacles. And they shall not appear before the LORD empty,

title: Deuteronomy 16:17
text: [but] each with his gift in his hand, according to the blessing of the LORD your God, which He has given you.

title: Deuteronomy 16:18
text: You shall appoint judges and officers for yourself in all your gates which the LORD your God gives you, tribe by tribe. And they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.

title: Deuteronomy 16:19
text: You shall not pervert judgment; you shall not respect persons, nor take a gift. For a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and perverts the words of the righteous.

title: Deuteronomy 16:20
text: You shall follow that which is altogether just, that you may live and inherit the land which the LORD your God gives you.

title: Deuteronomy 16:21
text: You shall not set up for yourself pillars of any trees near the altar of the LORD your God which you shall make for yourself.

title: Deuteronomy 16:22
text: Nor shall you set up an image, which the LORD your God hates.

title: Deuteronomy 17:1
text: You shall not sacrifice to the LORD your God [any] bull or sheep in which there is a blemish, any evil thing, for that is an abomination to the LORD your God.

title: Deuteronomy 17:2
text: If there is found among you, inside any of your gates which the LORD your God gives you, a man or woman who what is evil in the sight of the LORD your God, in breaking His covenant,

title: Deuteronomy 17:3
text: and has gone and served other gods and worshiped them, either the sun, or moon, or any [of] the host of heaven, which I have not commanded,

title: Deuteronomy 17:4
text: and if it is told you, and you have heard and inquired carefully, and, behold, it is true and the thing is certain, such abomination is done in Israel;

title: Deuteronomy 17:5
text: then you shall bring forth that man or that woman who has committed that evil thing, to your gates, even that man or that woman, and shall stone them with stones until they die.

title: Deuteronomy 17:6
text: At the mouth of two witnesses or three witnesses shall he that is worthy of death be put to death. At the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.

title: Deuteronomy 17:7
text: The hands of the witnesses shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterwards the hands of all the people. So you shall put the evil away from among you.

title: Deuteronomy 17:8
text: If a matter [is] too hard for you in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, matters of strife within your gates, then you shall arise and go up to the place which the LORD your God shall choose.

title: Deuteronomy 17:9
text: And [you] shall come to the priests of the Levites, and to the judge that shall be in those days, and ask. And they shall declare to you the sentence of judgment.

title: Deuteronomy 17:10
text: And you shall do according to the sentence which they declare to you from that place which the LORD shall choose. And you shall be careful to do according to all that they tell you.

title: Deuteronomy 17:11
text: According to the sentence of the law which they shall teach you and according to the judgment which they shall tell you, you shall do. You shall not turn aside from the sentence which they shall show you, to the right hand or the left.

title: Deuteronomy 17:12
text: And the man that acts proudly and will not listen to the priest who stands to minister there before the LORD your God, or to the judge, even that man shall die. And you shall put away the evil from Israel.

title: Deuteronomy 17:13
text: And all the people shall hear and fear, and not be presumptuous any more.

title: Deuteronomy 17:14
text: When you come to the land which the LORD your God gives you, and shall possess it and shall live in it and shall say, I will set a king over me, like all the nations around me,

title: Deuteronomy 17:15
text: you shall surely set a king over you, whom the LORD your God shall choose. You shall set a king over you from among your brothers. You may not set a stranger over you, who is not your brother.

title: Deuteronomy 17:16
text: But he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, so as to multiply horses, because the LORD has said to you, You shall return no more that way from now on.

title: Deuteronomy 17:17
text: Nor shall he multiply wives to himself, so that his heart does not turn away. Nor shall he greatly multiply silver and gold to himself.

title: Deuteronomy 17:18
text: And it shall be, when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, he shall write a copy of this law in a book from before the priests the Levites.

title: Deuteronomy 17:19
text: And it shall be with him, and he shall read it all the days of his life, so that he may learn to fear the LORD his God, to keep all the words of this law, and these statutes, to do them,

title: Deuteronomy 17:20
text: so that his heart may not be lifted up above his brothers, and that he does not turn aside from the commandment, to the right or the left, so that he may make his days longer in his kingdom, he and his sons, in the midst of Israel.

title: Deuteronomy 18:1
text: The priests, the Levites, all the tribe of Levi, [shall have] no part nor inheritance with Israel. They shall eat the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and His inheritance.

title: Deuteronomy 18:2
text: Therefore they shall have no inheritance among their brothers. The LORD [is their inheritance, as He has said to them.

title: Deuteronomy 18:3
text: And this shall be the priest's due from the people, from those that offer a sacrifice, whether ox or sheep. And they shall give to the priest the shoulder and the two cheeks, and the stomach.

title: Deuteronomy 18:4
text: You shall give him the first-fruit of your grain, of your wine, and of your oil, and the first of the fleece of your sheep.

title: Deuteronomy 18:5
text: For the LORD your God has chosen him out of all your tribes, to stand to minister in the name of the LORD, him and his sons forever.

title: Deuteronomy 18:6
text: And if a Levite comes from any of your gates out of all Israel, where he lived, and come with all the desire of his mind to the place which the LORD shall choose,

title: Deuteronomy 18:7
text: then he shall minister in the name of the LORD his God, as all his brothers and Levites who stand there before the LORD.

title: Deuteronomy 18:8
text: They shall have the same portions to eat, besides that of the sales of the inheritance from] his father.

title: Deuteronomy 18:9
text: When you come to the land which the LORD your God gives you, you shall not learn to do according to the abominations of those nations.

title: Deuteronomy 18:10
text: There shall not be found among you anyone who makes his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, [or] that uses divination, an observer of clouds, or a fortune-teller, or a witch,

title: Deuteronomy 18:11
text: or a charmer, or a consulter with familiar spirits, or a wizard, or one who calls to the dead.

title: Deuteronomy 18:12
text: For all that do these things [are] an abomination to the LORD. And because of these abominations the LORD your God drives them out from before you.

title: Deuteronomy 18:13
text: You shall be perfect with the LORD your God.

title: Deuteronomy 18:14
text: For these nations whom you shall possess listened to observers of clouds and to diviners. But as for you, the LORD your God has not allowed you [to do] so.

title: Deuteronomy 18:15
text: The LORD your God will raise up to you a Prophet from the midst of you, of your brothers, One like me. To Him you shall listen,

title: Deuteronomy 18:16
text: according to all that you desired of the LORD your God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying: Let me not hear again the voice of the LORD my God, neither let me see this great fire any more, so that I do not die.

title: Deuteronomy 18:17
text: And the LORD said to me, They have spoken well what they have spoken.

title: Deuteronomy 18:18
text: I will raise them up a Prophet from among their brothers, [one] like you, and will put My words in His mouth. And He shall speak to them all that I shall command Him.

title: Deuteronomy 18:19
text: And it shall happen, whatever man will not listen to My words which He shall speak in My name, I will require [it] of him.

title: Deuteronomy 18:20
text: But the prophet who shall presume to speak a word in My name which I have not commanded him to speak or who shall speak in the name of other gods, even that prophet shall die.

title: Deuteronomy 18:21
text: And if you say in your heart, How shall we know the word which the LORD has not spoken?

title: Deuteronomy 18:22
text: When a prophet speaks in the name of the LORD, if the thing does not follow nor come to pass, that [is] the thing which the LORD has not spoken. The prophet has spoken it presumptuously. You shall not be afraid of him.

title: Deuteronomy 19:1
text: When the LORD your God has cut off the nations whose land the LORD your God gives you, and when you take their place and live in their cities and in their houses,

title: Deuteronomy 19:2
text: you shall separate three cities for you in the middle of your land, which the LORD your God gives you to possess it.

title: Deuteronomy 19:3
text: You shall prepare you a way, and divide the borders of your land which the LORD your God gives you to inherit, into three parts, so that every slayer may flee there.

title: Deuteronomy 19:4
text: And this [is] the case of the slayer who shall flee there that he may live: whoever in error kills his neighbor whom he did not hate him before,

title: Deuteronomy 19:5
text: even he who goes into the wood with his neighbor to cut wood, and his hand brings a stroke with the axe to cut down the tree, and the head slips from the wood and lights on his neighbor so that he dies; he shall flee to one of those cities and live,

title: Deuteronomy 19:6
text: so that the avenger of the blood may not pursue the slayer while his heart is hot, and overtake him because the way is long, and kill him, and he had no sentence worthy of death, for he did not hate him in time past.

title: Deuteronomy 19:7
text: Therefore I command you saying, You shall separate three cities for you.

title: Deuteronomy 19:8
text: And if the LORD your God makes your border larger, as He has sworn to your fathers, and gives you all the land which He promised to give to your fathers;

title: Deuteronomy 19:9
text: if you will keep all these commandments which I command you today, to do them, to love the LORD your God, and to walk always in His ways, then you shall add to yourself three more cities to these three,

title: Deuteronomy 19:10
text: so that innocent blood may not be shed in your land which the LORD your God gives you [for] an inheritance and blood may not be on you.

title: Deuteronomy 19:11
text: But if a man hates his neighbor and lies in wait for him and rises up against him and strikes his life from him, so that he dies, and flees to one of these cities,

title: Deuteronomy 19:12
text: then the elders of his city shall send and bring him away from there and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood so that he may die.

title: Deuteronomy 19:13
text: Your eye shall not pity him, but you shall put away innocent blood from Israel, so that it may go well with you.

title: Deuteronomy 19:14
text: You may not remove your neighbor's landmark, which those in the past have set in your inheritance, which you shall inherit in the land which the LORD your God gives you to possess it.

title: Deuteronomy 19:15
text: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin, in any sin that he sins. At the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall the matter be made sure.

title: Deuteronomy 19:16
text: If a false witness rises up against any man to testify a falling away against him,

title: Deuteronomy 19:17
text: then both the men who are disagreeing shall stand before the LORD, before the priests and the judges which shall be in those days.

title: Deuteronomy 19:18
text: And the judges shall make careful inquiry. And behold, [if] the witness [is] a false witness [and] has testified falsely against his brother,

title: Deuteronomy 19:19
text: then you shall do to him as he had thought to have done to his brother. So you shall put the evil away from among you.

title: Deuteronomy 19:20
text: And those who remain shall hear and fear, and shall commit from then on no such evil among you.

title: Deuteronomy 19:21
text: And your eye shall not pity. Life [shall go] for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

title: Deuteronomy 20:1
text: When you go out to battle against your enemies and see horses and chariots, a people more than you, do not be afraid of them. For the LORD your God [is] with you, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt.

title: Deuteronomy 20:2
text: And it shall be, when you come near to the battle, the priest shall go up and speak to the people,

title: Deuteronomy 20:3
text: and shall say to them, Hear, O, Israel, today you go up to battle against your enemies. Do not let your hearts faint, do not fear, and do not tremble, neither be terrified before their faces.

title: Deuteronomy 20:4
text: For the LORD your God [is] He who goes with you to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.

title: Deuteronomy 20:5
text: And the officers shall speak to the people saying, Who [is] the man that has built a new house and has not dedicated it? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle and another man dedicate it.

title: Deuteronomy 20:6
text: And who [is] the man that has planted a vineyard and has not used its fruits? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle and another man use its fruits.

title: Deuteronomy 20:7
text: And who [is] the man that has become engaged to a wife and has not taken her? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle and another man take her.

title: Deuteronomy 20:8
text: And the officers shall speak further to the people, and they shall say, Who [is] the man that is fearful and faint-hearted? Let him go and return to his house, lest his brothers' heart faint as well as his heart.

title: Deuteronomy 20:9
text: And it shall be, when the officers have made an end of speaking to the people, they shall make captains of the armies to lead the people.

title: Deuteronomy 20:10
text: When you come near a city to fight against it, then shout peace to it.

title: Deuteronomy 20:11
text: And it shall be, if it makes the answer of peace and opens to you, then all the people found in it shall be forced laborers to you, and they shall serve you.

title: Deuteronomy 20:12
text: But if it will make no peace with you, but will make war against you, then you shall besiege it.

title: Deuteronomy 20:13
text: And when the LORD your God has delivered it into your hands, you shall strike every male of it with the edge of the sword.

title: Deuteronomy 20:14
text: But the women, and the little ones, and the cattle, and all that it is in the city, all the spoil of it, you shall take to yourself. And you shall eat the spoil of your enemies, which the LORD your God has given you.

title: Deuteronomy 20:15
text: So you shall do to all the cities [which are] very far off from you, which are not of the cities of these nations.

title: Deuteronomy 20:16
text: But of the cities of these people, which the LORD your God gives you [for] an inheritance, you shall save alive nothing that breathes.

title: Deuteronomy 20:17
text: But you shall utterly destroy them: the Hittites, and the Amorites, the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, the Hivites and the Jebusites; as the LORD your God has commanded you,

title: Deuteronomy 20:18
text: so that they may not teach you to do according to all their abominations which they have done to their gods. So you would sin against the LORD your God.

title: Deuteronomy 20:19
text: When you shall besiege a city a long time in making war against it to take it, you shall not destroy its trees by forcing an axe against them. For you may eat of them, and you shall not cut them down. For [is] the tree of the field a man that it should go before you to lay siege?

title: Deuteronomy 20:20
text: Only the trees which you know that they [are] not trees for food, you shall destroy and cut them down. And you shall build bulwarks against the city that makes war with you, until it is subdued.

title: Deuteronomy 21:1
text: If [one] is found dead in the land which the LORD your God gives you to possess it, lying in the field, and it is not known who has killed him,

title: Deuteronomy 21:2
text: then your elders and your judges shall come forth. And they shall measure to the cities which [are] around him who is dead.

title: Deuteronomy 21:3
text: And it shall be, the city nearest to the slain one, even the elders of that city shall take a heifer which has not been worked with, which has not drawn in the yoke.

title: Deuteronomy 21:4
text: And the elders of that city shall bring down the heifer to an ever-flowing stream, which is neither plowed nor sown, and shall strike off the heifer's neck there in the stream.

title: Deuteronomy 21:5
text: And the priests, the sons of Levi, shall come near. For the LORD your God has chosen them to minister to him, and to bless in the name of the LORD, and by their word shall every controversy and every stroke be [tried].

title: Deuteronomy 21:6
text: And all the elders of that city nearest to the slain one, shall wash their hands over the heifer that has been beheaded in the stream.

title: Deuteronomy 21:7
text: And they shall answer and say, Our hands have not shed this blood, neither have our eyes seen.

title: Deuteronomy 21:8
text: Be merciful, O LORD, to Your people Israel, whom You have redeemed, and do not lay innocent blood to the charge of Your people Israel. And the blood shall be forgiven them.

title: Deuteronomy 21:9
text: So you shall put away innocent blood from among you, when you do the right in the sight of the LORD.

title: Deuteronomy 21:10
text: When you go forth to war against your enemies, and the LORD your God has delivered them into your hands and you have taken them captive,

title: Deuteronomy 21:11
text: and see among the captives a beautiful woman, and have a desire to her, that you would take [her] for your wife,

title: Deuteronomy 21:12
text: then you shall bring her home to your house. And she shall shave her head and dress her nails.

title: Deuteronomy 21:13
text: And she shall put off the clothing of her captivity, and shall remain in your house, and shall sorrow for her father and her mother a full month. And after that you shall go in to her and be her husband, and she shall be your wife.

title: Deuteronomy 21:14
text: And it shall be, if you have no delight in her, then you shall let her go where she will. But you shall not sell her at all for silver, you shall not make a slave of her, because you have humbled her.

title: Deuteronomy 21:15
text: If a man has two wives, one beloved and another hated, and they have borne him sons, the beloved and the hated; and [if] the first-born son was of her that was hated,

title: Deuteronomy 21:16
text: then it shall be in the day when he makes his sons to inherit what he has, he may not cause to [inherit] the son of the beloved first-born before the son of the hated one, he who [is truly] the first-born.

title: Deuteronomy 21:17
text: But he shall acknowledge the son of the hated as the first-born by giving him a double portion of all that he has. For he [is] the beginning of his strength. The right of the first-born is his.

title: Deuteronomy 21:18
text: If a man has a son who is stubborn and rebels, who will not obey his fathers voice or his mothers voice, even when they have chastened him [he] will not listen to them,

title: Deuteronomy 21:19
text: then his father and his mother shall lay hold on him and bring him out to the elders of his city, and to the gate of his place.

title: Deuteronomy 21:20
text: And they shall say to the elders of his city, this son of ours [is] stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey our voice. [He is] a glutton and a drunkard.

title: Deuteronomy 21:21
text: And all the men of his city shall stone him with stones so that he dies. So shall you put evil away from you, and all Israel shall hear and fear.

title: Deuteronomy 21:22
text: And if a man has committed a sin worthy of death, and if he is put to death and you hang him on a tree,

title: Deuteronomy 21:23
text: his body shall not remain all night on the tree. But you shall surely bury him that day (for he that [is] hanged is accursed of God), so that your land may not be defiled, which the LORD your God gives you [for] an inheritance.

title: Deuteronomy 22:1
text: You shall not see your brother's ox or his sheep go astray and hide yourself from them. You shall surely bring them again to your brother.

title: Deuteronomy 22:2
text: And if your brother [is] not near you, or if you do not know him, then you shall bring [it] into your own house, and it shall be with you until your brother seeks after it, and you shall give it back to him again.

title: Deuteronomy 22:3
text: In the same way you shall do with his ass. And so shall you do with his clothing. And with any lost thing of your brother's, which he has lost and you have found, you shall do the same. You may not hide yourself.

title: Deuteronomy 22:4
text: You shall not see your brother's ass or his ox fall down by the way, and hide yourself from them. You shall surely [help] him to lift [it] up again.

title: Deuteronomy 22:5
text: There shall not be the thing of a man on a woman, neither shall a man put a woman's garment on. For all that do so [are] abominable to the LORD your God.

title: Deuteronomy 22:6
text: If a bird's nest happens to be before you in the way in any tree, or on the ground, [with] young ones or eggs, and the dam sitting on the young or on the eggs, you shall not take the mother with the young.

title: Deuteronomy 22:7
text: You shall in every case let the mother go and take the young for yourself, so that it may be well with you, and you may make [your] days longer.

title: Deuteronomy 22:8
text: When you build a new house, then you shall make a guard rail for your roof, so that you do not bring blood on your house, if one falls from it.

title: Deuteronomy 22:9
text: You shall not sow your vineyard with different kinds of seeds, lest the fruit of your seed which you have sown and the fruit of your vineyard be defiled.

title: Deuteronomy 22:10
text: You shall not plow with an ox and an ass together.

title: Deuteronomy 22:11
text: You shall not wear a garment of different kinds, of wool and linen together.

title: Deuteronomy 22:12
text: You shall make for yourself tassels on the four corners of your cloak with which you cover.

title: Deuteronomy 22:13
text: If any man takes a wife and goes in to her, and hates her,

title: Deuteronomy 22:14
text: and makes shameful charges against her, and brings up an evil name on her, and says, I took this woman, and when I came to her, I did not find in her the tokens of virginity,

title: Deuteronomy 22:15
text: then shall the father of the girl, and her mother, take and bring tokens of the girl's virginity to the elders of the city in the gate.

title: Deuteronomy 22:16
text: And the girl's father shall say to the elders, I gave my daughter to this man to wife, and he hates her.

title: Deuteronomy 22:17
text: And, lo, he has made shameful charges [against her], saying, I have not found in your daughter the tokens of virginity. And yet these are the tokens of my daughter's virginity. And they shall spread the cloth before the elders of the city.

title: Deuteronomy 22:18
text: And the elders of that city shall take that man and punish him.

title: Deuteronomy 22:19
text: And they shall fine him a hundred [shekels] of silver, and give them to the father of the girl, because he has brought an evil name on a virgin of Israel. And she shall be his wife. He may not put her away all his days.

title: Deuteronomy 22:20
text: But if this thing is true and tokens of virginity are not found for the girl,

title: Deuteronomy 22:21
text: then they shall bring the girl out to the door of her father's house, and the men of her city shall stone her with stones so that she dies because she has done foolishness in Israel to play the harlot in her father's house. So you shall put evil away from among you.

title: Deuteronomy 22:22
text: If a man is found lying with a woman married to a husband, then they shall both of them die, the man that lay with the woman, and the woman. So you shall put away evil from Israel.

title: Deuteronomy 22:23
text: If a girl [who is] a virgin is engaged to a husband, and a man finds her in the city and lies with her,

title: Deuteronomy 22:24
text: then you shall bring them both out to the gate of that city, and you shall stone them with stones that they die; the girl because she did not cry out in the city, and the man because he has humbled his neighbor's wife. So you shall put away evil from among you.

title: Deuteronomy 22:25
text: But if a man finds an engaged girl in the field, and the man forces her and lies with her, then only the man that lay with her shall die.

title: Deuteronomy 22:26
text: But you shall do nothing to the girl. No sin [worthy] of death [is] in the girl; for as when a man rises against his neighbor and slays him, even so is this matter.

title: Deuteronomy 22:27
text: For he found her in the field, the engaged girl cried out, but [there was] none to save her.

title: Deuteronomy 22:28
text: If a man finds a girl, a virgin not engaged, and lays hold on her, and lies with her, and they are found,

title: Deuteronomy 22:29
text: then the man who lay with her shall give to the girl's father fifty [shekels] of silver, and she shall be his wife. Because he has humbled her, he may not put her away all his days.

title: Deuteronomy 22:30
text: A man shall not take his father's wife, nor uncover his father's skirt.

title: Deuteronomy 23:1
text: He who is wounded, crushed, or who has his male member cut off, shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD.

title: Deuteronomy 23:2
text: A bastard shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD. Even to his tenth generation he shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD.

title: Deuteronomy 23:3
text: An Ammonite or Moabite shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD. Even to their tenth generation they shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD forever,

title: Deuteronomy 23:4
text: because they did not meet you with bread and with water in the way when you came forth out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor, of Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse you.

title: Deuteronomy 23:5
text: But the LORD your God would not listen to Balaam, but the LORD your God turned the curse to a blessing to you, because the LORD your God loved you.

title: Deuteronomy 23:6
text: You shall not seek their peace nor their prosperity all your days forever.

title: Deuteronomy 23:7
text: You shall not despise an Edomite, for he [is] your brother. You shall not despise an Egyptian, because you were a stranger in his land.

title: Deuteronomy 23:8
text: The sons that are born to them shall enter into the congregation of the LORD in their third generation.

title: Deuteronomy 23:9
text: When the army goes forth against your enemies, then keep yourself from every wicked thing.

title: Deuteronomy 23:10
text: If there is among you any man who is not clean because of an accident at night, then he shall go outside the camp. He shall not come inside the camp.

title: Deuteronomy 23:11
text: And it shall be as evening turns, he shall wash with water. And when the sun is down, he shall come into the the middle of the camp.

title: Deuteronomy 23:12
text: You shall also have a place outside the camp where you shall go forth.

title: Deuteronomy 23:13
text: And you shall have a paddle on your weapon. And it shall be, when you sit down outside, you shall dig with it, and shall turn back and cover that which comes from you.

title: Deuteronomy 23:14
text: For the LORD your God walks in the middle of your camp, to deliver you and to give up your enemies before you. Therefore your camp shall be holy, so that He may see no unclean thing in you and turn away from you.

title: Deuteronomy 23:15
text: You shall not deliver to his master the servant who has escaped from his master to you.

title: Deuteronomy 23:16
text: He shall live with you, among you, in that place which he shall choose in one of your gates, where it seems good to him. You shall not oppress him.

title: Deuteronomy 23:17
text: There shall be no harlot of the daughters of Israel, nor a sodomite of the sons of Israel.

title: Deuteronomy 23:18
text: You shall not bring the hire of a harlot, or the price of a dog, into the house of the LORD your God for any vow. For even both these [are] hateful to the LORD your God.

title: Deuteronomy 23:19
text: You shall not lend for interest to your brother, interest of silver, interest of food, interest of anything that is loaned on interest.

title: Deuteronomy 23:20
text: You may lend on interest to a stranger, but you shall not lend on interest to your brother, so that the LORD your God may bless you in all that you set your hand to in the land where you go to possess it.

title: Deuteronomy 23:21
text: When you shall vow a vow to the LORD your God, you shall not wait to pay it, for the LORD your God will surely require it of you, and it would be sin in you.

title: Deuteronomy 23:22
text: But if you shall cease to vow, it shall be no sin in you.

title: Deuteronomy 23:23
text: That which has gone out of your lips you shall keep and perform, even a free-will offering, according as you have vowed to the LORD your God, which you have promised with your mouth.

title: Deuteronomy 23:24
text: When you come into your neighbor's vineyard, then you may eat grapes to your fill at your own pleasure, but you shall not put [any] in your vessel.

title: Deuteronomy 23:25
text: When you come into the standing grain of your neighbor, then you may pluck the heads with your hand, but you shall not move a sickle into your neighbor's standing grain.

title: Deuteronomy 24:1
text: When a man has taken a wife and married her, and it happens that she finds no favor in his eyes, because he has found some uncleanness in her, then let him write her a bill of divorce and put [it] in her hand, and send her out of his house.

title: Deuteronomy 24:2
text: And when she has departed from his house, she goes and becomes another man's;

title: Deuteronomy 24:3
text: and the latter husband hates her and writes her a bill of divorce and puts [it] in her hand and sends her out of his house; or if the latter husband dies, he who took her to be his wife

title: Deuteronomy 24:4
text: her former husband, who sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife after she is defiled. For that [is] hateful before the LORD. And you shall not cause the land to sin, which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance.

title: Deuteronomy 24:5
text: When a man has taken a new wife, he shall not go out to war, neither shall he be charged with any duty. He shall be free at home one year, and shall cheer up his wife whom he has taken.

title: Deuteronomy 24:6
text: No man shall take the lower or the upper millstone to pledge, for he takes [a man's] life to pledge.

title: Deuteronomy 24:7
text: If a man is found stealing a person of his brothers, the sons of Israel, and makes a slave of him, or sells him, then that thief shall die. And you shall put evil away from among you.

title: Deuteronomy 24:8
text: Be careful in the plague of leprosy, that you watch carefully and do according to all that the priests the Levites shall teach you. As I commanded them, you shall be careful to do.

title: Deuteronomy 24:9
text: Remember what the LORD your God did to Miriam by the wayside, after you had come forth out of Egypt.

title: Deuteronomy 24:10
text: When you loan a loan of any kind to your brother, you shall not go into his house to bring forth his pledge.

title: Deuteronomy 24:11
text: You shall stand outside, and the man to whom you loan shall bring the pledge outside to you.

title: Deuteronomy 24:12
text: And if the man [is] poor, you shall not sleep with his pledge.

title: Deuteronomy 24:13
text: You shall certainly give back to him the pledge at sundown, that he may sleep in his own clothing, and bless you. And it shall be righteousness to you before the LORD your God.

title: Deuteronomy 24:14
text: You shall not oppress a hired servant who [is] poor and needy, of your brothers, or of your strangers that [are] in your land within your gates.

title: Deuteronomy 24:15
text: At his day you shall give [him] his hire, neither shall the sun go down on it. For he [is] poor and sets his heart on it; lest he cry against you to the LORD, and it shall be sin to you.

title: Deuteronomy 24:16
text: The fathers shall not be put to death for the sons, neither shall the sons be put to death for the fathers. Every man shall be put to death for his own sin.

title: Deuteronomy 24:17
text: You shall not pervert the rightful judgment of the stranger [nor] of the fatherless; nor take a widow's clothing to pledge.

title: Deuteronomy 24:18
text: But you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you from there. Therefore I command you to do this thing.

title: Deuteronomy 24:19
text: When you cut down your harvest in your field, and have forgotten a sheaf in the field, you shall not go again to bring it. It shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow; so that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hand.

title: Deuteronomy 24:20
text: When you beat your olive tree, you shall not go over the boughs again. It shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow.

title: Deuteronomy 24:21
text: When you gather the grapes from your vineyard, you shall not glean afterward. It shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow.

title: Deuteronomy 24:22
text: And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt. Therefore I command you to do this thing.

title: Deuteronomy 25:1
text: If there is a controversy between men, and they come to judgment, and they have been judged, and the righteous one is declared righteous, and the wrongdoer declared guilty,

title: Deuteronomy 25:2
text: then it shall be, if the wrongdoer [is] worthy to be beaten, the judge shall cause him to fall down. And one shall strike him in his presence, enough for his wrong, by a certain number.

title: Deuteronomy 25:3
text: He may give him forty stripes, no more, lest he should exceed and beat him above these [with] many stripes, then your brother would be dishonored before your eyes.

title: Deuteronomy 25:4
text: You shall not muzzle an ox when he treads out [the grain].

title: Deuteronomy 25:5
text: If brothers live together, and one of them dies and has no child, the wife of the dead shall not marry outside to a stranger. Her husband's brother shall go in to her and take her as a wife for himself, and perform the duty of a husband's brother to her.

title: Deuteronomy 25:6
text: And it shall be, the first-born whom she bears shall succeed in the name of his dead brother, so that his name may not be put out of Israel.

title: Deuteronomy 25:7
text: And if the man does not want to take his brother's wife, then let his brother's wife go up to the gate to the elders and say, My husband's brother refuses to raise up a name in Israel to his brother. He will not perform my levirate.

title: Deuteronomy 25:8
text: Then the elders of his city shall call him and speak to him. And [if] he stands and says, I do not desire to take her,

title: Deuteronomy 25:9
text: then his brother's wife shall come to him in the presence of his elders, and take off his shoe from his foot, and spit in his face, and shall answer and say, So shall it be done to that man who will not build up his brother's house.

title: Deuteronomy 25:10
text: And his name shall be called in Israel, The house of him who has his shoe taken off.

title: Deuteronomy 25:11
text: When men strive together with one another, and the wife of the one draws near to deliver her husband out of the hand of him who strikes him, and puts forth her hand and takes him by the secret parts,

title: Deuteronomy 25:12
text: then you shall cut off her hand. Your eye shall not pity.

title: Deuteronomy 25:13
text: You shall not have in your bag two kinds of weights, a great stone and a small.

title: Deuteronomy 25:14
text: You shall not have in your house two kinds of measures, a great ephah and a small.

title: Deuteronomy 25:15
text: You shall have a perfect and just weight, a perfect and just measure you shall have, so that your days may be lengthened in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

title: Deuteronomy 25:16
text: For all that do such things, all that do unrighteousness, [are] hateful to the LORD your God.

title: Deuteronomy 25:17
text: Remember what Amalek did to you by the way, when you came forth out of Egypt,

title: Deuteronomy 25:18
text: how he met you by the way and struck those of you who were behind, all the feeble behind you, when you [were] faint and weary. And he did not fear God.

title: Deuteronomy 25:19
text: And it shall be when the LORD your God has given you rest from all your enemies all around in the land which the LORD your God gives you [for] an inheritance to possess it, you shall blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heavens. You shall not forget.

title: Deuteronomy 26:1
text: And it shall be, when you come into the land which the LORD you God gives you for an inheritance, and possess it, and live in it,

title: Deuteronomy 26:2
text: you shall take of the first of all the fruit of the earth which you shall bring of your land that the LORD your God gives you, and you shall put [it] in a basket, and shall go to the place which the LORD your God shall choose to place His name there.

title: Deuteronomy 26:3
text: And you shall go to the priest in those days, and say to him, I profess today to the LORD your God that I have come into the land which the LORD swore to our fathers to give us.

title: Deuteronomy 26:4
text: And the priest shall take the basket out of your hand and set it down before the altar of the LORD your God.

title: Deuteronomy 26:5
text: And you shall speak and say before the LORD your God, My father [was] a Syrian ready to perish. And he went down to Egypt, and stayed there with a few, and became there a nation, great, mighty, and many.

title: Deuteronomy 26:6
text: And the Egyptians ill-treated us, and afflicted us, and laid hard bondage on us.

title: Deuteronomy 26:7
text: And when we cried to the LORD God of our fathers, the LORD heard our voice and looked on our afflictions and our labor and our oppression.

title: Deuteronomy 26:8
text: And the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with fearful might, and with miracles and with wonders.

title: Deuteronomy 26:9
text: And He has brought us into this place, and has given us this land, a land that flows with milk and honey.

title: Deuteronomy 26:10
text: And now, behold, I have brought the firstfruits of the land which You, O LORD, have given me. And you shall set it before the LORD your God, and worship before the LORD your God.

title: Deuteronomy 26:11
text: And [you shall] rejoice in all the good which the LORD your God has given to you, and to your house; you, and the Levite, and the stranger in your midst.

title: Deuteronomy 26:12
text: When you have made an end of tithing all the tithes of your increase the third year, the year of tithing, and have given [it] to the Levite, the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow (that they may eat inside your gates and be filled),

title: Deuteronomy 26:13
text: then you shall say before the LORD your God, I have brought away the holy things out of my house, and also have given them to the Levite, and to the stranger, to the fatherless, and to the widow, according to all Your commandments which You have commanded me. I have not broken Your commandments, neither have I forgotten.

title: Deuteronomy 26:14
text: I have not eaten of it in my mourning, neither have I put [any] of it away for unclean [use], nor have I given of it for the dead. I have listened to the voice of the LORD my God, and have done according to all that You have commanded me.

title: Deuteronomy 26:15
text: Look down from Your holy dwelling, from Heaven, and bless Your people Israel and the land which You have given us, as You swore to our fathers, a land that flows with milk and honey.

title: Deuteronomy 26:16
text: Today the LORD your God has commanded you to do these statutes and judgments. You therefore shall keep and do them with all your heart and with all your soul.

title: Deuteronomy 26:17
text: You have today said that the LORD is your God, and that you would walk in His ways, and keep His statutes and His commandments and His judgments, and listen to His voice.

title: Deuteronomy 26:18
text: And the LORD has taken you today to be His peculiar people, as He has promised you, and to keep all His commandments,

title: Deuteronomy 26:19
text: and to make you high above all nations which he has made, in praise and in name and in honor, and that you may be a holy people to the LORD your God, even as He has spoken.

title: Deuteronomy 27:1
text: And Moses with the elders of Israel commanded the people saying, Keep all the commandments which I command you today.

title: Deuteronomy 27:2
text: And it will be, on the day when you shall pass over Jordan to the land which the LORD your God gives you, you shall set up great stones and plaster them with plaster.

title: Deuteronomy 27:3
text: And you shall write on them all the words of the law when you have passed over, so that you may go in to the land which the LORD your God gives you, a land that flows [with] milk and honey, as the LORD God of your fathers has promised you.

title: Deuteronomy 27:4
text: Therefore it shall be when you have gone over Jordan, you shall set up these stones which I command you today, in Mount Ebal. And you shall plaster them with plaster.

title: Deuteronomy 27:5
text: And you shall build an altar there to the LORD your God, an altar of stones. You shall not lift up [any] iron [tool] on them.

title: Deuteronomy 27:6
text: You shall build the altar of the LORD your God [of] uncut stones, and you shall offer burnt offerings on it to the LORD your God.

title: Deuteronomy 27:7
text: And you shall offer peace offerings, and shall eat there, and rejoice before the LORD your God.

title: Deuteronomy 27:8
text: And you shall write all the words of this law very plainly on the stones.

title: Deuteronomy 27:9
text: And Moses and the priests the Levites spoke to all Israel, saying: Take heed and listen, O Israel. Today you have become the people of the LORD your God.

title: Deuteronomy 27:10
text: You shall therefore obey the voice of the LORD your God, and do His commandments and His statutes which I command you today.

title: Deuteronomy 27:11
text: And Moses charged the people the same day, saying,

title: Deuteronomy 27:12
text: These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people when you have come over Jordan: Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin.

title: Deuteronomy 27:13
text: And these shall stand on Mount Ebal to curse: Reuben, Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

title: Deuteronomy 27:14
text: And the Levites shall speak and say to all the men of Israel with a loud voice,

title: Deuteronomy 27:15
text: Cursed [is] the man that makes any graven or molten image, an abomination to the LORD, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and puts [it] in a secret place. And all the people shall answer and say, Amen.

title: Deuteronomy 27:16
text: Cursed [is] he who thinks lightly of his father or his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.

title: Deuteronomy 27:17
text: Cursed [is] he who removes his neighbor's landmark. And all the people shall say, Amen.

title: Deuteronomy 27:18
text: Cursed [is] he who makes the blind to wander out of the way. And all the people shall say, Amen.

title: Deuteronomy 27:19
text: Cursed [is] he who perverts the judgment of the stranger, fatherless, and widow. And all the people shall say, Amen.

title: Deuteronomy 27:20
text: Cursed [is] he who lies with his father's wife, because he uncovers his father's skirt. And all the people shall say, Amen.

title: Deuteronomy 27:21
text: Cursed [is] he who lies with any kind of animal. And all the people shall say, Amen.

title: Deuteronomy 27:22
text: Cursed [is] he who lies with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.

title: Deuteronomy 27:23
text: Cursed [is] he who lies with his mother-in-law. And all the people shall say, Amen.

title: Deuteronomy 27:24
text: Cursed [is] he who strikes his neighbor secretly. And all the people shall say, Amen.

title: Deuteronomy 27:25
text: Cursed [is] he who takes reward to kill an innocent person. And all the people shall say, Amen.

title: Deuteronomy 27:26
text: Cursed [is] he who does not confirm [all] the words of this law, to do them. And all the people shall say, Amen.

title: Deuteronomy 28:1
text: And it will be, if you shall listen carefully to the voice of the LORD your God, to observe [and] to do all His commandments which I command you today, the LORD your God will set you on high above all nations of the earth.

title: Deuteronomy 28:2
text: And all these blessings shall come on you and overtake you, if you will listen to the voice of the LORD your God.

title: Deuteronomy 28:3
text: You [shall be] blessed in the city, and be blessed in the field.

title: Deuteronomy 28:4
text: The fruit of your body [shall be] blessed, and the fruit of your ground, and the fruit of your cattle, the increase of your cows, and the flocks of your sheep.

title: Deuteronomy 28:5
text: Your basket and your store [shall be] blessed.

title: Deuteronomy 28:6
text: You [shall be] blessed when you come in, and blessed when you go out.

title: Deuteronomy 28:7
text: The LORD shall cause your enemies that rise up against you to be stricken before your face. They shall come out against you one way, and flee before you seven ways.

title: Deuteronomy 28:8
text: The LORD shall command the blessing on you in your storehouses, and all that you set your hand to. And He shall bless you in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

title: Deuteronomy 28:9
text: The LORD shall establish you a holy people to Himself, as He has sworn to you, if you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God and walk in His ways.

title: Deuteronomy 28:10
text: And all the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by the name of the LORD, and they shall be afraid of you.

title: Deuteronomy 28:11
text: And the LORD shall prosper you in goods, in the fruit of your body, and in the fruit of your cattle, and in the fruit of your ground, in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give you.

title: Deuteronomy 28:12
text: The LORD shall open to you His good treasure, the heaven to give the rain to your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand. And you shall loan to many nations, and you shall not borrow.

title: Deuteronomy 28:13
text: And the LORD shall make you the head, and not the tail. And you shall be always above, and you shall not be beneath, if you listen to the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you today, to observe and to do them.

title: Deuteronomy 28:14
text: And you shall not go aside from any of the words which I command you today, to the right hand or the left, to go after other gods to serve them.

title: Deuteronomy 28:15
text: And it shall be, if you will not listen to the voice of the LORD your God, to observe and to do all His commandments and His statutes which I command you today, all these curses shall come on you and overtake you.

title: Deuteronomy 28:16
text: You [shall be] cursed in the city, and cursed in the field.

title: Deuteronomy 28:17
text: Your basket and your store [shall be] cursed.

title: Deuteronomy 28:18
text: The fruit of your body [shall be] cursed, and the fruit of your land, the increase of your cows, and the flocks of your sheep.

title: Deuteronomy 28:19
text: You [shall be] cursed when you come in, and cursed when you go out.

title: Deuteronomy 28:20
text: The LORD shall send on you cursing, vexation, and rebuke, in all that you set your hand to do, until you are destroyed, and until you perish quickly, because of the wickedness of your doings [by] which you have forsaken Me.

title: Deuteronomy 28:21
text: The LORD shall make the plague cling to you until He has consumed you from off the land where you go to possess it.

title: Deuteronomy 28:22
text: The LORD shall strike you with lung disease and with a fever, and with an inflammation, and with an extreme burning, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew. And they shall pursue you until you perish.

title: Deuteronomy 28:23
text: And your heavens over your head shall be bronze, and the earth that is under you iron.

title: Deuteronomy 28:24
text: The LORD shall make the rain of your land powder and dust. It shall come down from the heavens on you until you are destroyed.

title: Deuteronomy 28:25
text: The LORD shall cause you to be stricken before your enemies. You shall go out one way against them, and flee seven ways before them. And you shall be a trembling to all the kingdoms of the earth.

title: Deuteronomy 28:26
text: And your body shall be food to all birds of the air, and to the beasts of the earth. And no man shall frighten [them] away.

title: Deuteronomy 28:27
text: The LORD will strike you with the boils of Egypt, and with the hemorrhoids, and with the scab, and with the itch, of which you cannot be healed.

title: Deuteronomy 28:28
text: The LORD shall strike you with madness and blindness, and astonishment of heart.

title: Deuteronomy 28:29
text: And you shall grope at noonday, as the blind gropes in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways. And you shall always be pressed down and spoiled forever, and no man shall save you.

title: Deuteronomy 28:30
text: You shall become engaged to a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You shall build a house, and you shall not live in it. You shall plant a vineyard, and you shall not gather the grapes of it.

title: Deuteronomy 28:31
text: Your ox [shall be] slain before your eyes, and you shall not eat of it. Your ass [shall be] violently taken away from before your face, and shall not be restored to you, your sheep given to your enemies, and you [shall have]  none to rescue them.

title: Deuteronomy 28:32
text: Your sons and your daughters [shall be] given to another people, and your eyes shall look and fail for them all the day long. And [there shall be] no power in your hand.

title: Deuteronomy 28:33
text: The fruit of your land, and all your labors, shall be eaten up by a nation which you do not know. And you shall always be oppressed and crushed,

title: Deuteronomy 28:34
text: and you shall be mad because of that which you shall see with the sight of your eyes.

title: Deuteronomy 28:35
text: The LORD shall strike you in the knees and in the legs with an evil ulcer that cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the top of your head.

title: Deuteronomy 28:36
text: The LORD shall bring you, and your king which you shall set over you, to a nation which neither you nor your fathers have known. And there you shall serve other gods, wood and stone.

title: Deuteronomy 28:37
text: And you shall become an astonishment, a proverb, and a by-word among all nations where the LORD shall lead you.

title: Deuteronomy 28:38
text: You shall carry much seed out into the field, and shall gather little in, for the locust shall eat it.

title: Deuteronomy 28:39
text: You shall plant vineyards and dress [them], but shall neither drink the wine nor gather, for the worm shall eat them.

title: Deuteronomy 28:40
text: You shall have olive trees throughout all your coasts, but you shall not anoint [with] the oil, for your olive shall drop off [its fruit].

title: Deuteronomy 28:41
text: You shall father sons and daughters, but you shall not enjoy them, for they shall go into captivity.

title: Deuteronomy 28:42
text: All your trees and the fruit of your land the locust shall possess.

title: Deuteronomy 28:43
text: The stranger within you shall get up above you very high, and you shall come down very low.

title: Deuteronomy 28:44
text: He shall loan to you, and you shall not loan to him. He shall be the head, and you shall be the tail.

title: Deuteronomy 28:45
text: And all these curses shall come on you, and shall pursue you and overtake you, until you are destroyed, because you did not listen to the voice of the LORD your God, to keep His commandments and His statutes which He commanded you.

title: Deuteronomy 28:46
text: And they shall be on you for a sign and for a wonder, and on your seed forever.

title: Deuteronomy 28:47
text: Because you did not serve the LORD your God with joyfulness and with gladness of heart for the abundance of all [things];

title: Deuteronomy 28:48
text: therefore you shall serve your enemies which the LORD shall send against you, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in the lack of all [things]. And he shall put a yoke of iron on your neck until he has destroyed you.

title: Deuteronomy 28:49
text: The LORD shall bring a nation against you from far, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flies; a nation whose tongue you shall not understand,

title: Deuteronomy 28:50
text: a nation fierce of face who shall not regard the person of the old, nor show favor to the young.

title: Deuteronomy 28:51
text: And he shall eat the fruit of your cattle and the fruit of your land, until you are destroyed. He shall not leave you grain, wine, or oil, the increase of your livestock, or flocks of your sheep, until he has destroyed you.

title: Deuteronomy 28:52
text: And he shall besiege you in all your gates until your high and fortified walls in which you trusted come down, throughout all the land. And he shall besiege you in all your gates throughout all your land which the LORD your God has given you.

title: Deuteronomy 28:53
text: And you shall eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, which the LORD your God has given you, in the siege and in the anguish with which your enemies shall distress you.

title: Deuteronomy 28:54
text: The man [that is] tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the rest of his sons which he has left;

title: Deuteronomy 28:55
text: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his sons whom he shall eat, because he has nothing left to him in the siege and in the anguish with which your enemies shall distress you in all your gates.

title: Deuteronomy 28:56
text: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not have ventured to set the sole of her foot on the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,

title: Deuteronomy 28:57
text: and toward her young one who comes out from between her feet, and toward her sons whom she shall bear. For she shall eat them secretly for lack of all [things], in the siege and anguish with which your enemies shall distress you in your gates.

title: Deuteronomy 28:58
text: If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and fearful name, THE LORD YOUR GOD,

title: Deuteronomy 28:59
text: then the LORD will make your plagues remarkable, and the plagues of your seed great and persistent plagues; with evil and long-lasting sicknesses.

title: Deuteronomy 28:60
text: Also, He will bring on you all the diseases of Egypt of which you were afraid. And they shall cling to you.

title: Deuteronomy 28:61
text: Also, every sickness and every plague which [is] not written in the book of this law, the LORD will bring them on you until you are destroyed.

title: Deuteronomy 28:62
text: And you shall be left few in number, whereas you were as the stars of the heavens for multitude, because you would not obey the voice of the LORD your God.

title: Deuteronomy 28:63
text: And it shall be, as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good and to multiply you, so the LORD will rejoice over you to destroy you and to bring you to nothing. And you shall be plucked from off the land where you go to possess it.

title: Deuteronomy 28:64
text: And the LORD shall scatter you among all people, from the [one] end of the earth even to the [other], and you shall serve other gods there, which neither you nor your fathers have known, wood and stone.

title: Deuteronomy 28:65
text: And among these nations you shall find no ease, neither shall the sole of your foot have rest. But the LORD shall give you there a trembling heart and failing of eyes and sorrow of mind.

title: Deuteronomy 28:66
text: And your life shall hang in doubt before you, and you shall fear day and night, and shall have no assurance of your life.

title: Deuteronomy 28:67
text: In the morning you shall say, Oh that it were evening! And at evening you shall say, Oh that it were morning, for the fear of your heart with which you shall fear, and for the sight of your eyes which you shall see.

title: Deuteronomy 28:68
text: And the LORD shall bring you into Egypt again with ships, by the way of which I said to you, You shall see it no more again. And there you shall be sold to your enemies for men-slaves and women-slaves, and no man shall buy [you].

title: Deuteronomy 29:1
text: These [are] the words of the covenant which the LORD commanded Moses to make with the sons of Israel in the land of Moab, besides the covenant which He made with them in Horeb.

title: Deuteronomy 29:2
text: And Moses called to all Israel and said to them, You have seen all that the LORD did before your eyes in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh and to all his servants, and to all his land.

title: Deuteronomy 29:3
text: Your eyes have seen the great trials, the signs, and those great miracles.

title: Deuteronomy 29:4
text: Yet the LORD has not given you a heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, until today.

title: Deuteronomy 29:5
text: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness. Your clothes have not become old on you, and your shoe has not become old on your foot.

title: Deuteronomy 29:6
text: You have not eaten bread, neither have you drunk wine or strong drink, so that you might know that I [am] the LORD your God.

title: Deuteronomy 29:7
text: And when you came to this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us to battle, and we struck them.

title: Deuteronomy 29:8
text: And we took their land and gave it for an inheritance to the Reubenites and to the Gadites and to the half tribe of Manasseh.

title: Deuteronomy 29:9
text: Therefore, keep the words of this covenant and do them, so that you may act wisely in all that you do.

title: Deuteronomy 29:10
text: You stand today, all of you, before the LORD your God; your captains of your tribes, your elders, and your officers, all the men of Israel,

title: Deuteronomy 29:11
text: your little ones, your wives, and your stranger that [is] in your camp, from the cutter of your wood to the drawer of your water;

title: Deuteronomy 29:12
text: so that you should enter into covenant with the LORD your God, and into His oath, which the LORD your God makes you today;

title: Deuteronomy 29:13
text: that He may establish you today for a people to Himself, and [that] He may be a God to you, as He has said to you, and as He has sworn to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

title: Deuteronomy 29:14
text: Nor do I make this covenant and this oath with you only,

title: Deuteronomy 29:15
text: but with [him] who stands here with us today before the LORD our God, and also with him that is not here with us today.

title: Deuteronomy 29:16
text: (For you know how we have lived in the land of Egypt, and how we came through the nations which you passed.

title: Deuteronomy 29:17
text: And you have seen their abominations and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which [were] among them)

title: Deuteronomy 29:18
text: lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turns away today from the LORD our God, to go serve the gods of these nations; lest there should be among you a root that bears gall and wormwood,

title: Deuteronomy 29:19
text: and it happens when he hears the words of this curse, that he shall bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart, to snatch away the drunken with the thirsty.

title: Deuteronomy 29:20
text: The LORD will not be willing to forgive him, but then the anger of the LORD and His jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie on him, and the LORD shall blot out his name from under heavens.

title: Deuteronomy 29:21
text: And the LORD shall set him apart to evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law;

title: Deuteronomy 29:22
text: so that the generation to come of your sons that shall rise up after you, and the stranger that shall come from a far land, shall say (when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses which the LORD has laid on it)

title: Deuteronomy 29:23
text: the whole land shall be burned [with] brimstone, and salt; it shall not be sown; nor shall it sprout; nor shall there be any grass in it. It [shall be] like the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, which the LORD overthrew in His anger, and in His wrath,

title: Deuteronomy 29:24
text: even all nations shall say, Why has the LORD done this to this land? [For] what [is] the heat of this great anger?

title: Deuteronomy 29:25
text: Then [men] shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD God of their fathers, which He made with them when He brought them forth out of the land of Egypt.

title: Deuteronomy 29:26
text: For they went and served other gods, and worshiped them, gods whom they did not know, and who had not given to them any portion.

title: Deuteronomy 29:27
text: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against this land, to bring on it all the curses that are written in this book.

title: Deuteronomy 29:28
text: And the LORD rooted them out of their land in anger and wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as [it is] today.

title: Deuteronomy 29:29
text: The secret things [belong] to the LORD our God, but the revealed things [belong] to us and to our sons forever, so that we may do all the words of this law.

title: Deuteronomy 30:1
text: And it shall be when all these things have come on you, the blessing and the curse which I have set before you, and when you shall call [them] to mind among all the nations where the LORD your God has driven you,

title: Deuteronomy 30:2
text: and shall return to the LORD your God and shall obey His voice according to all that I command you today, you and your sons, with all your heart, and with all your soul,

title: Deuteronomy 30:3
text: then the LORD your God will turn your captivity. And He will have compassion on you, and will return and gather you from all the nations where the LORD your God has scattered you.

title: Deuteronomy 30:4
text: If you are driven out into the outermost [parts] of the heavens, the LORD your God will gather you from there, and He will bring you from there.

title: Deuteronomy 30:5
text: And the LORD your God will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you shall possess it. And He will do you good, and multiply you above your fathers.

title: Deuteronomy 30:6
text: And the LORD your God will circumcise your heart and the heart of your seed, to love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul, so that you may live.

title: Deuteronomy 30:7
text: And the LORD your God will put all these curses on your enemies, and on those that hate you, who persecuted you.

title: Deuteronomy 30:8
text: And you shall return and obey the voice of the LORD, and do all His commandments which I command you today.

title: Deuteronomy 30:9
text: And the LORD your God will make you have plenty in every work of your hand, in the fruit of your body, and in the fruit of your cattle, and in the fruit of your land, for good. For the LORD will again rejoice over you for good, as He rejoiced over your fathers;

title: Deuteronomy 30:10
text: for you shall listen to the voice of the LORD your God, to keep His commandments and His statutes which are written in this book of the law, [and] if you turn to the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

title: Deuteronomy 30:11
text: For this commandment which I command you today [is] not hidden from you, neither is it far off.

title: Deuteronomy 30:12
text: It [is] not in Heaven, [that you should] say, Who shall go up for us to Heaven, and bring it to us, so that we may hear it and do it?

title: Deuteronomy 30:13
text: Nor [is] it beyond the sea, [that you should] say, Who shall go over the sea for us to the region beyond the sea, and bring it to us, so that we may hear it and do it?

title: Deuteronomy 30:14
text: But the word [is] very near you, in your mouth and in your heart, so that you may do it.

title: Deuteronomy 30:15
text: Behold! I have set before you today life and good, and death and evil,

title: Deuteronomy 30:16
text: in that I command you today to love the LORD your God, to walk in His ways, and to keep His commandments and His statutes and His judgments, so that you may live and multiply. And the LORD your God shall bless you in the land where you go to possess it.

title: Deuteronomy 30:17
text: But if you turn away your heart, so that you will not hear, but shall be drawn away and worship other gods and serve them,

title: Deuteronomy 30:18
text: I declare to you today that you shall surely perish; you shall not prolong [your] days on the land where you pass over Jordan to go to possess it.

title: Deuteronomy 30:19
text: I call Heaven and earth to record today against you. I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing. Therefore, choose life, so that both you and your seed may live,

title: Deuteronomy 30:20
text: so that you may love the LORD your God, [and] that you may obey His voice, and that you may cling to Him. For He is your life and the length of your days, so that you may dwell in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

title: Deuteronomy 31:1
text: And Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.

title: Deuteronomy 31:2
text: And he said to them, I [am] a hundred twenty years old today. I can no more go out and come in. Also the LORD has said to me, You shall not go over this Jordan.

title: Deuteronomy 31:3
text: The LORD your God will go over before you. He will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall possess them. Joshua [is] the one crossing shall go over before you, as the LORD has said.

title: Deuteronomy 31:4
text: And the LORD shall do to them as He did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and to the land of those whom He destroyed.

title: Deuteronomy 31:5
text: And the LORD shall give them up before your face, so that you may do to them according to all the commandments which I have commanded you.

title: Deuteronomy 31:6
text: Be strong and of a good courage. Do not fear nor be afraid of them. For the LORD your God [is] He who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.

title: Deuteronomy 31:7
text: And Moses called to Joshua and said to him in the sight of all Israel, Be strong and of a good courage. For you must go with this people to the land which the LORD has sworn to their fathers to give [it to] them, and you shall cause them to inherit it.

title: Deuteronomy 31:8
text: And the LORD [is] He who goes before you. He will be with you; He will not fail you nor forsake you. Do not fear; nor be dismayed.

title: Deuteronomy 31:9
text: And Moses wrote this law and delivered it to the priests, the sons of Levi, who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and to all the elders of Israel.

title: Deuteronomy 31:10
text: And Moses commanded them, saying: At the end of seven years, at the set time of the year of release, in the Feast of Tabernacles,

title: Deuteronomy 31:11
text: when all Israel has come to appear before the LORD your God in the place which He shall choose, you shall read this law before all Israel in their hearing.

title: Deuteronomy 31:12
text: Gather the people, men and women and the little ones, and your stranger who [is] within your gates, so that they may hear and that they may learn and fear the LORD your God, and be careful to do all the words of this law,

title: Deuteronomy 31:13
text: and [that] their sons who have not known may hear and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as you live in the land where you go over Jordan to possess it.

title: Deuteronomy 31:14
text: And the LORD said to Moses, Behold, your days are coming near to die. Call Joshua and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation, and that I shall charge him. And Moses and Joshua went. And they presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation.

title: Deuteronomy 31:15
text: And the LORD appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud. And the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.

title: Deuteronomy 31:16
text: And the LORD said to Moses, Behold, you shall sleep with your fathers. And this people shall rise up and go lusting after the gods of the strangers of the land into which they are going, into their midst. And they will forsake Me and break My covenant which I made with them.

title: Deuteronomy 31:17
text: Then My anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them. And I will hide My face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them, so that they will say in that day, Have not these evils come on us because our God [is] not among us?

title: Deuteronomy 31:18
text: And I will surely hide My face in that day for all the evils which they have done, for they shall turn to other gods.

title: Deuteronomy 31:19
text: Now, therefore, write this song for you, and teach it to the sons of Israel. Put it in their mouths, so that this song may be a witness for Me against the sons of Israel.

title: Deuteronomy 31:20
text: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I swore to their fathers, the land that flows [with] milk and honey, and they shall have eat and be satisfied, and become fat, then turn to other gods and serve them, and provoke Me and break My covenant.

title: Deuteronomy 31:21
text: And it shall be when many evils and troubles have found them, this song shall testify against them as a witness. For it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed. For I know their imagination which they do, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I swore.

title: Deuteronomy 31:22
text: And Moses wrote this song the same day, and taught it to the sons of Israel.

title: Deuteronomy 31:23
text: And he commanded Joshua the son of Nun, and said: Be strong and of a good courage. For you shall bring the sons of Israel into the land which I swore to them, and I will be with you.

title: Deuteronomy 31:24
text: And it happened when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,

title: Deuteronomy 31:25
text: Moses commanded the Levites who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD, saying,

title: Deuteronomy 31:26
text: Take this book of the law, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, so that it may be there for a witness against you.

title: Deuteronomy 31:27
text: For I know your rebellion and your stiff neck. Behold, while I am still alive with you today, you have been rebellious against the LORD. And how much more after my death?

title: Deuteronomy 31:28
text: Gather to me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, so that I may speak these words in their ears, and call Heaven and earth to record against them.

title: Deuteronomy 31:29
text: For I know that after my death you will become utterly corrupt, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you. And evil will happen to you in the latter end of the days, because you will do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke Him to anger through the work of your hands.

title: Deuteronomy 31:30
text: And Moses spoke in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song, until their conclusion.

title: Deuteronomy 32:1
text: Give ear, O heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.

title: Deuteronomy 32:2
text: My doctrine shall drop as the rain; my speech shall drop down as the dew, as the small rain on the tender plant, and as the showers on the grass;

title: Deuteronomy 32:3
text: because I will proclaim the name of the LORD, ascribe greatness to our God.

title: Deuteronomy 32:4
text: [He is] the Rock; His work [is] perfect. For all His ways [are] just, a God of faithfulness, and without evil; just and upright is He.

title: Deuteronomy 32:5
text: They have corrupted themselves: [they are] not His sons; [it is] their blemish; [they are] a crooked and perverse generation.

title: Deuteronomy 32:6
text: Do you thus give back to the LORD, Oh foolish and unwise people? [Is] He not your Father who bought you? [Has] He [not] made you and established you?

title: Deuteronomy 32:7
text: Remember the days of old; consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; your elders, and they will tell you.

title: Deuteronomy 32:8
text: When the Most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when He separated the sons of Adam, He set the bounds of the people according to the number of the sons of Israel.

title: Deuteronomy 32:9
text: For the LORD's portion [is] His people. Jacob [is] the lot of His inheritance.

title: Deuteronomy 32:10
text: He found him in a desert land, and in the deserted, howling wilderness. He led him about, He cared for him, He kept him as the pupil of His eye.

title: Deuteronomy 32:11
text: As an eagle stirs up her nest, flutters over her young, spreads abroad her wings, takes them and bears them on her wing,

title: Deuteronomy 32:12
text: the LORD alone led him, and [there was] no strange god with him.

title: Deuteronomy 32:13
text: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, so that he might eat the increase of the fields. And He made him suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock,

title: Deuteronomy 32:14
text: butter from cows, and milk from sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the sons of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat. And you drank the blood of the grape.

title: Deuteronomy 32:15
text: But Jeshurun grew fat and kicked. You grew fat, thick, [and] satisfied. Then he forsook God who made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.

title: Deuteronomy 32:16
text: They provoked Him to jealousy with strange [gods]; with abominations they provoked Him to anger.

title: Deuteronomy 32:17
text: They sacrificed to devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new ones newly come up, whom your fathers did not fear.

title: Deuteronomy 32:18
text: You forgot the Rock [who] brought you forth, and ceased to care for God who formed you.

title: Deuteronomy 32:19
text: And the LORD saw, and despised [them] because of the provoking of His sons and of His daughters.

title: Deuteronomy 32:20
text: And He said, I will hide My face from them; I will see what their end [shall be]. For they [are] a very perverse generation, sons in whom [is] no faithfulness.

title: Deuteronomy 32:21
text: They have moved Me to jealousy with a no-god. They have provoked Me to anger with their vanities. And I will move them to jealousy with a no-people. I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.

title: Deuteronomy 32:22
text: For a fire is kindled in My anger, and shall burn to the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with its increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.

title: Deuteronomy 32:23
text: I will heap evils on them. I will spend My arrows on them.

title: Deuteronomy 32:24
text: Exhaustion by famine, and consumption by burning heat, and bitter destruction, and the teeth of beasts I will send on them, with the poison of crawling things of the dust.

title: Deuteronomy 32:25
text: The sword outside, and the terror inside, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling [also] with the man of grey hairs.
