title: Deuteronomy 32:26
text: I said I would dash them to pieces; I would make the memory of them to cease from among men,

title: Deuteronomy 32:27
text: were it not the provocation of an enemy I feared, lest their enemies should misconstrue; lest they should say, Our hand [is] high and the LORD has not done all this.

title: Deuteronomy 32:28
text: For they [are] a nation without wisdom, neither is there any understanding in them.

title: Deuteronomy 32:29
text: If they were wise, they would understand this; they would consider their latter end!

title: Deuteronomy 32:30
text: How shall one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them and the LORD had shut them up?

title: Deuteronomy 32:31
text: For their rock [is] not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves being judges.

title: Deuteronomy 32:32
text: For their vine [is] of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are grapes of gall. Their clusters [are] bitter.

title: Deuteronomy 32:33
text: Their wine [is] the poison of serpents, and the cruel venom of asps.

title: Deuteronomy 32:34
text: [Is] not this laid up in store with Me and sealed up among My treasures?

title: Deuteronomy 32:35
text: Vengeance and retribution [belong] to Me. Their foot shall slide in time, for the day of their calamity [is] at hand, and the things that shall come on them make haste.

title: Deuteronomy 32:36
text: For the LORD will bring His people justice; and He shall have compassion on His servants, for He sees that [their] power is gone, and only the imprisoned and abandoned [remain].

title: Deuteronomy 32:37
text: And He shall say, Where [are] their gods, [their] rock in whom they trusted?

title: Deuteronomy 32:38
text: Who ate the fat of their sacrifices [and] drank the wine of their drink offerings? Let them rise up and help you; let it be your hiding place.

title: Deuteronomy 32:39
text: See now that I, I am He, and there is no god with me. I kill, and I make alive; I wound and I heal; and there is no deliverer of My hand.

title: Deuteronomy 32:40
text: For I lift up My hand to Heaven and say, I live forever!

title: Deuteronomy 32:41
text: If I sharpen My glittering sword, and if My hand takes hold in judgment, I will give vengeance to My enemies and will reward those that hate Me.

title: Deuteronomy 32:42
text: I will make My arrows drunk with blood, and My sword shall devour flesh, with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the hairy scalp of the enemy.

title: Deuteronomy 32:43
text: Rejoice, O, nations, [with] His people; for He will avenge the blood of His servants, and will render vengeance to His foes and will be merciful to His land, to His people.

title: Deuteronomy 32:44
text: And Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.

title: Deuteronomy 32:45
text: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel.

title: Deuteronomy 32:46
text: And he said to them, Set your hearts to all the words which I testify among you today, which you shall command your sons to observe and to do, all the words of this law.

title: Deuteronomy 32:47
text: For it [is] not a vain thing for you, because it is your life. And by this word you shall prolong [your] days in the land where you go over Jordan, there to possess it.

title: Deuteronomy 32:48
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses that same day, saying,

title: Deuteronomy 32:49
text: Go up into Mount Abarim, [to] Mount Nebo in the land of Moab, which is opposite Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan which I am giving to the sons of Israel for a possession.

title: Deuteronomy 32:50
text: And die in the mountain where you go up, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died in Mount Hor and was gathered to his people,

title: Deuteronomy 32:51
text: because you sinned against Me among the sons of Israel at the Waters of Strife in Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin, because you did not sanctify Me in the midst of the sons of Israel.

title: Deuteronomy 32:52
text: Yet you shall see the land before [you], but you shall not go there to the land which I [am] giving to the sons of Israel.

title: Deuteronomy 33:1
text: And this [is] the blessing [with] which Moses the man of God blessed the sons of Israel before his death.

title: Deuteronomy 33:2
text: And he said: The LORD came from Sinai and rose up from Seir to them. He shone forth from Mount Paran, and He came with ten thousands of saints. From His right went a fiery law for them.

title: Deuteronomy 33:3
text: Yea, He loved the people. All His saints [are] in Your hand, and they sat down at Your feet. Everyone shall receive of Your words.

title: Deuteronomy 33:4
text: Moses commanded us a law, the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.

title: Deuteronomy 33:5
text: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people [and] the tribes of Israel were gathered.

title: Deuteronomy 33:6
text: Let Reuben live and not die, and let [not] his men be few.

title: Deuteronomy 33:7
text: And this for Judah: And he said, Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah, and bring him to his people. Let his hands be sufficient for him, and You shall be a help [to him] from his enemies.

title: Deuteronomy 33:8
text: And of Levi he said, [Let] Your Thummim and Your Urim [be] with Your holy one whom You proved at Massah; You strove with him at the Waters of Strife,

title: Deuteronomy 33:9
text: who said to his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; and he has not acknowledged his brothers, nor knew his own son, for they have observed Your word and kept Your covenant.

title: Deuteronomy 33:10
text: Let them teach Jacob Your judgments, and Israel Your law. Let them put incense before You and whole burnt sacrifice on Your altar.

title: Deuteronomy 33:11
text: O, LORD, bless his strength, and accept the work of his hands. Strike through the loins of those who rise against him, and [of those] who hate him, that they should not rise again.

title: Deuteronomy 33:12
text: Of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the LORD shall live in safety beside Him, [and] shall cover him all the day long, yea he shall dwell between His shoulders.

title: Deuteronomy 33:13
text: And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the LORD [be] his land, with the precious things of the heavens, for the dew, and for the deep that crouches beneath,

title: Deuteronomy 33:14
text: and for the precious fruits of by the sun, and with the best yield of [the] months.

title: Deuteronomy 33:15
text: And with the first of the ancient mountains, and for the precious things of the everlasting hills,

title: Deuteronomy 33:16
text: and for the precious things of the earth and fullness of it, and [for] the good will of Him who lived in the Bush. Let the blessing come on the head of Joseph, and on the top of the head of him who was separated from his brothers.

title: Deuteronomy 33:17
text: His glory [is like] the first-born of his bull, and his horns are like the horns of the wild ox. With them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth. And they are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they are the thousands of Manasseh.

title: Deuteronomy 33:18
text: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out, and Issachar in your tents.

title: Deuteronomy 33:19
text: They shall call the peoples to the mountain. There they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness, for they shall suck the bounty of the seas and treasures hidden in the sand.

title: Deuteronomy 33:20
text: And of Gad he said, Blessed [is] he who makes Gad greater. He lives as a lion and tears the arm and the crown of the head.

title: Deuteronomy 33:21
text: And he provided the first part for himself, because there was the portion of the lawgiver hidden. And he came [with] the heads of the people. He executed the justice of the LORD, and His judgments with Israel.

title: Deuteronomy 33:22
text: And of Dan he said, Dan [is] a lion's whelp. He shall leap from Bashan.

title: Deuteronomy 33:23
text: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favor, and full with the blessing of the LORD, possess the west and the south.

title: Deuteronomy 33:24
text: And of Asher he said, Asher [shall be] blessed with sons, let him be pleasing to his brothers, and let him dip his foot in oil.

title: Deuteronomy 33:25
text: Your shoes [shall be] iron and bronze. And as your days, so shall your strength be.

title: Deuteronomy 33:26
text: [There is] none like the God of Jeshurun, who rides on the heaven to your help, and in His majesty on the clouds.

title: Deuteronomy 33:27
text: The eternal God [is your] refuge, and underneath [are] the everlasting arms. And He shall throw the enemy out from before you, and shall say, Destroy!

title: Deuteronomy 33:28
text: And Israel shall dwell in safety alone; the fountain of Jacob in a land of grain and wine; and his heavens shall drop down dew.

title: Deuteronomy 33:29
text: Blessed [are] you, O Israel! Who [is] like you, O people saved by the LORD, the shield of your help, and who [is] the sword of your excellency! And your enemies shall be found liars to you, and you shall tread on their high places.

title: Deuteronomy 34:1
text: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab to the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah that [is] opposite Jericho. And the LORD showed him all the land of Gilead, to Dan,

title: Deuteronomy 34:2
text: and all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, to the furthest sea,

title: Deuteronomy 34:3
text: and the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, to Zoar.

title: Deuteronomy 34:4
text: And the LORD said to him, This [is] the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, I will give it to your seed. I have caused you to see it with your eyes, but you shall not go over there.

title: Deuteronomy 34:5
text: And Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the LORD.

title: Deuteronomy 34:6
text: And He buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, opposite Beth-peor. But no man knows of his grave this day.

title: Deuteronomy 34:7
text: And Moses [was] a hundred and twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor had he lost any of his natural strength.

title: Deuteronomy 34:8
text: And the sons of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days. And the days of weeping [and] mourning for Moses were ended.

title: Deuteronomy 34:9
text: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him. And the sons of Israel listened to him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Deuteronomy 34:10
text: And never since has a prophet like Moses arisen in Israel, whom the LORD knew face to face,

title: Deuteronomy 34:11
text: in all the signs and the wonders which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,

title: Deuteronomy 34:12
text: and in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses showed in the eyes of all Israel.

title: Joshua 1:1
text: And it happened after the death of Moses the servant of the LORD, the LORD spoke to Joshua the son of Nun, Moses' minister, saying,

title: Joshua 1:2
text: My servant Moses is dead. Now, therefore, arise, go over this Jordan, you and all this people to the land which I give to them, to the sons of Israel.

title: Joshua 1:3
text: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, I have given that to you, as I said to Moses.

title: Joshua 1:4
text: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even to the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and to the Great Sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your border.

title: Joshua 1:5
text: No man shall be able to stand before you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, [so] I will be with you. I will not fail you nor forsake you.

title: Joshua 1:6
text: Be strong and of good courage. For you shall divide for an inheritance to this people, the land which I swore to their fathers, to give it to them.

title: Joshua 1:7
text: Only be strong and very courageous so that you may be careful to do according to all the law which My servant Moses commanded you. Do not turn from it to the right or to the left, so that you may act wisely wherever you go.

title: Joshua 1:8
text: This book of the law shall not depart out of your mouth, but you shall meditate on it by day and by night, so that you may be careful to do according to all that is written in it. For then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall act wisely.

title: Joshua 1:9
text: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and of good courage. Do not be afraid, neither be dismayed. For the LORD your God [is] with you in all places where you go.

title: Joshua 1:10
text: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people saying,

title: Joshua 1:11
text: Pass through the host, and command the people, saying, Prepare food for yourselves, for within three days you are crossing over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God is giving you to possess it.

title: Joshua 1:12
text: And Joshua spoke to the Reubenites and to the Gadites and to half the tribe of Manasseh, saying:

title: Joshua 1:13
text: Remember the word which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you saying, The LORD your God has given you rest and has given you this land.

title: Joshua 1:14
text: Your wives, your little ones, and your cattle shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan. But you shall go armed before your brothers, all the mighty men of valor, and help them

title: Joshua 1:15
text: until the LORD has given your brothers rest, even as you, and they also have possessed the land which the LORD your God gives them; and you shall return to the land of your possession and enjoy it, which Moses the LORD's servant gave you on this side Jordan, towards the sunrise.

title: Joshua 1:16
text: And they answered Joshua, saying: We will do all that you command us, and wherever you send us we will go.

title: Joshua 1:17
text: Just as we listened to Moses in all things, so we will listen to you. Only may the LORD your God be with you as He was with Moses.

title: Joshua 1:18
text: Whoever rebels against your command and will not listen to your words in all that you command him, he shall be put to death. Only be strong and of a good courage.

title: Joshua 2:1
text: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go look over the land, even Jericho. And they went and came to the house of a harlot named Rahab. And they stayed there.

title: Joshua 2:2
text: And the king of Jericho was told about it, saying, Behold, men from the sons of Israel came in here tonight, to search out the country.

title: Joshua 2:3
text: And the king of Jericho sent to Rahab, saying, Bring out the men that have come to you, those who have entered into your house. For they have come to search out all the country.

title: Joshua 2:4
text: And the woman took the two men and hid them. And she said, Two men came to me, but I did not know from where they came.

title: Joshua 2:5
text: And it happened when it was dark, [at the time of] shutting the gate, the men went out. Where the men went I do not know. Go after them quickly, for you shall overtake them.

title: Joshua 2:6
text: But she had brought them up on the roof, and had hidden them with the stalks of flax which she had laid in order upon the roof.

title: Joshua 2:7
text: And the men went after them on the way to Jordan, to the fords. And when they who pursued them had gone out, they shut the gate.

title: Joshua 2:8
text: And before they had laid down, she came up to them on the roof.

title: Joshua 2:9
text: And she said to the men, I know that the LORD has given you the land, and that your terror has fallen on us, and that all those who live in the land faint because of you.

title: Joshua 2:10
text: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Red Sea for you when you came out of Egypt, and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites that were on the other side Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom you utterly destroyed.

title: Joshua 2:11
text: And we had heard, and our hearts melted, nor did any more spirit remain in any man, because of you. For the LORD your God, He is God in Heaven above and in earth beneath.

title: Joshua 2:12
text: Now therefore, I pray you, swear to me by the LORD, since I have dealt with you in kindness, that you will also deal with kindness to my father's house. And give me a true token,

title: Joshua 2:13
text: and shall save alive my father and my mother, and my brothers and my sisters, and all that they [have], and deliver our lives from death.

title: Joshua 2:14
text: And the men answered her, Our life shall be for yours, if you do not tell our business. And when the LORD has given us the land, we will deal kindly and truly with you.

title: Joshua 2:15
text: Then she let them go down by a cord through the window. For her house [was] on the town wall, and she lived on the wall.

title: Joshua 2:16
text: And she said to them, Get up into the mountain lest the pursuers meet you. And hide yourselves there three days until the pursuers have returned. And afterward you may go your way.

title: Joshua 2:17
text: And the men said to her, We [will be] blameless of this oath to you which you have made us swear.

title: Joshua 2:18
text: Behold, [when] we come into the land, you shall set this line of scarlet thread in the window from which you let us down. And you shall bring your father and your mother, and your brothers, and all your father's household, home to you.

title: Joshua 2:19
text: And it shall be, whoever shall go out of the doors of your house, his blood [shall be] on his head, and we [will be] blameless. And whoever shall be with you in the house, his blood [shall be] on our head if a hand is on him.

title: Joshua 2:20
text: And if you tell our business, then we will be free of the oath which you have made us swear to you.

title: Joshua 2:21
text: And she said, Let [it be] according to your word. And she sent them away, and they departed. And she set the scarlet line in the window.

title: Joshua 2:22
text: And they went and came to the mountain, and stayed there three days until the pursuers them had returned. And the pursuers looked for [them] throughout all the way, but did not find [them].

title: Joshua 2:23
text: And the two men returned. And came down from the mountain, and passed over, and came to Joshua the son of Nun. And they told him all that happened to them.

title: Joshua 2:24
text: And they said to Joshua, Truly the LORD has delivered all the land into our hands, for even all those who live in the country faint because of us.

title: Joshua 3:1
text: And Joshua rose early in the morning. And they moved from Shittim and came to Jordan, he and all the sons of Israel, and lodged there before they passed over.

title: Joshua 3:2
text: And it happened after three days the officers went through the host.

title: Joshua 3:3
text: And [they] commanded the people saying, When you see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, and the priests the Levites bearing it, then you shall move from your place and go after it.

title: Joshua 3:4
text: Yet keep a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure. Do not come near it, so that you may know the way by which you must go. For you have not passed [this] way before now.

title: Joshua 3:5
text: And Joshua said to the people, Sanctify yourselves, for tomorrow the LORD will do wonders among you.

title: Joshua 3:6
text: And Joshua spoke to the priests saying, Take up the ark of the covenant and pass over before the people. And they took up the ark of the covenant and went before the people.

title: Joshua 3:7
text: And the LORD said to Joshua, Today, I will begin to magnify you in the sight of all Israel so that they may know that I will be with you, as I was with Moses.

title: Joshua 3:8
text: And you shall command the priests that carry the ark of the covenant, saying, When you have come to the brink of the water of Jordan, you shall stand still in Jordan.

title: Joshua 3:9
text: And Joshua said to the sons of Israel, Come here and hear the words of the LORD your God.

title: Joshua 3:10
text: And Joshua said, By this you shall know that the living God [is] among you, and He will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Hivites, and the Perizzites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Jebusites.

title: Joshua 3:11
text: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passes over before you into Jordan.

title: Joshua 3:12
text: And now take yourselves twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, out of every tribe a man.

title: Joshua 3:13
text: And it shall be, as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests that carry the ark of the LORD, the Lord of all the earth, shall rest in the waters of Jordan, the waters of Jordan shall be cut off [from] the waters that come down from above. And they shall stand all in a heap.

title: Joshua 3:14
text: And it happened, when the people moved from their tents to pass over Jordan, and as the priests carried the ark of the covenant before the people,

title: Joshua 3:15
text: and as those who bore the ark had come to Jordan, and the feet of the priests that bore the ark were dipped in the edge of the water (for Jordan overflows all its banks, all the time of harvest);

title: Joshua 3:16
text: that the waters which came down from above stopped [and] rose up all in a heap, very far from the city Adam that [is] beside Zaretan. And those that came down toward the sea of the plain, the Salt Sea, were completely cut off. And the people passed over across from Jericho.

title: Joshua 3:17
text: And the priests who bore the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firm on dry ground in the middle of Jordan. And all the Israelites passed over on dry ground, until all the people had passed completely over Jordan.

title: Joshua 4:1
text: And it happened when all the people had completely passed over the Jordan, the LORD spoke to Joshua saying,

title: Joshua 4:2
text: Take twelve men for you out of the people, a man out of every tribe,

title: Joshua 4:3
text: and command them saying, Take twelve stones from here, out of the middle of Jordan, out of the place where the priests' feet stood firm. And you shall carry them over with you, and leave them in the place where you shall stay tonight.

title: Joshua 4:4
text: Then Joshua called the twelve men whom he had prepared from the sons of Israel, a man out of every tribe.

title: Joshua 4:5
text: And Joshua said to them, Pass over in front of the ark of the LORD your God into the middle of the Jordan. And every man take a stone on his shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Israel,

title: Joshua 4:6
text: so that this may be a sign to you when your sons ask in time to come, saying, What do you [mean] by these stones?

title: Joshua 4:7
text: Then you shall answer them, The waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD. When it passed over Jordan, the waters of Jordan were cut off, and these stones shall be for a memorial to the sons of Israel forever.

title: Joshua 4:8
text: And the sons of Israel did as Joshua commanded. And they took up twelve stones out of the middle of the Jordan, as the LORD spoke to Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Israel, and carried them over with them to the place where they stayed, and laid them down there;

title: Joshua 4:9
text: even the twelve stones Joshua lifted up in the middle of Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests who carried the ark of the covenant, stood. And they are there to this day.

title: Joshua 4:10
text: For the priests who bore the ark stood in the middle of the Jordan until everything was finished, all that the LORD commanded Joshua to speak to the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua. And the people hurried and passed over.

title: Joshua 4:11
text: And it happened, when all the people had finished passing over, the ark of the LORD and the priests passed over before the people.

title: Joshua 4:12
text: And the sons of Reuben, and the sons of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh, passed over armed in front of the sons of Israel, as Moses spoke to them;

title: Joshua 4:13
text: about forty thousand armed men of the army passed over before the LORD to battle, to the plains of Jericho.

title: Joshua 4:14
text: On that day the LORD made Joshua great in the sight of all Israel. And they feared him, even as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.

title: Joshua 4:15
text: And the LORD spoke to Joshua, saying,

title: Joshua 4:16
text: Command the priests who bear the ark of the testimony, that they come up out of the Jordan.

title: Joshua 4:17
text: Joshua, therefore, commanded the priests saying, Come up out of the Jordan.

title: Joshua 4:18
text: And it happened, when the priests who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD had come up out of the midst of the Jordan, the soles of the feet of the priests were lifted up to the dry land, the waters of the Jordan returned to their place and flowed over all its banks, as before.

title: Joshua 4:19
text: And the people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth of the first month, and camped in Gilgal, in the east border of Jericho.

title: Joshua 4:20
text: And those twelve stones which they took out of the Jordan, Joshua were raised in Gilgal.

title: Joshua 4:21
text: And he spoke to the sons of Israel saying, When your sons shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What do these stones [mean]?

title: Joshua 4:22
text: Then you shall let your sons know, saying, Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.

title: Joshua 4:23
text: For the LORD your God dried up the waters of Jordan from before you until you had passed over, even as the LORD your God did to the Red Sea which He dried up from before us until we had gone over;

title: Joshua 4:24
text: so that all the people of the earth might know the hand of the LORD, [is] mighty and so that you might fear the LORD your God forever.

title: Joshua 5:1
text: And it happened, when all the kings of the Amorites who [were] on the west side of the Jordan, and all the kings of the Canaanites who [were] by the sea, heard that the LORD had dried up the waters of Jordan in front of the sons of Israel until we had passed over, that their hearts melted. Neither was there spirit in them any more, because of the sons of Israel.

title: Joshua 5:2
text: At that time the LORD said to Joshua, Make sharp knives for yourselves and circumcise the sons of Israel again, the second time.

title: Joshua 5:3
text: And Joshua made sharp knives and circumcised the sons of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.

title: Joshua 5:4
text: And this [is] the reason why Joshua circumcised. All the people that came out of Egypt, the males, all the men of war, died in the wilderness by the wayside, after they came out of Egypt.

title: Joshua 5:5
text: For all the people who came out were circumcised. But all the people born in the wilderness by the wayside, as they came forth out of Egypt, had not been circumcised.

title: Joshua 5:6
text: For the sons of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness, until all the people, the men of war, who came out of Egypt, were destroyed, because they did not obey the voice of the LORD. To them the LORD swore that He would not show them the land which the LORD swore to their fathers that He would give us, a land that flows with milk and honey.

title: Joshua 5:7
text: And Joshua circumcised their sons, [whom] He raised up in their place. For they were not circumcised, because they had not been circumcised by the wayside.

title: Joshua 5:8
text: And it happened when they had finished circumcising all the people, they stayed in their places in the camp until they were well.

title: Joshua 5:9
text: And the LORD said to Joshua, Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you. Therefore, the name of the place is called Gilgal to this day.

title: Joshua 5:10
text: And the sons of Israel camped in Gilgal and kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month at evening in the plains of Jericho.

title: Joshua 5:11
text: And they ate of the old grain of the land on the next day after the Passover, unleavened cakes and roasted grain in the same day.

title: Joshua 5:12
text: And the manna stopped on the next day after they had eaten the old grain of the land. And there was no more manna to the sons of Israel, but they ate the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.

title: Joshua 5:13
text: And it happened, when Joshua was beside Jericho, he lifted up his eyes and looked. And, behold, there stood a Man in front of him with His sword drawn in His hand. And Joshua went to Him and said to Him, [Are] You for us, or for our foes?

title: Joshua 5:14
text: And He said, No, but I have come [as] the Commander of the army of the LORD. And Joshua fell on his face to the earth. And he worshiped and said to Him, What does my Lord say to His servant?

title: Joshua 5:15
text: And the Commander of the LORD's army said to Joshua, Take your shoe off your foot, for the place on which you stand [is] holy. And Joshua did so.

title: Joshua 6:1
text: And Jericho was completely shut up because of the sons of Israel. None went out and none came in.

title: Joshua 6:2
text: And the LORD said to Joshua, See, I have given Jericho into your hand, and its king, [and] the mighty men of war.

title: Joshua 6:3
text: And you shall go around the city, all the men of war. Go around the city once. So you shall do for six days.

title: Joshua 6:4
text: And seven priests shall bear seven trumpets of ram's horns in front of the ark. And the seventh day you shall go around the city seven times, and the priests shall blow with the trumpets.

title: Joshua 6:5
text: And it shall be when they make a long [blast] with the ram's horn, and when you hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout. And the wall of the city shall fall down flat, and the people shall go up, each man straight before him.

title: Joshua 6:6
text: And Joshua the son of Nun called the priests and said to them, Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests carry seven ram's horns in front of the ark of the LORD.

title: Joshua 6:7
text: And he said to the people, Pass on, and go around the city. And let him who is armed pass on in front of the ark of the LORD.

title: Joshua 6:8
text: And it happened when Joshua had spoken to the people, the seven priests bearing the seven ram's horns passed on before the LORD and blew the ram's horns. And the ark of the covenant of the LORD followed them.

title: Joshua 6:9
text: And the armed men went before the priests who blew with the ram's horns. And the gathering army came after the ark, as [the priests] were going on and blowing with the ram's horns.

title: Joshua 6:10
text: And Joshua had commanded the people saying, You shall not shout nor make any noise with your voice, neither shall [any] word come out of your mouth until the day I tell you to shout. Then you shall shout.

title: Joshua 6:11
text: And the ark of the LORD went around the city, going around [it] once. And they came into the camp and stayed in the camp.

title: Joshua 6:12
text: And Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of the LORD.

title: Joshua 6:13
text: And seven priests carrying seven ram's horns before the ark of the LORD went on without stopping and blew with the ram's horns. And the armed men went in front of them. But the rear guard came after the ark of the LORD as [the priests] were going on and blowing with the ram's horns.

title: Joshua 6:14
text: And the second day they went around the city once, and returned to the camp. So they did six days.

title: Joshua 6:15
text: And it happened on the seventh day they rose early, at the dawning of the day, and circled the city in the same way seven times. Only on that day did they go around the city seven times.

title: Joshua 6:16
text: And it happened, at the seventh time, when the priest blew with the ram's horns, Joshua said to the people, Shout! For the LORD has given you the city!

title: Joshua 6:17
text: And the city shall be devoted to the LORD, it and all in it. Only Rahab the harlot shall live, she and all with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.

title: Joshua 6:18
text: And you surely shall keep [clear of] from the cursed thing, lest you make yourselves cursed when you take of the cursed things, and make the camp of Israel a curse, and trouble it.

title: Joshua 6:19
text: But all the silver and gold, and vessels of bronze and iron, [are] devoted to the LORD. They shall come into the treasury of the LORD.

title: Joshua 6:20
text: And the people shouted when [the priests] blew with the ram's horns. And it happened when the people heard the sound of the ram's horns, and the people shouted with a great shout, the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, each man straight before him. And they took the city.

title: Joshua 6:21
text: And they completely destroyed all in the city, both man and woman, young and old, and ox, and sheep, and ass, with the edge of the sword.

title: Joshua 6:22
text: And Joshua had said to the two men who had spied out the country, Go into the harlot's house, and bring the woman out from there, and all that she has, as you swore to her.

title: Joshua 6:23
text: And the young men who were spies went in and brought Rahab out, and her father and her mother, and her brothers, and all that she had. And they brought out all her kindred and set them outside the camp of Israel.

title: Joshua 6:24
text: And they burned the city with fire, and all that [was] in it. Only the silver and the gold, and the vessels of bronze and iron, they put into the treasury of the house of the LORD.

title: Joshua 6:25
text: And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive, and her father's household, and all that she had. And she lives in Israel to this day, because she hid the messengers whom Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.

title: Joshua 6:26
text: And Joshua charged [them] at that time, saying, Cursed before the LORD [is] the man who rises up and builds this city of Jericho. He shall lay the foundation of it in his first-born, and in his youngest [son] he shall set up the gates of it.

title: Joshua 6:27
text: And the LORD was with Joshua. And his fame was in all the country.

title: Joshua 7:1
text: But the sons of Israel committed a sin in the cursed thing. For Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took of the thing which was cursed. And the anger of the LORD was kindled against the sons of Israel.

title: Joshua 7:2
text: And Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which [is] beside Beth-aven, on the east side of Bethel. And he spoke to them, saying, Go up and look over the country. And the men went up and spied out Ai.

title: Joshua 7:3
text: And they returned to Joshua and said to him, Let not all the people go up. But let about two or three thousand men go up and strike Ai. Do not make all the people labor there, for they [are] few.

title: Joshua 7:4
text: And about three thousand men of the people went up there. And they fled before the men of Ai.

title: Joshua 7:5
text: And the men of Ai struck about thirty-six men of them, for they chased them [from] before the gate to Shebarim, and struck them in the road going down. Therefore the hearts of the people melted and became as water.

title: Joshua 7:6
text: And Joshua tore his clothes and fell to the earth on his face before the ark of the LORD until the eventide, he and the elders of Israel, and put dust on their heads.

title: Joshua 7:7
text: And Joshua said, Alas, O Lord God, why have You at all brought this people over Jordan to deliver us into the hands of the Amorites, to destroy us? And, oh that we had been content and lived on the other side Jordan!

title: Joshua 7:8
text: O, Lord, what shall I say when Israel turns their backs before their enemies?

title: Joshua 7:9
text: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land shall hear, and shall surround us, and shall cut off our name from the earth. And what will You do for Your great name?

title: Joshua 7:10
text: And the LORD said to Joshua, Get up! Why do you lie on your face this way?

title: Joshua 7:11
text: Israel has sinned, and they have also broken My covenant which I commanded them, and have even taken of the cursed things, and have also stolen and pretended falsely. And they have even put [it] among their own stuff.

title: Joshua 7:12
text: And the sons of Israel could not stand before their enemies. They will turn [their] backs before their enemies, because they have become cursed. I will not be with you again, unless you destroy the one who is cursed from among you.

title: Joshua 7:13
text: Up! Sanctify the people and say, Sanctify yourselves for tomorrow. For thus says the LORD God of Israel, A cursed thing in the midst of you, O Israel. You cannot stand before your enemies until you take away the cursed thing from among you.

title: Joshua 7:14
text: And in the morning, you shall be brought according to your tribes. And it shall be, the tribe which the LORD takes shall come, according to its families. And the family which the LORD shall take shall come by households. And the household which the LORD shall take shall come man by man.

title: Joshua 7:15
text: And it shall be, he who is taken with the cursed thing shall be burned with fire, he and all he has, because he has broken the covenant of the LORD, and because he has done wickedness in Israel.

title: Joshua 7:16
text: And Joshua rose up early in the morning, and brought Israel by their tribes. And the tribe of Judah was taken.

title: Joshua 7:17
text: And he brought the families of Judah. And he took the family of the Zerahites. And he took the family of the Zerahites man by man. And Zabdi was taken.

title: Joshua 7:18
text: And he brought his household man by man. And Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.

title: Joshua 7:19
text: And Joshua said to Achan, My son, I pray you, give glory to the LORD God of Israel, and make confession to Him. And tell me now what you have done. Do not hide [it] from me.

title: Joshua 7:20
text: And Achan answered Joshua and said, Indeed I have sinned against the LORD God of Israel, and this I have done.

title: Joshua 7:21
text: When I saw among the spoil a goodly robe of Shinar, and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight, I coveted them and took them. And behold, they [are] hidden in the earth in the middle of my tent, and the silver under it.

title: Joshua 7:22
text: And Joshua sent messengers, and they ran into the tent. And behold, [it was hidden] in his tent, and the silver under it.

title: Joshua 7:23
text: And they took them out of the middle of the tent, and brought them to Joshua, and to all the sons of Israel. And they laid them out before the LORD.

title: Joshua 7:24
text: And Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, and the silver, and the garment, and the wedge of gold, and his sons, and his daughters, and his oxen, and his asses, and his sheep, and his tent, and all that he had. And they brought them to the valley of Achor.

title: Joshua 7:25
text: And Joshua said, Why have you troubled us? The LORD shall trouble you this day. And all Israel stoned him with stones, and burned them with fire, after they had stoned them with stones.

title: Joshua 7:26
text: And they raised over him a great heap of stones to this day. And the LORD turned from the greatness of His anger. Therefore, the name of that valley is called, The Valley of Grief, to this day.

title: Joshua 8:1
text: And the LORD said to Joshua, Do not fear, nor be dismayed. Take all the people of war with you, and arise, go up to Ai. See, I have given into your hand the king of Ai, and his people, and his city, and his land.

title: Joshua 8:2
text: And you shall do to Ai and its king as you did to Jericho and its king. Only its spoil and its cattle you shall take for a prize for yourselves. Lay an ambush for the city behind it.

title: Joshua 8:3
text: So Joshua and all the people of war arose to go up against Ai. And Joshua chose out thirty thousand men, mighty warriors, and sent them away by night.

title: Joshua 8:4
text: And he commanded them, saying, Behold, you [will be] an ambush against the city, behind the city. You shall not go very far from the city, but all of you be ready.

title: Joshua 8:5
text: And I, and all the people with me, shall go toward the city. And it shall be, when they come out against us, as at the first, we will flee before them,

title: Joshua 8:6
text: (for they will come out after us,) until we have drawn them out of the city. For they will say, They flee before us, even as at the first. And we will flee before them.

title: Joshua 8:7
text: Then you shall rise up from the ambush, and seize on the city; for the LORD your God will deliver it into your hand.

title: Joshua 8:8
text: And it shall be, when you have taken the city, you shall set the city on fire, according to the command of the LORD you shall do. See, I have commanded you.

title: Joshua 8:9
text: And Joshua sent them out. And they went to lie in ambush, and stayed between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of Ai. But Joshua stayed that night among the people.

title: Joshua 8:10
text: And Joshua rose up early in the morning and called up the people. And [they] went up, he and the elders of Israel, in the sight of the people of Ai.

title: Joshua 8:11
text: And all the people of war with him went up and drew near. And they came before the city, and pitched on the north side of Ai. And a valley [was] between them and Ai.

title: Joshua 8:12
text: And he took about five thousand men, and set them to lie in ambush between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of the city.

title: Joshua 8:13
text: And when they had set the people, all the army that [was] on the north of the city, and its rear [ambush] on the west of the city, Joshua went that night into the middle of the valley.

title: Joshua 8:14
text: And it happened, when the king of Ai saw, they hurried and rose up early. And the men of the city went out to do battle against Israel, he and all his people, at the time appointed, before the plain. [But] he did not know that [there were] some lying in ambush against him behind the city.

title: Joshua 8:15
text: And Joshua and all Israel acted as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.

title: Joshua 8:16
text: And all the people in Ai were called together to run after them. And they ran after Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.

title: Joshua 8:17
text: And there was not a man left in Ai or Bethel, who did not go after Israel. And they left the city open, and ran after Israel.

title: Joshua 8:18
text: And the LORD said to Joshua, Stretch out the spear in your hand toward Ai, for I will give it into your hand. And Joshua stretched out the spear in his hand toward the city.

title: Joshua 8:19
text: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place, and ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand. And they entered into the city, and took it, and hurried and set the city on fire.

title: Joshua 8:20
text: And the men of Ai looked behind them and saw. And, behold, the smoke of the city went up into the sky, and they had no power to flee this way or that way. And the people who fled to the wilderness turned back against the pursuers.

title: Joshua 8:21
text: And when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city went up, then they turned again and killed the men of Ai.

title: Joshua 8:22
text: And the others came out of the city against them. So they were in the middle of Israel, some on this side, and some on that side. And they struck them so that they let none of them remain or escape.

title: Joshua 8:23
text: And they took the king of Ai, and brought him alive to Joshua.

title: Joshua 8:24
text: And it happened, when Israel had made an end of killing all those who lived in Ai, in the field and in the wilderness where they chased them, and when they had all fallen on the edge of the sword until they were gone, all the Israelites returned to Ai and struck it with the edge of the sword.

title: Joshua 8:25
text: And all who fell that day, both of men and women, [were] twelve thousand, all the men of Ai.

title: Joshua 8:26
text: For Joshua did not draw his hand back, with which he stretched out the spear, until he had utterly destroyed all the people of Ai.

title: Joshua 8:27
text: Only, Israel took the cattle and the spoil of that city for a prize for themselves, according to the word of the LORD which He commanded Joshua.

title: Joshua 8:28
text: And Joshua burned Ai, and made it a heap forever, a ruin to this day.

title: Joshua 8:29
text: And he hanged the king of Ai on a tree until evening. And as soon as the sun was down, Joshua commanded that they should take his body down from the tree and throw it down at the entrance to the gate of the city, and raise on it a great heap of stones, to this day.

title: Joshua 8:30
text: Then Joshua built an altar to the LORD God of Israel in Mount Ebal,

title: Joshua 8:31
text: as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded the sons of Israel, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses, an altar of whole stones over which no man has lifted [any] iron. And they offered on it burnt offerings to the LORD, and sacrificed peace offerings.

title: Joshua 8:32
text: And he wrote there on the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he wrote in the presence of the sons of Israel.

title: Joshua 8:33
text: And all Israel, and their elders and officers, and their judges, stood on this side of the ark, and on that side, before the priests the Levites who bore the ark of the covenant of the LORD, the stranger as well as the homeborn among them, half of them over against Mount Gerizim, and half of them over against Mount Ebal, as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded before that they should bless all the people of Israel.

title: Joshua 8:34
text: And afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessings and cursings, according to all that is written in the book of the law.

title: Joshua 8:35
text: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded, which Joshua did not read before all the congregation of Israel, with the women and the little ones, and the strangers that walked among them.

title: Joshua 9:1
text: And it happened, when all the kings who [were] on this side Jordan, in the hills and in the valleys, and in all the coast of the great sea over against Lebanon heard, the Hittite, and the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite,

title: Joshua 9:2
text: they all, with one mind, gathered themselves to fight with Joshua and with Israel.

title: Joshua 9:3
text: And when those who lived in Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and to Ai,

title: Joshua 9:4
text: they worked slyly. For they came and acted as if they were ambassadors. And they took old sacks on their asses, and old and torn and bound up wineskins,

title: Joshua 9:5
text: and old and patched sandals on their feet, and old clothes on them. And all the bread they had taken was dry [and] moldy.

title: Joshua 9:6
text: And they went to Joshua to the camp at Gilgal, and said to him and to the men of Israel, We have come from a far country. Now therefore, make a treaty with us.

title: Joshua 9:7
text: And the men of Israel said to the Hivites, Perhaps you are living among us, and how shall we make a treaty with you?

title: Joshua 9:8
text: And they said to Joshua, We [are] your servants. And Joshua said to them, Who [are] you, and from where do you come?

title: Joshua 9:9
text: And they said to him, Your servants have come from a very far country, because of the name of the LORD your God. For we have heard of His fame and all that He did in Egypt,

title: Joshua 9:10
text: and all that He did to the two kings of the Amorites who [were] beyond Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, who was at Ashtaroth.

title: Joshua 9:11
text: And our elders and all those who live in our country spoke to us saying, Take provisions with you for the journey, and go to meet them. Say to them, We [are] your servants. And now make a treaty with us.

title: Joshua 9:12
text: We took this bread hot [for] our provision out of our houses on the day we came out to go to you. But now, see, [it is] dry, and it is moldy.

title: Joshua 9:13
text: And these wineskins which we filled [were] new. And, see, they are torn. And these clothes and shoes of ours have become old because of the very long journey.

title: Joshua 9:14
text: And they received the men because of their provisions, and did not ask at the mouth of the LORD.

title: Joshua 9:15
text: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a treaty with them, to let them live. And the rulers of the congregation swore to them.

title: Joshua 9:16
text: And it happened at the end of three days after they had made a treaty with them, they heard that they [were] their neighbors and that they lived among them.

title: Joshua 9:17
text: And the sons of Israel journeyed and came to their cities on the third day. Now their cities [were] Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjath-jearim.

title: Joshua 9:18
text: And the sons of Israel did not strike them, because the rulers of the congregation had sworn to them by the LORD God of Israel. And all the congregation murmured against the rulers.

title: Joshua 9:19
text: But all the rulers said to the congregation, We have sworn to them by the LORD God of Israel. Now, therefore, we may not touch them.

title: Joshua 9:20
text: This we will do to them. We will even let them live, lest wrath be on us because of the oath which we swore to them.

title: Joshua 9:21
text: And the rulers said to them, Let them live, but let them be woodcutters and drawers of water to all the congregation, as the rulers had promised them.

title: Joshua 9:22
text: And Joshua called for them, and he spoke to them, saying, Why have you fooled us saying, We [are] very far from you, when you dwell among us?

title: Joshua 9:23
text: And now you [are] cursed, and there shall none of you be freed from being slaves and woodcutters and drawers of water for the house of my God.

title: Joshua 9:24
text: And they answered Joshua and said, Because it was certainly told your servants how the LORD your God commanded His servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all those who lived in the land from before you; therefore, we were very much afraid of our lives because of you, and have done this thing.

title: Joshua 9:25
text: And now, behold, we [are] in your hand. As it seems good and right to you to do to us, do it.

title: Joshua 9:26
text: And so he did to them, and delivered them out of the hand of the sons of Israel, so that they did not kill them.

title: Joshua 9:27
text: And Joshua made them that day woodcutters and drawers of water for the congregation, and for the altar of the LORD, even to this day, in the place which He should choose.

title: Joshua 10:1
text: And it happened, when Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai and had utterly destroyed it (as he had done to Jericho and its king, so he had done to Ai and its king) and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel and were among them,

title: Joshua 10:2
text: they feared greatly, because Gibeon [was] a great city, like one of the royal cities, and because it [was] greater than Ai, and all of its men were mighty.

title: Joshua 10:3
text: And Adonizedek king of Jerusalem sent to Hoham king of Hebron, and to Piram king of Jarmuth, and to Japhia king of Lachish, and to Debir king of Eglon, saying,

title: Joshua 10:4
text: Come up to me, and help me, so that we may strike Gibeon. For it has made peace with Joshua and with the sons of Israel.

title: Joshua 10:5
text: And the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon, gathered themselves. And they went up, they and all their armies, and camped before Gibeon, and made war against it.

title: Joshua 10:6
text: And the men of Gibeon sent to Joshua to the camp to Gilgal, saying, Do not withhold your hand from your servants. Come up to us quickly, and save us, and help us. For all the kings of the Amorites who dwell in the mountains have gathered against us.

title: Joshua 10:7
text: So Joshua went up from Gilgal, he and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of war.

title: Joshua 10:8
text: And the LORD said to Joshua, Do not fear them, for I have delivered them into your hands. There shall not a man of them stand before you.

title: Joshua 10:9
text: And Joshua came to them suddenly, coming up from Gilgal all night.

title: Joshua 10:10
text: And the LORD troubled them before Israel, and killed them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the way that goes up to Bethhoron, and struck them to Azekah, and to Makkedah.

title: Joshua 10:11
text: And it happened, as they fled from before Israel, and [were] in the descent of Bethhoron, the LORD cast down great stones from the heavens on them to Azekah, and they died. The many who died from hailstones were more than the sons of Israel killed with the sword.

title: Joshua 10:12
text: Then Joshua spoke to the LORD in the day when the LORD delivered up the Amorites before the sons of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun! Stand still on Gibeon! And, moon, [stand still] in the valley of Aijalon!

title: Joshua 10:13
text: And the sun stood still, and the moon stood [still], until the people [had] avenged themselves on their enemies. [Is] this not written in the Book of Jasher? And the sun stood [still] in the midst of the heavens, and did not hasten to go down about a whole day.

title: Joshua 10:14
text: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that the LORD listened to the voice of a man. For the LORD fought for Israel.

title: Joshua 10:15
text: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp to Gilgal.

title: Joshua 10:16
text: But these five kings fled and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah.

title: Joshua 10:17
text: And it was told to Joshua, saying, The five kings have been found hidden in a cave at Makkedah.

title: Joshua 10:18
text: And Joshua said, Roll great stones on the mouth of the cave, and set men by it in order to keep them.

title: Joshua 10:19
text: And do not stay. Pursue your enemies and strike the ones who are behind. Do not allow them to enter into their cities. For the LORD your God has delivered them into your hand.

title: Joshua 10:20
text: And it happened, when Joshua and the sons of Israel had made an end of killing them [with] a very great slaughter until they were gone, the rest of those [who] remained entered into fortified cities.

title: Joshua 10:21
text: And all the people returned in peace to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah. None moved his tongue against any of the sons of Israel.

title: Joshua 10:22
text: And Joshua said, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring those five kings out of the cave to me.

title: Joshua 10:23
text: And they did so, and brought those five kings out of the cave to him: the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon.

title: Joshua 10:24
text: And it happened, when they brought out those kings to Joshua, Joshua called for all the men of Israel. And he said to the commanders of the men of war who had gone with him, Draw near, set your feet on the necks of these kings. And they drew near and put their feet on their necks.

title: Joshua 10:25
text: And Joshua said to them, Do not fear nor be dismayed. Be strong and of good courage. For so shall the LORD do to all your enemies against whom you fight.

title: Joshua 10:26
text: And afterward Joshua struck them and killed them, and hanged them on five trees. And they were hanging on the trees until the evening.

title: Joshua 10:27
text: And it happened at the time of the going down of the sun, Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees and threw them into the cave in which they had been hidden, and laid great stones in the cave's mouth, [which remain] until this very day.

title: Joshua 10:28
text: And that day Joshua took Makkedah and struck it with the edge of the sword, and he utterly destroyed the king of it, them, and every soul in it. He let none remain. And he did to the king of Makkedah as he did to the king of Jericho.

title: Joshua 10:29
text: And Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, to Libnah, and fought against Libnah.

title: Joshua 10:30
text: And the LORD delivered it also, and its king, into the hand of Israel. And [he] struck it with the edge of the sword, and every soul in it. He let none remain in it, but did to its king as he did to the king of Jericho.

title: Joshua 10:31
text: And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, to Lachish, and camped against it, and fought against it.

title: Joshua 10:32
text: And the LORD delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, who took it on the second day, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and every soul in it, according to all that he had done to Libnah.

title: Joshua 10:33
text: Then Horam, king of Gezer, came up to help Lachish. And Joshua struck him and his people until he had left him none remaining.

title: Joshua 10:34
text: And from Lachish Joshua passed to Eglon, and all Israel with him. And they camped against it and fought against it.

title: Joshua 10:35
text: And they took it on that day, and struck it with the edge of the sword; and every soul in it he completely destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.

title: Joshua 10:36
text: And Joshua went on from Eglon, and all Israel with him, to Hebron. And they fought against it.

title: Joshua 10:37
text: And they took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and its king, and all its cities, and every soul in it. He left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon, but destroyed it, and all the souls that were in it.

title: Joshua 10:38
text: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir, and fought against it.

title: Joshua 10:39
text: And he took it, and its king, and all its cities. And they struck them with the edge of the sword, and destroyed every soul in it. He left none remaining. As he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to its king, as he had done also to Libnah, and to its king.

title: Joshua 10:40
text: And Joshua struck all the land, the hills, and the south, and the valley, and the springs, and all their kings. He left none remaining, but destroyed all that breathed, as the LORD God of Israel commanded.

title: Joshua 10:41
text: And Joshua struck them from Kadesh-barnea even to Gaza, and all the land of Goshen, even to Gibeon.

title: Joshua 10:42
text: And Joshua took all these kings and their land [at] one time, because the LORD God of Israel fought for Israel.

title: Joshua 10:43
text: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp to Gilgal.

title: Joshua 11:1
text: And it happened when Jabin, king of Hazor, had heard, he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,

title: Joshua 11:2
text: and to the kings on the north of the mountains, and on the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and in the borders of Dor on the west,

title: Joshua 11:3
text: [and to] the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and to the Hivite under Hermon, in the land of Mizpeh.

title: Joshua 11:4
text: And they went out, they and all their armies with them, many people, even as the sand on the seashore in multitude, with very many horses and chariots.

title: Joshua 11:5
text: And when all these kings had met together, they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Israel.

title: Joshua 11:6
text: And the LORD said to Joshua, Do not be afraid because of them, for tomorrow about this time I will deliver them up, all killed before Israel. You shall hamstring their horses and burn their chariots with fire.

title: Joshua 11:7
text: And Joshua came suddenly, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom. And they fell on them.

title: Joshua 11:8
text: And the LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, who struck them and chased them to great Sidon, and to the salt pits, and to the valley of Mizpeh eastward. And they struck them until they left them none remaining.

title: Joshua 11:9
text: And Joshua did to them as the LORD commanded him. He hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots with fire.

title: Joshua 11:10
text: And Joshua at that time turned back and took Hazor, and struck its king with the sword. For Hazor formerly [was] the head of all those kingdoms.

title: Joshua 11:11
text: And they struck every soul in it with the edge of the sword, destroying [them]. And he left none breathing. And he burned Hazor with fire.

title: Joshua 11:12
text: And Joshua took all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them. And he struck them with the edge of the sword. He destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded.

title: Joshua 11:13
text: But Israel did not burn any of them, the cities that stood in their strength, except Hazor only. Joshua did burn it.

title: Joshua 11:14
text: And all the spoil of these cities and the cattle the sons of Israel took for a prize to themselves. But they struck every man with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them. They left none breathing.

title: Joshua 11:15
text: As the LORD commanded Moses His servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so Joshua did. He left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Joshua 11:16
text: So Joshua took all that land, the hills, and all the south country, and all the land of Goshen, and the valley, and the plain, and the mountains of Israel, and its lowlands,

title: Joshua 11:17
text: from mount Halak that goes up to Seir, even to Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon under Mount Hermon. And he took all their kings, and struck them and killed them.

title: Joshua 11:18
text: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.

title: Joshua 11:19
text: There was not a city that made peace with the sons of Israel, except the Hivites, the inhabitants of Gibeon. All [others] they took in battle.

title: Joshua 11:20
text: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts so that they should come against Israel in battle, so that they might be destroyed, so that they might have no favor, but that He might destroy them, as the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Joshua 11:21
text: At that time Joshua came and cut off the giants from the mountains, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountains of Judah, and from all the mountains of Israel. Joshua destroyed them with their cities.

title: Joshua 11:22
text: There were none of the giants left in the land of the sons of Israel; only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod there remained some.

title: Joshua 11:23
text: And Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the LORD commanded Moses. And Joshua gave it for an inheritance to Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from war.

title: Joshua 12:1
text: And these [are] the kings of the land, whom the sons of Israel struck and whose land they possessed on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the river Arnon to mount Hermon, and all the plain on the east:

title: Joshua 12:2
text: Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon [and] ruled from Aroer, which is on the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half Gilead, even to the river Jabbok, the border of the sons of Ammon;

title: Joshua 12:3
text: and from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and to the sea of the plain, the Salt Sea on the east, the way to Beth-jeshimoth, and from the south, under Ashdothpisgah.

title: Joshua 12:4
text: And they struck the coast of Og king of Bashan, of the rest of the giants, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,

title: Joshua 12:5
text: and reigned in mount Hermon and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

title: Joshua 12:6
text: Moses the servant of the LORD and the sons of Israel struck them. And Moses the servant of the LORD gave it [for] a possession to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.

title: Joshua 12:7
text: And these [are] the kings of the land which Joshua and the sons of Israel struck on this side Jordan, on the west, from Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon even to the mount Halak that goes up to Seir, which Joshua gave to the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;

title: Joshua 12:8
text: in the mountains, and in the valleys, and in the plains, and in the springs, and in the wilderness, and in the south country--the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:

title: Joshua 12:9
text: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which [is] beside Bethel, one;

title: Joshua 12:10
text: the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;

title: Joshua 12:11
text: the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;

title: Joshua 12:12
text: the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;

title: Joshua 12:13
text: the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;

title: Joshua 12:14
text: the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;

title: Joshua 12:15
text: the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;

title: Joshua 12:16
text: the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;

title: Joshua 12:17
text: the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;

title: Joshua 12:18
text: the king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;

title: Joshua 12:19
text: the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;

title: Joshua 12:20
text: the king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;

title: Joshua 12:21
text: the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;

title: Joshua 12:22
text: the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam of Carmel, one;

title: Joshua 12:23
text: the king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;

title: Joshua 12:24
text: the king of Tirzah, one. All the kings were thirty-one.

title: Joshua 13:1
text: Now Joshua [was] old, going on [in] days. And the LORD said to him, You are old, far along in days, [and] there remains yet very much land to be possessed.

title: Joshua 13:2
text: This [is] the land that still remains: all the borders of the Philistines, and all Geshuri,

title: Joshua 13:3
text: from Shihor, which [is] before Egypt, even to the borders of Ekron northward, which is counted to the Canaanite, five lords of the Philistines: of Gaza, of Ashdod, of Ashkelon, of Gath, and of Ekron; also the Avim.

title: Joshua 13:4
text: From the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah which [belongs] to the Sidonians, to Aphek, to the borders of the Amorites.

title: Joshua 13:5
text: And the land of the Giblites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrise, from Baal-gad under Mount Hermon to the border of Hamath,

title: Joshua 13:6
text: all the inhabitants from the hills; from Lebanon to the Burning Waters, [and] all the Sidonians, I will expel them before the sons of Israel. Only you divide it by lot to the Israelites for an inheritance, as I have commanded you.

title: Joshua 13:7
text: And, therefore, divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half tribe of Manasseh,

title: Joshua 13:8
text: with whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance which Moses gave them beyond Jordan eastward, as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them,

title: Joshua 13:9
text: from Aroer on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city in the midst of the river, and all the plain of Medeba, to Dibon;

title: Joshua 13:10
text: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, to the border of the sons of Ammon;

title: Joshua 13:11
text: and Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan to Salcah,

title: Joshua 13:12
text: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan (who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei; he remained of the rest of the giants), even Moses struck them and expelled them.

title: Joshua 13:13
text: But the sons of Israel did not put out the Geshurites and the Maachathites, but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.

title: Joshua 13:14
text: Only, he gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The sacrifices of the LORD God of Israel made by fire [are] their inheritance, as He said to them.

title: Joshua 13:15
text: And Moses gave to the tribe of the sons of Reuben [inheritance] according to their families.

title: Joshua 13:16
text: And their coast was from Aroer on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba.

title: Joshua 13:17
text: He gave them Heshbon and all its cities in the plain, Dibon, and Bamoth-baal, and Beth-baal-meon,

title: Joshua 13:18
text: and Jahazah, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,

title: Joshua 13:19
text: and Kirjath-aim, and Sibmah, and Zarethshahar in the mountain of the valley,

title: Joshua 13:20
text: and Beth-peor, and Ashdoth-pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth,

title: Joshua 13:21
text: and all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon (whom Moses struck with the rulers of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, rulers of Sihon, the inhabitants of the land).

title: Joshua 13:22
text: The sons of Israel also killed Balaam the son of Beor, the diviner, with the sword, among their slain.

title: Joshua 13:23
text: And the border of the sons of Reuben was Jordan, and [its] border. This [was] the inheritance of the sons of Reuben according to their families, the cities and its villages.

title: Joshua 13:24
text: And Moses gave [inheritance] to the tribe of Gad, to the sons of Gad according to their families.

title: Joshua 13:25
text: And their coast was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the sons of Ammon, to Aroer, before Rabbah,

title: Joshua 13:26
text: and from Heshbon to Ramoth-mizpeh, and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir.

title: Joshua 13:27
text: And in the valley he gave them Beth-aram, and Beth-nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and [its] border, even to the edge of the Sea of Chinnereth on the east side Jordan eastward.

title: Joshua 13:28
text: This [is] the inheritance of the sons of Gad according to their families, the cities, and their villages.

title: Joshua 13:29
text: And Moses gave [inheritance] to the half tribe of Manasseh, and this was of the half tribe of the sons of Manasseh by their families.

title: Joshua 13:30
text: And their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which [are] in Bashan, sixty cities.

title: Joshua 13:31
text: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, [were given] to the sons of Machir the son of Manasseh, even to their half of the sons of Machir by their families.

title: Joshua 13:32
text: These [are] they whom Moses caused to inherit in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan by Jericho, eastward.

title: Joshua 13:33
text: But to the tribe of Levi Moses gave no inheritance. The LORD God of Israel [was] their inheritance, as He said to them.

title: Joshua 14:1
text: And these [are] they [of] the sons of Israel who inherited in the land of Canaan, whom Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the sons of Israel, gave out for inheritance to them.

title: Joshua 14:2
text: Their inheritance [was] by lot, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half tribe.

title: Joshua 14:3
text: For Moses had given the inheritance of two tribes and a half tribe on the other side Jordan. But to the Levites he gave no inheritance among them.

title: Joshua 14:4
text: For the sons of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. And they gave no part to the Levites in the land, except cities to live [in], with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance.

title: Joshua 14:5
text: As the LORD commanded Moses, so the sons of Israel did, and they divided the land.

title: Joshua 14:6
text: Then the sons of Judah came to Joshua in Gilgal. And Caleb, the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, said to him, You know the thing that the LORD said to Moses the man of God in Kadesh-barnea regarding you and me.

title: Joshua 14:7
text: I [was] forty years old when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land. And I brought him word again as it was in my heart.

title: Joshua 14:8
text: But my brothers that went up with me made the heart of the people melt; yet I fully followed the LORD my God.

title: Joshua 14:9
text: And Moses swore on that day, saying, Surely the land on which your feet have trodden shall be your inheritance, and your sons' forever because you have fully followed the LORD my God.

title: Joshua 14:10
text: And now, behold, the LORD has kept me alive these forty-five years as He said, even since the LORD spoke this word to Moses, while Israel wandered in the wilderness. And now, lo, I am eighty-five years old today.

title: Joshua 14:11
text: As yet I [am as] strong today as [I was] in the day that Moses sent me. As my strength [was] then, even so [is] my strength now, for war, both to go out and to come in.

title: Joshua 14:12
text: And now give me this mountain of which the LORD spoke on that day. For you heard in that day [how] the giants [were] there, and that the cities were great and fortified. If the LORD will be with me, then I will be able to drive them out, as the LORD said.

title: Joshua 14:13
text: And Joshua blessed him, and gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.

title: Joshua 14:14
text: And Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb, the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, to this day, because he fully followed the LORD God of Israel.

title: Joshua 14:15
text: And the name of Hebron before [was] Kirjath-arba; that one [was] a great man among the giants. And the land had rest from war.

title: Joshua 15:1
text: [This] then was the lot of the tribe of the sons of Judah by their families: to the border of Edom, the wilderness of Zin southward, in the extreme south.

title: Joshua 15:2
text: And their south border was from the end of the Salt Sea, from the bay that looks southward.

title: Joshua 15:3
text: And it went out southward to the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed on to Zin, and went up on the south of Kadesh-barnea, and went on to Hezron, and went up toward Adar, and turned toward Karkaa,

title: Joshua 15:4
text: and passed on to Azmon, and went out by the torrent of Egypt. And the boundary line was at the Sea. This shall be your south border.

title: Joshua 15:5
text: And the east border, the Salt Sea to the end of Jordan, and [their] border in the north quarter [was] from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan.

title: Joshua 15:6
text: And the border went up to Beth-hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth-arabah. And the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben;

title: Joshua 15:7
text: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, before the going up to Adummim, which [is] on the south side of the river. And the border passed toward the waters of En-shemesh, and its boundary was at En-rogel.

title: Joshua 15:8
text: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the south side of the Jebusite. It [is] Jerusalem. And the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom westward, at the end of the Valley of the Giants northward.

title: Joshua 15:9
text: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill to the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron. And the border was drawn to Baalah; it [is] Kirjath-jearim.

title: Joshua 15:10
text: And the border went around from Baalah westward to Mount Seir, and passed along to the side of mount Jearim; it is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Bethshemesh, and passed on to Timnah.

title: Joshua 15:11
text: And the border went to the side of Ekron northward, and the border was drawn [to] Shikkeron and passed along to Mount Baalah, and went out to Jabneel. And the boundary line was at the Sea.

title: Joshua 15:12
text: And the west border [was] to the Great Sea, and the coast. This is the border of the sons of Judah all around according to their families.

title: Joshua 15:13
text: And he gave a part among the sons of Judah to Caleb the son of Jephunneh, according to the command of the LORD to Joshua, even the city of Arba the father of Anak; it [is] Hebron.

title: Joshua 15:14
text: And Caleb drove out from there the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the sons of Anak.

title: Joshua 15:15
text: And he went up from there to those who lived in Debir. And the name of Debir before [was] Kirjath-sepher.

title: Joshua 15:16
text: And Caleb said, He who smites Kirjath-sepher, and takes it, I will give my daughter Achsah to him for a wife.

title: Joshua 15:17
text: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it. And he gave him Achsah his daughter for a wife.

title: Joshua 15:18
text: And it happened as she came, she moved him to ask a field from her father. And she dismounted from the ass. And Caleb said to her, What do you [desire]?

title: Joshua 15:19
text: She answered, Give me a blessing, for you have given me a south land. Give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

title: Joshua 15:20
text: This [is] the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Judah according to their families.

title: Joshua 15:21
text: And the furthest cities of the tribe of the sons of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,

title: Joshua 15:22
text: and Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,

title: Joshua 15:23
text: and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,

title: Joshua 15:24
text: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,

title: Joshua 15:25
text: and Hazor, Hadattah, and Kerioth, [and] Hezron, which is Hazor,

title: Joshua 15:26
text: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah,

title: Joshua 15:27
text: and Hazargaddah, and Heshmon, and Beth-palet,

title: Joshua 15:28
text: and Hazar-shual, and Beer-sheba, and Bizjothjah,

title: Joshua 15:29
text: Baalah, and Iim, and Azem,

title: Joshua 15:30
text: and Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,

title: Joshua 15:31
text: and Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,

title: Joshua 15:32
