text: and Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon. All the cities [are] twenty-nine, with their villages.

title: Joshua 15:33
text: In the low country [were] Eshtaol, and Zoreah, and Ashnah,

title: Joshua 15:34
text: and Zanoah, and En-gannim, Tappuah, and Enam,

title: Joshua 15:35
text: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,

title: Joshua 15:36
text: and Sharaim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages--

title: Joshua 15:37
text: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdal-gad,

title: Joshua 15:38
text: and Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,

title: Joshua 15:39
text: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,

title: Joshua 15:40
text: and Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Kithlish,

title: Joshua 15:41
text: and Gederoth, Beth-dagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages--

title: Joshua 15:42
text: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,

title: Joshua 15:43
text: and Jiphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,

title: Joshua 15:44
text: and Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities and their villages;

title: Joshua 15:45
text: Ekron with its town and its villages;

title: Joshua 15:46
text: from Ekron even to the Sea, all that were at hand by Ashdod, and their villages;

title: Joshua 15:47
text: Ashdod with its towns and its villages; Gaza with its towns and its villages, to the river of Egypt, and the Great Sea, and [its] coast.

title: Joshua 15:48
text: And in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,

title: Joshua 15:49
text: and Dannah, and Kirjath-sannah (which is Debir);

title: Joshua 15:50
text: and Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,

title: Joshua 15:51
text: and Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities and their villages;

title: Joshua 15:52
text: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshean,

title: Joshua 15:53
text: and Janum, and Beth-tappuah, and Aphekah,

title: Joshua 15:54
text: and Humtah, and Kirjath-arba; it [is] Hebron; and Zior; nine cities and their villages--

title: Joshua 15:55
text: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Juttah,

title: Joshua 15:56
text: and Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,

title: Joshua 15:57
text: Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities and their villages;

title: Joshua 15:58
text: Halhul, Beth-zur, and Gedor,

title: Joshua 15:59
text: and Maarath, and Beth-anoth, and Eltekon; six cities and their villages--

title: Joshua 15:60
text: Kirjath-baal; it [is] Kirjath-jearim; and Rabbah; two cities and their villages.

title: Joshua 15:61
text: In the wilderness, Beth-arabah, Middin, and Secacah,

title: Joshua 15:62
text: and Nibshan, and the city of Salt, and En-gedi; six cities and their villages.

title: Joshua 15:63
text: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the sons of Judah could not drive them out. But the Jebusites live with the sons of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.

title: Joshua 16:1
text: And the lot of the sons of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho, to the water of Jericho on the east, to the wilderness that goes up from Jericho through Mount Bethel,

title: Joshua 16:2
text: and goes out from Bethel to Luz, and passes along to the borders of the Archites, to Ataroth;

title: Joshua 16:3
text: and it goes down westward to the border of the Japhletites, to the border of Beth-horon the lower, and to Gezer. And its boundary was at the sea.

title: Joshua 16:4
text: And the sons of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.

title: Joshua 16:5
text: And the border of the sons of Ephraim was by their families: the border of their inheritance on the east side [was] Ataroth-addar, to Beth-horon the upper.

title: Joshua 16:6
text: And the border went out toward the sea to Michmethah on the north side. And the border went about eastward to Taanath-shiloh, and passed by it on the east to Janohah.

title: Joshua 16:7
text: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth, and to Naarath, and came again to Jericho, and went out at Jordan.

title: Joshua 16:8
text: The border went out from Tappuah westward to the river Kanah. And the boundary was at the sea. This [is] the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Ephraim by their families.

title: Joshua 16:9
text: And the separate cities for the sons of Ephraim [were] among the inheritance of the sons of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.

title: Joshua 16:10
text: And they did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer. But the Canaanites live among the Ephraimites until this day, and serve under tribute.

title: Joshua 17:1
text: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh (for he [was] the first-born of Joseph); for Machir, the first-born of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.

title: Joshua 17:2
text: There was also [a lot] for the rest of the sons of Manasseh by their families: for the sons of Abiezer, and for the sons of Helek, and for the sons of Asriel, and for the sons of Shechem, and for the sons of Hepher, and for the sons of Shemida; these [were] the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, by their families.

title: Joshua 17:3
text: But Zelophehad the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters. And these [were] the names of his daughters: Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

title: Joshua 17:4
text: And they came near before Eleazar the priest and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the rulers, saying, The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers. And according to the command of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among the brothers of their father.

title: Joshua 17:5
text: And there fell ten portions [to] Manasseh, besides the land of Gilead and Bashan, which [were] on the other side Jordan;

title: Joshua 17:6
text: because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons. And the rest of Manasseh's sons had the land of Gilead.

title: Joshua 17:7
text: And the border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah before Shechem. And the border went up to the right to the inhabitants of En-tappuah.

title: Joshua 17:8
text: Manasseh had the land of Tappuah, but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh [belonged] to the sons of Ephraim.

title: Joshua 17:9
text: And the border went down to the river Kanah, southward of the river. These cities of Ephraim [are] among the cities of Manasseh. And the border of Manasseh [was] on the north of the river, and the boundary was at the sea.

title: Joshua 17:10
text: Southward [it was] Ephraim's, and northward it was Manasseh's. And the sea is its border. And they met together in Asher on the north, and in Issachar on the east.

title: Joshua 17:11
text: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Beth-shean and its towns, and Ibleam and its towns, and those who lived in Dor and its towns, and those who lived in Endor and its towns, and those who lived in Taanach and its towns, and those who lived in Megiddo and its towns, even three regions.

title: Joshua 17:12
text: Yet the sons of Manasseh were not able to occupy these cities, but the Canaanites wanted to live in that land.

title: Joshua 17:13
text: And it happened when the sons of Israel had become strong, they put the Canaanites to tribute. But they did not completely drive them out.

title: Joshua 17:14
text: The sons of Joseph spoke to Joshua saying, Why have you given me one lot and one portion to inherit, since I [am] a great people, because the LORD has blessed me until now?

title: Joshua 17:15
text: And Joshua answered them, If you [are] a great people, and if mount Ephraim is too narrow for you, get up to the forest and cut down more for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants.

title: Joshua 17:16
text: And the sons of Joseph said, The hill is not enough for us. And all the Canaanites who live in the land of the valley [have] chariots of iron, those who [are] of Beth-shean and its towns, and those who [are] of the valley of Jezreel.

title: Joshua 17:17
text: And Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph, even to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, You [are] a great people and have great power. You shall not have one lot.

title: Joshua 17:18
text: But the mountain shall be yours, for it [is] a forest, and you shall cut it down. And the outer limits of it shall be yours. For you shall drive out the Canaanites, even though they have iron chariots and though they [are] strong.

title: Joshua 18:1
text: And all the congregation of the sons of Israel gathered at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.

title: Joshua 18:2
text: And there remained among the sons of Israel seven tribes which had not yet received their inheritance.

title: Joshua 18:3
text: And Joshua said to the sons of Israel, How long will you fail to go in to possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers has given you?

title: Joshua 18:4
text: Give from among you three men for [each] tribe. And I will send them, and they shall rise and go through the land and map it according to the inheritance of them. And they shall come to me.

title: Joshua 18:5
text: And they shall divide it into seven parts. Judah shall stay within their border on the south, and the house of Joseph shall stay within their borders on the north.

title: Joshua 18:6
text: And you shall map the land [into] seven parts and bring it here to me, so that I may cast lots here for you before the LORD our God.

title: Joshua 18:7
text: But the Levites have no part among you. For the priesthood of the LORD [is] their inheritance. And Gad and Reuben and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.

title: Joshua 18:8
text: And the men arose and went away. And Joshua charged those who went to map the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and map it, and come again to me so that I may here cast lots for you before the LORD in Shiloh.

title: Joshua 18:9
text: And the men went and passed through the land, and mapped it by cities into seven parts in a book, and they came to Joshua, to the host at Shiloh.

title: Joshua 18:10
text: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD. And Joshua divided the land to the sons of Israel there, according to their divisions.

title: Joshua 18:11
text: And the lot of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin came up by their families. And the border of their lot came forth between the sons of Judah and the sons of Joseph.

title: Joshua 18:12
text: And their border on the north side was from Jordan. And the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward. And their boundary was at the wilderness of Beth-aven.

title: Joshua 18:13
text: And the border went over from there toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which [is] Bethel, southward. And the border went down to Ataroth-adar, near the hill that lies on the south side of the lower Beth-horon.

title: Joshua 18:14
text: And the border was drawn [from there], and went around the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that [is] in front of Beth-horon southward. And its boundary was at Kirjath-baal; it [is] Kirjath-jearim, a city of the sons of Judah. This [was] the west quarter.

title: Joshua 18:15
text: And the south quarter [was] from the end of Kirjath-jearim; and the border went out westward, and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah;

title: Joshua 18:16
text: and the border went down to the end of the mountain that [is] before the valley of the sons of Hinnom, which [is] the Valley of the Giants northward, and went down the valley of Hinnom to the side of the Jebusite on the south, and went down to En-rogel.

title: Joshua 18:17
text: And it was drawn from the north and went out to En-shemesh, and went out toward Geliloth, which [is] across from the ascent of Adummim, and went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,

title: Joshua 18:18
text: and passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward, and went down to the Arabah.

title: Joshua 18:19
text: And the border passed along to the side of Beth-hoglah northward. And the boundary was at the north tongue of the Salt Sea, at the south end of Jordan. This [was] the south border.

title: Joshua 18:20
text: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side. This [was] the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin, according to its borders all around, according to their families.

title: Joshua 18:21
text: And the cities of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Beth-hoglah, and the valley of Keziz,

title: Joshua 18:22
text: and Beth-arabah, and Zemaraim, and Bethel,

title: Joshua 18:23
text: and Avvim, and Parah, and Ophrah,

title: Joshua 18:24
text: and Chephar-haam-monai, and Ophni, and Gaba; twelve cities and their villages;

title: Joshua 18:25
text: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,

title: Joshua 18:26
text: and Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,

title: Joshua 18:27
text: and Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,

title: Joshua 18:28
text: and Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusi, which [is] Jerusalem; Gibeath, Kirjath; fourteen cities and their villages. This is the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin according to their families.

title: Joshua 19:1
text: And the second lot came forth to Simeon, for the tribe of the sons of Simeon according to their families. And their inheritance was inside the inheritance of the sons of Judah.

title: Joshua 19:2
text: And they [had] in their inheritance Beer-sheba, or Sheba, and Moladah,

title: Joshua 19:3
text: and Hazar-shual, and Balah, and Azem,

title: Joshua 19:4
text: and Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,

title: Joshua 19:5
text: and Ziklag, and Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susah,

title: Joshua 19:6
text: and Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages--

title: Joshua 19:7
text: Ain, Remmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages,

title: Joshua 19:8
text: and all the villages that were around these cities to Baalath-beer, Ramah of the south. This [is] the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Simeon according to their families.

title: Joshua 19:9
text: The inheritance of the sons of Simeon [was] out of the portion of the sons of Judah. For the part of the sons of Judah [was] too much for them; therefore the sons of Simeon had their inheritance within their inheritance.

title: Joshua 19:10
text: And the third lot came up for the sons of Zebulun according to their families. And the border of their inheritance was to Sarid.

title: Joshua 19:11
text: And their border went up toward the sea, and Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the river that [is] before Jokneam,

title: Joshua 19:12
text: and turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrise to the border of The Flames of Tabor, and then goes out to Daberath, and goes up to Japhia,

title: Joshua 19:13
text: and from there it passes on along on the east to Gittah-hepher, to Ittah-kazin, and goes out to Rimmon-methoar, to Neah.

title: Joshua 19:14
text: And the border compasses it on the north side to Hannathon. And its edges were [in] the valley of Jiphthahel,

title: Joshua 19:15
text: and Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Bethlehem; twelve cities with their villages.

title: Joshua 19:16
text: This [is] the inheritance of the sons of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.

title: Joshua 19:17
text: The fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the sons of Issachar according to their families.

title: Joshua 19:18
text: And their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,

title: Joshua 19:19
text: and Hapharaim, and Shihon, and Anaharath,

title: Joshua 19:20
text: and Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,

title: Joshua 19:21
text: and Remeth, and En-gannim, and En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez.

title: Joshua 19:22
text: And the border reaches to Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Beth-shemesh. And the edges of their border were at Jordan; sixteen cities with their villages.

title: Joshua 19:23
text: This [is] the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.

title: Joshua 19:24
text: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the sons of Asher according to their families.

title: Joshua 19:25
text: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,

title: Joshua 19:26
text: and Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and reaches to Carmel westward, and to Shihor-libnath;

title: Joshua 19:27
text: and turns toward the sunrising to Beth-dagon, and reaches to Zebulun, and to the valley of Jiphthah-el toward the north of Beth-emek, and Neiel, and goes out to Cabul on the left hand,

title: Joshua 19:28
text: and Hebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, to great Sidon;

title: Joshua 19:29
text: and the border turns to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre. And the border turns to Hosah, and the boundaries of it are at the sea from the line to Achzib,

title: Joshua 19:30
text: and Ummah, and Aphek, and Rehob; twenty-two cities and their villages.

title: Joshua 19:31
text: This [is] the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.

title: Joshua 19:32
text: The sixth lot came out to the sons of Naphtali, for the sons of Naphtali according to their families.

title: Joshua 19:33
text: And their border was from Heleph, from Allon to Zaanannim, and Adami, Nekeb, and Jabneel, to Lakum. And its boundaries were at Jordan.

title: Joshua 19:34
text: And the border turns west toward Aznoth-tabor, and goes out from there to Hukkok, and reached to Zebulun on the south side, and reaches to Asher on the west side, and to Judah on Jordan toward the sunrise.

title: Joshua 19:35
text: And the fortified cities [are] Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,

title: Joshua 19:36
text: and Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,

title: Joshua 19:37
text: and Kedesh, and Edrei, and En-hazor,

title: Joshua 19:38
text: and Iron, and Migdalel, Horem, and Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh; nineteen cities and their villages.

title: Joshua 19:39
text: This [is] the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Naphtali according to their families, the cities and their villages.

title: Joshua 19:40
text: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the sons of Dan according to their families.

title: Joshua 19:41
text: And the border of their inheritance was Zorah, and Eshtaol, and Ir-shemesh,

title: Joshua 19:42
text: and Shaalabbin, and Ajalon, and Jethlah,

title: Joshua 19:43
text: and Elon, and Timnah, and Ekron,

title: Joshua 19:44
text: and Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,

title: Joshua 19:45
text: and Jehud, and Beneberak, and Gath-rimmon,

title: Joshua 19:46
text: and Mejarkon, and Rakkon, with the border before Japho.

title: Joshua 19:47
text: And the border of the sons of Dan came out [too little] for them. And the sons of Dan went up to fight against Leshem, and took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and lived in it. And [they] called Leshem Dan, after the name of their father Dan.

title: Joshua 19:48
text: This [is] the inheritance of the tribe of Dan, by their families, these cities and their villages.

title: Joshua 19:49
text: When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance by their borders, the sons of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them.

title: Joshua 19:50
text: According to the command of Jehovah they gave him the city which he asked, Timnath-serah in mount Ephraim. And he built the city and lived in it.

title: Joshua 19:51
text: These [are] the inheritances which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the sons of Israel divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before Jehovah, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. And they finished dividing the land.

title: Joshua 20:1
text: And the LORD spoke to Joshua, saying,

title: Joshua 20:2
text: Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, Appoint cities of refuge for you, as I have spoken to you by the hand of Moses;

title: Joshua 20:3
text: that the manslayer who in innocence strikes [anyone] mortally, without knowing, may flee there. And they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.

title: Joshua 20:4
text: And he shall flee to one of those cities, and shall stand at the entrance of the gate of the city, and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city. And they shall take him into the city to themselves and make him a place, and he shall live with them.

title: Joshua 20:5
text: And if the avenger of blood pursues him, then they shall not deliver the manslayer into his hand, for he has struck his neighbor without knowing, and did not hate him in past time.

title: Joshua 20:6
text: And he shall live in that city until he stands before the congregation for judgment, until the death of the high priest who is in those days. Then the manslayer shall return and come to his city, and to his house, to the city from where he fled.

title: Joshua 20:7
text: And they set apart Kadesh in Galilee, in the hills of Naphtali; and Shechem in the hills of Ephraim; and Kirjath-arba (it [is] Hebron) in the hills of Judah.

title: Joshua 20:8
text: And beyond the Jordan, [at] Jericho eastward, they gave Bezer in the wilderness, on the tableland out of the tribe of Reuben; and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad; and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

title: Joshua 20:9
text: These were the appointed cities for all the sons of Israel, and for the alien who was living in their midst, that he who had killed [anyone] without knowing might flee there, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stood before the congregation.

title: Joshua 21:1
text: And the heads of the fathers of the Levites came near to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the sons of Israel.

title: Joshua 21:2
text: And they spoke to them in Shiloh, in the land of Canaan, saying, the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses to give cities to us to live in, and their open lands for our cattle.

title: Joshua 21:3
text: And the sons of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance these cities and their open lands, at the command of the LORD:

title: Joshua 21:4
text: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites. And the sons of Aaron the priest, of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.

title: Joshua 21:5
text: And the rest of the sons of Kohath [had] by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.

title: Joshua 21:6
text: And the sons of Gershon [had] by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

title: Joshua 21:7
text: The sons of Merari by their families [had] out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun. twelve cities.

title: Joshua 21:8
text: And the sons of Israel gave by lot to the Levites these cities with their open lands, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.

title: Joshua 21:9
text: And they gave out of the tribe of the sons of Judah, and out of the tribe of the sons of Simeon, these cities which are called by name,

title: Joshua 21:10
text: which the sons of Aaron had, [being] of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the sons of Levi, for theirs was the first lot.

title: Joshua 21:11
text: And they gave them the city of Arba, the father of Anak (it [is] Hebron) in the hills of Judah, with its open lands around it.

title: Joshua 21:12
text: But the fields of the city of Arba and its villages they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his own.

title: Joshua 21:13
text: And to the sons of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron and its open lands [as] a city of refuge for the manslayer, and Libnah and its open lands,

title: Joshua 21:14
text: and Jattir and its open lands, and Eshtemoa and its open lands,

title: Joshua 21:15
text: and Holon and its open lands, and Debir and its open lands,

title: Joshua 21:16
text: and Ain and its open lands, and Juttah and its open lands, and Beth-shemesh and its open lands, nine cities from these two tribes.

title: Joshua 21:17
text: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon and its open lands, Geba and its open lands,

title: Joshua 21:18
text: Anathoth and its open lands, and Almon and its open lands; four cities and their open lands.

title: Joshua 21:19
text: And all the cities of the sons of Aaron the priest [were] thirteen cities.

title: Joshua 21:20
text: And the families of the sons of Kohath, the Levites who were left of the sons of Kohath, even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe Ephraim.

title: Joshua 21:21
text: And they gave them Shechem and its open lands in mount Ephraim as a city of refuge for the manslayer, and Gezer and its open lands,

title: Joshua 21:22
text: and Kibzaim and its open lands, and Beth-horon and its open lands; four cities.

title: Joshua 21:23
text: And out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh and open lands, Gibbethon and its open lands,

title: Joshua 21:24
text: Aijalon and its open lands, Gath-rimmon and its open lands; four cities.

title: Joshua 21:25
text: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach and its open lands, and Gath-rimmon and its open lands; two cities.

title: Joshua 21:26
text: All the cities [were] ten, and their open lands, for the families of the sons of Kohath that were left.

title: Joshua 21:27
text: And to the sons of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, from the half tribe of Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and its open lands [as] a city of refuge for the manslayer, and Beesh-terah and its open lands; two cities.

title: Joshua 21:28
text: And from the tribe of Issachar, Kishon and its open lands, and Daberath and its open lands,

title: Joshua 21:29
text: Jarmuth and its open lands, En-gannim and its open lands, four cities.

title: Joshua 21:30
text: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal and its open lands, and Abdon and its open lands,

title: Joshua 21:31
text: Helkath and its open lands, and Rehob and its open lands, four cities

title: Joshua 21:32
text: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee and its open lands [as] a city of refuge for the manslayer, and Hammoth-dor and its open lands, and Kartah and its open lands; three cities.

title: Joshua 21:33
text: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families [were] thirteen cities and their open lands.

title: Joshua 21:34
text: And to the families of the sons of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun: Jokneam and its open lands, and Kartah and its open lands,

title: Joshua 21:35
text: Dimnah and its open lands, Nahalal and its open lands; four cities.

title: Joshua 21:36
text: And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer and its open lands, and Jahazah and its open lands,

title: Joshua 21:37
text: Kedemoth and its open lands, and Mephaath and its open lands; four cities.

title: Joshua 21:38
text: And out of tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead and its open lands [as] a city of refuge for the manslayer, and Mahanaim and its open lands,

title: Joshua 21:39
text: Heshbon and its open lands, Jazer and its open lands; four cities in all.

title: Joshua 21:40
text: All the cities for the sons of Merari by their families which were left of the families of the Levites, were [by] their lot twelve cities.

title: Joshua 21:41
text: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the sons of Israel [were] forty-eight cities and their open lands.

title: Joshua 21:42
text: These cities [were] each one with their open lands around them. So it was to all these cities.

title: Joshua 21:43
text: And the LORD gave to Israel all the land which He swore to give to their fathers. And they possessed it, and lived in it.

title: Joshua 21:44
text: And Jehovah gave them rest round about, according to all that He swore to their fathers. And not a man of all their enemies stood before them. Jehovah delivered all their enemies into their hand.

title: Joshua 21:45
text: Not a word failed from any good thing which the LORD had spoken to the house of Israel. All came to pass.

title: Joshua 22:1
text: Then Joshua called for the Reubenites and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,

title: Joshua 22:2
text: and said to them, You have done all that which Moses the servant of Jehovah commanded you. And you have listened to my voice, to all that I have commanded you.

title: Joshua 22:3
text: You have not left your brothers these many days until today, and have kept the observance of the command of the LORD your God.

title: Joshua 22:4
text: And now Jehovah your God has given rest to your brothers, as He spoke to them. And now turn and go to your tents, to the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the LORD has given to you beyond the Jordan.

title: Joshua 22:5
text: Only, diligently take heed to do the commands and the law which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, to love the LORD your God, and to walk in all His ways, and to keep His commandments, and to cleave to Him, and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul.

title: Joshua 22:6
text: And Joshua blessed them and sent them away. And they went to their tents.

title: Joshua 22:7
text: And to the half tribe of Manasseh, Moses had given [possession] in Bashan. And to its [other] half Joshua had given [possession] with their brothers beyond the Jordan westward. And also when Joshua had sent them away to their tents, then he blessed them.

title: Joshua 22:8
text: And [he] spoke to them, saying, You are returning to your tents with your great treasures, and with very much cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with bronze, and with iron, and with very much clothing. Divide the spoil of your enemies with your brothers.

title: Joshua 22:9
text: And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned. And they departed from the sons of Israel out of Shiloh, which [is] in the land of Canaan, to go to the land of Gilead, to the land of their possession, of which they were possessed, according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

title: Joshua 22:10
text: And when they came to the borders of Jordan in the land of Canaan, the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built an altar of grand appearance there by Jordan.

title: Joshua 22:11
text: And the sons of Israel heard, Behold, the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, at the passage of the sons of Israel.

title: Joshua 22:12
text: And when the sons of Israel heard, the whole congregation of the sons of Israel gathered themselves at Shiloh to go to war against them.

title: Joshua 22:13
text: And the sons of Israel sent Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest to the sons of Reuben, and to the sons of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead,

title: Joshua 22:14
text: and with him ten rulers, a ruler from each of the chief houses throughout all the tribes of Israel. And each one [was] a head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Israel.

title: Joshua 22:15
text: And they came to the sons of Reuben, and to the sons of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead, and they spoke with them saying,

title: Joshua 22:16
text: So says all the congregation of the LORD: What trespass [is] this that you have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away today from following the LORD, in [that] you have built an altar for you so that you might rebel this day against the LORD?

title: Joshua 22:17
text: [Is] the iniquity of Peor [too] little for us, from which we have not been made clean until today? Yea, a plague came on the congregation of the LORD!

title: Joshua 22:18
text: But must you turn away today from following the LORD? It shall be, you rebel today against the LORD, and tomorrow He will be angry with all the congregation of Israel.

title: Joshua 22:19
text: But surely if the land of your possession [is] unclean, pass over to the land of the possession of the LORD in which the LORD's tabernacle dwells, and take possession among us. But do not rebel against the LORD, nor rebel against us in building an altar for yourselves besides the altar of the LORD our God.

title: Joshua 22:20
text: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a sin in the cursed thing, and did not wrath fall on all the congregation of Israel? And that man did not perish alone in his iniquity.

title: Joshua 22:21
text: And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered and said to the heads of the thousands of Israel,

title: Joshua 22:22
text: The LORD God of gods, the LORD God of gods knows, and Israel shall know if [it is] in rebellion or in transgression against the LORD (you shall not save us alive today),

title: Joshua 22:23
text: that we have built us an altar to turn from following the LORD. Or if we have built an altar to offer on it burnt offering or food offering, or if to offer peace offerings on it, let the LORD Himself require [it].

title: Joshua 22:24
text: And if we have not done it for fear of [this] thing, saying, In time to come your sons might speak to our sons, saying, What have you to do with the LORD God of Israel?

title: Joshua 22:25
text: For the LORD has made Jordan a border between us and you, sons of Reuben and sons of Gad. You have no part in the LORD. And your sons shall make our sons stop fearing the LORD.

title: Joshua 22:26
text: And we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice,

title: Joshua 22:27
text: but it shall be a witness between us and you, and our generations after us, so that we might do the service of the LORD before Him with our burnt offerings and with our sacrifices and with our peace offerings; so that your sons may not say to our sons in time to come, You have no part in the LORD.

title: Joshua 22:28
text: And we said that when they should say so to us or to our generations in time to come, that we may say, Behold the pattern of the altar of the LORD which our fathers made, not for burnt offerings nor for sacrifices, but it [is] a witness between us and you.

title: Joshua 22:29
text: Far be it from us that we should rebel against the LORD and turn this day from following the LORD, to build an altar for burnt offerings, for food offerings, or for sacrifices, besides the altar of the LORD our God that [is] before His tabernacle!

title: Joshua 22:30
text: And Phinehas the priest, and the rulers of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Israel with him, heard the words that the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the sons of Manasseh spoke, it pleased them.

title: Joshua 22:31
text: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said to the sons of Reuben and to the sons of Gad and to the half tribe of Manasseh, Today we see that the LORD [is] among us, because you have not committed this sin against the LORD. Now you have delivered the sons of Israel out of the hand of the LORD.

title: Joshua 22:32
text: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the rulers, returned from the sons of Reuben, and from the sons of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, to the land of Canaan, to the sons of Israel, and brought them word again.

title: Joshua 22:33
text: And the thing pleased the sons of Israel. And the sons of Israel blessed God and no more said to go up against them in battle, to destroy the land in which the sons of Reuben and Gad lived.

title: Joshua 22:34
text: And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad proclaimed regarding the altar, that it [was] a witness between us that Jehovah [is] God.

title: Joshua 23:1
text: And it happened many days after the LORD had given rest to Israel from all their enemies all around, Joshua became old, far along in days.

title: Joshua 23:2
text: And Joshua called for all Israel, for their elders and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said to them, I am old, far along in days.

title: Joshua 23:3
text: And you have seen all that the LORD your God has done to all these nations because of you. For the LORD your God [is] He who has fought for you.

title: Joshua 23:4
text: Behold, I have divided to you by lot these nations that are left to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even to the Great Sea westward.

title: Joshua 23:5
text: And the LORD your God shall put them out from before you, and drive them out of your sight. And you shall possess their land, as the LORD your God has promised to you.

title: Joshua 23:6
text: And be very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, so that you do not turn aside from it [to] the right or to the left;

title: Joshua 23:7
text: so that you do not come among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear [by them], neither serve them, nor bow yourselves to them.

title: Joshua 23:8
text: But cleave to the LORD your God, as you have done to this day.

title: Joshua 23:9
text: For the LORD has driven out from before you great and strong nations. But [as for] you, no one has been able to stand before you to this day.

title: Joshua 23:10
text: One man of you shall chase a thousand. For the LORD your God [is] He who fights for you, as He has promised you.

title: Joshua 23:11
text: And take good heed to yourselves that you love the LORD your God.

title: Joshua 23:12
text: Otherwise, if you go back in any way, and hold to those left of these nations, these that remain among you, and shall marry them and go in to them and they to you,

title: Joshua 23:13
text: know for a certainty that the LORD your God will no more drive out these nations from before you. But they shall be snares and traps to you, and whips in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from off this good land which the LORD your God has given you.

title: Joshua 23:14
text: And behold, today I [am] going the way of all the earth. And you know in all your heart and in all your souls that not one thing has failed of all the good things which the LORD your God spoke concerning you. All have come to pass to you. Not one thing of it has failed.

title: Joshua 23:15
text: And it shall be, as comes to you every good thing which the LORD your God has spoken to you has come to you, so shall the LORD bring on you every evil thing until He has destroyed you from off this good land which the LORD your God has given you,

title: Joshua 23:16
text: when you transgress the covenant of the LORD your God, which He commanded you, and have gone and served other gods, and bowed yourselves to them, then shall the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and you shall perish quickly from off the good land which He has given to you.

title: Joshua 24:1
text: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers. And they presented themselves before God.

title: Joshua 24:2
text: And Joshua said to all the people, So says the LORD God of Israel, Your fathers lived Beyond the River in times past, Terah the father of Abraham, and the father of Nahor, and they served other gods.

title: Joshua 24:3
text: And I took your father Abraham from Beyond the River, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed and gave him Isaac.

title: Joshua 24:4
text: And I gave to Isaac Jacob and Esau. And I gave Esau Mount Seir for his own, but Jacob and his sons went down to Egypt.

title: Joshua 24:5
text: I sent Moses also, and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them. And afterward I brought you out.

title: Joshua 24:6
text: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt. And you came to the sea, and the Egyptians followed after your fathers with chariots and horsemen to the Red Sea.

title: Joshua 24:7
text: And they cried to the LORD, He put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea on them and covered them. And your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt. And you lived in the wilderness a long time.

title: Joshua 24:8
text: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites who lived on the other side Jordan. And they fought with you, and I gave them into your hand so that you might possess their land. And I destroyed them from before you.

title: Joshua 24:9
text: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Israel, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you.

title: Joshua 24:10
text: But I would not listen to Balaam. And he still blessed you. And I delivered you out of his hand.

title: Joshua 24:11
text: And you went over Jordan and came to Jericho. And the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites. And I delivered them into your hand.

title: Joshua 24:12
text: And I sent the hornet before you, which drove them out from before you, the two kings of the Amorites, not with your sword, nor with your bow.

title: Joshua 24:13
text: And I have given you a land for which you did not labor, and cities which you did not build, and you live in them. You now eat of the vineyards and olive-yards which you did not plant.

title: Joshua 24:14
text: Now, then, fear the LORD, and serve Him in sincerity and truth. And put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Egypt, and serve the LORD.

title: Joshua 24:15
text: And if it seems evil to you to serve the LORD, choose this day whom you will serve, whether the gods which your fathers served Beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you live. But as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.

title: Joshua 24:16
text: And the people answered and said, Far be it from us to forsake the LORD to serve other gods.

title: Joshua 24:17
text: For the LORD our God [is] He who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage. And He did those great wonders in our sight, and kept us in all our way in which we went and among all the people through whom we passed.

title: Joshua 24:18
text: And the LORD drove out from before us all the people, even the Amorites who lived in the land. We will also serve the LORD, for He [is] our God.

title: Joshua 24:19
text: And Joshua said to the people, You cannot serve the LORD, for He [is] a holy God. He [is] a jealous God. He will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.

title: Joshua 24:20
text: If you forsake the LORD and serve strange gods, then He will turn and do you harm, and destroy you after He has done you good.

title: Joshua 24:21
text: And the people said to Joshua, No, but we will serve the LORD.

title: Joshua 24:22
text: And Joshua said to the people, You [are] witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen the LORD, to serve Him. And they said, [We are] witnesses.

title: Joshua 24:23
text: And now put away the strange gods among you, and incline your heart to the LORD God of Israel.

title: Joshua 24:24
text: And the people said to Joshua, We will serve the LORD our God, and His voice we will obey.

title: Joshua 24:25
text: And Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

title: Joshua 24:26
text: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and took a great stone and set it up there under an oak by the sanctuary of the LORD.

title: Joshua 24:27
text: And Joshua said to all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness to us, for it has heard all the words of the LORD which He spoke to us. It shall therefore be a witness to you, lest you deny your God.

title: Joshua 24:28
text: And Joshua sent away the people, each man to his inheritance.

title: Joshua 24:29
text: And it happened after these things, Joshua, the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, [being] a hundred and ten years old.

title: Joshua 24:30
text: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-serah in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.

title: Joshua 24:31
text: And Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, and who had known all the works of the LORD that He had done for Israel.

title: Joshua 24:32
text: And the bones of Joseph, which the sons of Israel brought up out of Egypt, they buried in Shechem, in a piece of ground which Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of silver. And it became the inheritance of the sons of Joseph.

title: Joshua 24:33
text: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died. And they buried him in a hill [belonging] to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.

title: Judges 1:1
text: And it happened after the death of Joshua, the children of Israel asked the LORD, saying, Who shall go up first for us against the Canaanites to fight against them?

title: Judges 1:2
text: And the LORD said, Judah shall go up. Behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.

title: Judges 1:3
text: And Judah said to Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot so that we may fight against the Canaanites. And I likewise will go with you into your lot. So Simeon went with him.

title: Judges 1:4
text: And Judah went up. And the LORD delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand. And they killed ten thousand men of them in Bezek.

title: Judges 1:5
text: And they found Adoni-bezek in Bezek. And, they fought against him, and they killed the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

title: Judges 1:6
text: And Adoni-bezek fled. And they ran after him and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his big toes.

title: Judges 1:7
text: And Adoni-bezek said, Seventy kings [with] their thumbs and big toes cut off have gathered under my table. As I have done, so God has requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.

title: Judges 1:8
text: And the sons of Judah had fought against Jerusalem, and had taken it, and had struck it with the edge of the sword, and had set the city on fire.

title: Judges 1:9
text: And afterward the sons of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who lived in the mountain, and in the south, and in the valley.

title: Judges 1:10
text: And Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron; (and the name of Hebron before [was] Kirjath-arba). And they killed Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.

title: Judges 1:11
text: And from there he went against those who lived in Debir. And the name of Debir before [was] Kirjath-sepher.

title: Judges 1:12
text: And Caleb said, He who strikes Kirjath-sepher and takes it, I will give Achsah my daughter to him for a wife.

title: Judges 1:13
text: And Othniel, the son of Caleb's younger brother Kenaz, took it. And he gave him Achsah his daughter for a wife.

title: Judges 1:14
text: And it happened when she came, she moved him to ask for a field from her father. And she dismounted from the ass. And Caleb said to her, What do you desire?

title: Judges 1:15
text: And she said to him, Give me a blessing. For you have given me a south land. Give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

title: Judges 1:16
text: And the sons of the Kenite, Moses' father-in-law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the sons of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which [is] in the south of Arad. And they went and lived among the people.

title: Judges 1:17
text: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they killed the Canaanites who lived in Zephath and destroyed it. And the name of the city [was called] Hormah.

title: Judges 1:18
text: Also Judah took Gaza with its border, and Askelon with its border, and Ekron with its border.

title: Judges 1:19
text: And the LORD was with Judah. And he took possession of the mountain. But he could not drive out those who lived in the valley, because they had chariots of iron.

title: Judges 1:20
text: And they gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses said. And he expelled the three sons of Anak from there.

title: Judges 1:21
text: And the sons of Benjamin did not expel the Jebusites who lived in Jerusalem. But the Jebusites live with the sons of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.

title: Judges 1:22
text: And the house of Joseph also went up against Bethel, and the LORD [was] with them.

title: Judges 1:23
text: And the house of Joseph sent to spy out Bethel. And the name of the city before [was] Luz.

title: Judges 1:24
text: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city, and they said to him, Please show us the gate into the city, and we will show you mercy.

title: Judges 1:25
text: And when he showed them the gate into the city, they struck the city with the edge of the sword. But they let the man and all his family go.

title: Judges 1:26
text: And the man went into the land of the Hittites and built a city, and called the name of it Luz, which [is] the name of it to this day.

title: Judges 1:27
text: And Manasseh had not taken possession of Beth-shean and its daughter -[villages], nor Taanach and its daughter -[villages], nor [struck] the inhabitants of Dor and its daughter -[villages], nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and its daughter -[villages], nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and its daughter -[villages]. For the Canaanites were determined to live in that land.

title: Judges 1:28
text: And it happened, when Israel became strong, they put the Canaanites to tribute, and did not completely expel them.

title: Judges 1:29
text: And Ephraim did not expel the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, but the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them.

title: Judges 1:30
text: And Zebulun did not expel those who lived in Kitron, nor those who lived in Nahalol. But the Canaanites lived among them and became tributaries.

title: Judges 1:31
text: And Asher did not expel those who lived in Accho, and the inhabitants of Sidon, and Ahlab, and Achzib, and Helbah, and Aphik, and Rehob.

title: Judges 1:32
text: But the Asherites lived among the Canaanites, those who lived in the land, for they did not expel them.

title: Judges 1:33
text: And Naphtali did not expel those who lived in Beth-shemesh, and the inhabitants of Beth-anath, and they lived among the Canaanites, those who lived in the land. But those who lived in Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath became tributaries to them

title: Judges 1:34
text: And the Amorites forced the sons of Dan into the mountain. For they would not allow them to come down to the valley.

title: Judges 1:35
text: But the Amorites desired to stay in Mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim. Yet the hand of the house of Joseph won out so that they became tributaries.

title: Judges 1:36
text: And the border of the Amorites [was] from the going up to Akrabbim, from the rock and upward.

title: Judges 2:1
text: And the Angel of the LORD came up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said, I made you go up out of Egypt, and have brought you into the land which I swore to your fathers. And I said, I will never break My covenant with you.

title: Judges 2:2
text: And you shall make no treaty with those who live in this land. You shall throw down their altars. But you have not obeyed My voice. What [is] this that you have done?

title: Judges 2:3
text: And I also said, I will not drive them out from before you, but they shall be thorns in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare to you.

title: Judges 2:4
text: And it happened when the Angel of the LORD spoke these words to all the sons of Israel, the people lifted up their voices and wept.

title: Judges 2:5
text: And they called the name of that place Bochim. And they sacrificed there to the LORD.

title: Judges 2:6
text: And when Joshua had let the people go, the sons of Israel left, each man to his inheritance, to possess the land.

title: Judges 2:7
text: And the people served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great works of the LORD that He did for Israel.

title: Judges 2:8
text: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being a hundred and ten years old.

title: Judges 2:9
text: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-heres, in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill Gaash.

title: Judges 2:10
text: And also all that generation were gathered to their fathers. And there arose another generation after them who did not know the LORD, nor even the works which He had done for Israel.

title: Judges 2:11
text: And the sons of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD, and served Baals.

title: Judges 2:12
text: And they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt. And they followed other gods of the gods of the people who were around them, and bowed themselves to them, and provoked the LORD to anger.

title: Judges 2:13
text: And they forsook the LORD and served Baal and Ashtaroth.

title: Judges 2:14
text: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and He delivered them into the hand of spoilers who spoiled them. And He sold them into the hand of their enemies all around, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.

title: Judges 2:15
text: Wherever they went out, the hand of the LORD was against them for evil, as the LORD had said, and as the LORD had sworn to them. And they were greatly distressed.

title: Judges 2:16
text: But the LORD raised up judges who delivered them out of the hand of those who spoiled them.

title: Judges 2:17
text: And yet they would not listen to their judges, but they went lusting after other gods, and bowed themselves to them. They turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in, for they had obeyed the commandments of the LORD; these did not do so.

title: Judges 2:18
text: And when the LORD raised judges up for them, then the LORD was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge. For the LORD took pity because of their groanings before their oppressors and their crushers.

title: Judges 2:19
text: And it happened when the judge was dead, they returned and made themselves more rotten than their fathers in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down to them. They did not cease from their own doings nor from their stubborn way.

title: Judges 2:20
text: And the anger of the LORD glowed against Israel. And He said, Because this nation has transgressed My covenant which I commanded their fathers, and has not listened to My voice,

title: Judges 2:21
text: I also from now on will not expel any from before them of the nations that Joshua left when he died;

title: Judges 2:22
text: so that by them I may test Israel, whether they are keeping the way of the LORD, to go in it, as their fathers kept it, or not.

title: Judges 2:23
text: And the LORD left those nations, without driving them out quickly. And He did not deliver them into the hand of Joshua.

title: Judges 3:1
text: And these are the nations which the LORD left, to prove Israel by them, as many as had not known all the wars of Canaan;

title: Judges 3:2
text: only that the generations of the sons of Israel might know, to teach them war, at the least those who before knew nothing of it:

title: Judges 3:3
text: five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites that lived in Mount Lebanon, from Mount Baal-hermon to the border of Hamath.

title: Judges 3:4
text: And they were to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would listen to the commands of the LORD, which He commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.

title: Judges 3:5
text: And the sons of Israel lived among the Canaanites, Hittites, and Amorites, and Perizzites, and Hivites, and Jebusites.

title: Judges 3:6
text: And they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their daughters to their sons, and served their gods.

title: Judges 3:7
text: And the sons of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD and forgot the LORD their God, and served Baals and the Asherahs.

title: Judges 3:8
text: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and He sold them into the hands of Chushan-rishathaim, king of Mesopotamia. And the sons of Israel served Chushan-rishathaim eight years.

title: Judges 3:9
text: And when the sons of Israel cried to the LORD, the LORD raised up a deliverer to the sons of Israel, who delivered them, Othniel, the son of Caleb's younger brother Kenaz.

title: Judges 3:10
text: And the spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he judged Israel and went out to war. And the LORD delivered Chushan-rishathaim, king of Mesopotamia, into his hand. And his hand prevailed against Chushan-rishathaim.

title: Judges 3:11
text: And the land had rest forty years. And Othniel the son of Kenaz died.

title: Judges 3:12
text: And the sons of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD. And the LORD made Eglon the king of Moab strong against Israel because they had done evil in the sight of the LORD.

title: Judges 3:13
text: And he gathered to him the sons of Ammon and Amalek. And he went forth and struck Israel, and took the city of palm trees.

title: Judges 3:14
text: So the sons of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.

title: Judges 3:15
text: But when the sons of Israel cried to the LORD, the LORD raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a left-handed man. And the sons of Israel sent a present to Eglon the king of Moab by him.

title: Judges 3:16
text: But Ehud made himself a dagger which had two edges, a cubit long. And he tied it under his clothing upon his right thigh.

title: Judges 3:17
text: And he brought the present to Eglon king of Moab. And Eglon was a very fat man.

title: Judges 3:18
text: And when he had finished offering the present, he sent away the people who carried the present.

title: Judges 3:19
text: But he himself turned again from the graven images by Gilgal, and said, I have a secret message for you, O, king. And he said, Keep silence. And all that stood by him went out from him.

title: Judges 3:20
text: And Ehud came to him. And he was sitting [in] the cool roof room which he had for himself alone. And Ehud said, I have a message from God to you. And he rose out of his seat.

title: Judges 3:21
text: And Ehud put forth his left hand and took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly.

title: Judges 3:22
text: And the haft also went in after the blade. And the fat closed upon the blade, so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly. And the dung came out.

title: Judges 3:23
text: Then Ehud went forth through the porch, and shut the doors of the room upon him, and locked them.

title: Judges 3:24
text: And when he had gone out, his servants came. And they looked, and, behold, the doors of the roof room were locked, they said, Surely he [is] covering his feet in his cool roof room.

title: Judges 3:25
text: And they waited until they were ashamed. And, behold, he did not open the doors of the room. And they took a key and opened them. And behold, their lord [had] fallen down dead on the earth.

title: Judges 3:26
text: And Ehud escaped while they waited, and passed beyond the graven images, and escaped to Seirath.

title: Judges 3:27
text: And it happened, when he had come, he blew a ram's horn in the mountain of Ephraim, and the sons of Israel went down with him from the mountain, and he before them.

title: Judges 3:28
text: And he said to them, Follow after me. For the LORD has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand. And they went down after him and took the fords of Jordan toward Moab, and did not allow a man to pass over.

title: Judges 3:29
text: And they killed about ten thousand of the men of Moab at that time, all lusty, and all men of might. And there did not escape a man.

title: Judges 3:30
text: So Moab was subdued under the hand of Israel that day. And the land had rest eighty years.

title: Judges 3:31
text: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who killed six hundred men of the Philistines with an ox goad. And he also delivered Israel.

title: Judges 4:1
text: And the sons of Israel again did evil in the sight of the LORD when Ehud was dead.

title: Judges 4:2
text: And the LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who ruled in Hazor. The captain of his host was Sisera who lived in Harosheth of the nations.

title: Judges 4:3
text: And the sons of Israel cried to the LORD, for he had nine hundred chariots of iron. And he mightily oppressed the sons of Israel twenty years.
